# 2025: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 5,453 Wikipedia event assertions across the full calendar year, with pinned source revisions, topic context and original citations. It is intended for long-term reference, reading and LLM context.

The sources reflect Wikipedia’s selection and wording. They are not guaranteed exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Independent checks are recorded where performed; publication does not imply that every event has been independently verified. Source errors remain visible, alongside separately labeled cited editorial accounts.

Database: [2025.sqlite](2025.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `5b21f969460809b03b64a21be2c638023cde5abfe321fac9ead653964eb373bd`. Publication contract: `preservation-release-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

The 7 entries originally lacking attached citations have separate publisher evidence in the editorial layer. There are 8 editorial accounts, including documented corrections; 5 full-event reviews are complete and 3 remain partial. Outstanding questions are disclosed rather than used to postpone source preservation.

Editorial dates are explicit where they differ from portal dates. Historical casualty totals apply at the reporting time. Five unclassified fragments from one malformed May 6 football passage and an empty July 5 marker are preserved in the database; they are not invented event assertions. Original daily files, cached source bytes, metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with a deletion manifest and Git checkpoint identity.

Wikipedia text is attributed through the pinned revision links and remains subject to its CC BY-SA terms. Publisher links identify evidence; publisher full text and images are not reproduced. This is an archival chronicle, with further synthesis and a PDF yearbook possible as later interpretations.

## Recorded research findings

These are scoped observations, not endorsements of entire days or the year. Access limitations and unresolved claims remain explicit.

- **2025-01-20: supported.** Date of clemency proclamation, broad pardon provision and fourteen named commutations. Primary proclamation supports this scope. Approximate total of 1,500 is not independently established by the document; this is not a review of every word in the portal event. Evidence: [White House](<https://www.whitehouse.gov/Presidential-actions/2025/01/granting-pardons-and-commutation-of-sentences-for-certain-offenses-relating-to-the-events-at-or-near-the-united-states-capitol-on-january-6-2021/>) (opened).

- **2025-01-25: contradicted.** Calendar placement of the Australian Open women's doubles final and reported result. Organizer dates the final to January 26, not the archive entry's January 25. Winners and score match. Retain original extraction and flag a separate editorial date correction. Evidence: [Australian Open](<https://ausopen.com/articles/news/townsend-returns-rod-laver-take-doubles-title-siniakova>) (opened).

- **2025-02-23: supported.** Official Bundestag seat totals and separately reported SPD/AfD vote shares. Official seats match: CDU 164 plus CSU 44, AfD 152, SPD 120. SPD 16.4% and AfD 20.8% match. Combined Union percentage is outside this check; do not add already-rounded component shares. Evidence: [Federal Returning Officer, Germany](<https://www.bundeswahlleiterin.de/bundestagswahlen/2025/ergebnisse/bund-99.html>) (opened).

- **2025-03-12: needs research.** Source reliability annotation and attribution of encirclement claim. Pinned source contains an unreliable-inline tag. Extraction preserves this annotation. The party-attributed military claim and independent corroboration have not been checked; do not restate it as an established battlefield fact. Evidence: [Proto Thema](<https://en.protothema.gr/2025/03/12/putin-visits-kursk-in-camouflage-uniform-a-day-after-u-s-kyiv-ceasefire-deal-ukrainian-forces-encircled/>) (not_opened).

- **2025-03-28: partially supported.** Earthquake occurrence, date, magnitude and scope of casualty reporting. GSI supports March 28 and magnitude 7.7, not the casualty figures or emergency declaration. Portal cites next-day reporting for part of this event; casualty totals need explicit reporting times and publisher checks. Evidence: [Geospatial Information Authority of Japan](<https://www.gsi.go.jp/cais/topic20250328-e_Myanmar.html>) (opened); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/earthquake-myanmar-thailand-77-bangkok-tremor-rcna198515>) (blocked).

- **2025-04-02: contradicted.** Effective dates of baseline and higher reciprocal tariff announcements. Source entry conflates effective dates: official fact sheet distinguishes the April 5 baseline from higher reciprocal rates effective April 9. It also lists exclusions; do not generalize the China statement to all goods. Original extraction remains unchanged. Evidence: [White House](<https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/04/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-declares-national-emergency-to-increase-our-competitive-edge-protect-our-sovereignty-and-strengthen-our-national-and-economic-security/>) (opened).

- **2025-04-06: supported.** Championship date, opponents, final score and Azzi Fudd award. The otherwise uncited source event is supported by the university-hosted AP game report. Add this evidence to researched synthesis rather than silently inserting a citation into the Wikipedia extraction. Evidence: [UConn Athletics (AP report)](<https://uconnhuskies.com/news/2025/4/6/womens-basketball-huskies-champs-for-the-12th-time>) (opened).

- **2025-04-21: supported.** Death date, age and Cardinal Farrell announcement. Vatican account supports the source event. No medical-cause analysis or unrelated biographical assertions were checked. Evidence: [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-04/pope-francis-dies-on-easter-monday-aged-88.html>) (opened).

- **2025-05-06: supported.** Election date, second ballot, 325 affirmative votes and 316-vote threshold. Bundestag account supports the checked election details. Chancellor ordinal is outside the scope of this check. Evidence: [German Bundestag](<https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2025/kw19-de-kanzlerwahl-1062470>) (opened).

- **2025-06-12: partially supported.** Accident occurrence, date, aircraft type and accessibility of casualty sources. Initial AAIB report text identifies B787-8 VT-ANB and the June 12 Ahmedabad accident. The 204 recovered bodies, passenger/crew totals and survivor statement have not been verified in this pass. The cited CNA article returned 404; repeated AAIB requests later timed out. Evidence: [Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau, India](<https://aaib.gov.in/Reports/2025/Accident/Preliminary%20Report%20VT-ANB.pdf>) (opened); [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/air-india-plane-crash-ahmedabad-airport-5177241>) (not_found).

- **2025-07-04: partially supported.** Flood date/existence and accessibility of sources for rolling casualty totals. NWS index identifies historic July 4 floods. It does not establish the 51 fatalities, 15 children or 27 missing children. The linked interactive collection did not provide readable event text; source totals require dated reports, not retrospective final figures. Evidence: [National Weather Service, San Angelo](<https://www.weather.gov/index.php/sjt/climate-pastevents>) (opened); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr4w36lnvgyo>) (blocked); [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/article/5044c169b59921b2b4f65a2568c354c0>) (blocked).

- **2025-08-08: partially supported.** Washington meeting/declaration and distinction from a ratified peace treaty. Primary text records an August 8 signed declaration and initialing of agreed treaty text; further signing/ratification steps were still required. The source event's prospective wording needs chronological context for a retrospective yearbook. Evidence: [Prime Minister of Armenia](<https://www.primeminister.am/en/press-release/item/2025/08/09/Nikol-Pashinyan-visit-US-declaration/>) (opened).

- **2025-08-08: needs research.** Claim of an exclusive 99-year development-rights grant and associated infrastructure terms. Opened declaration describes a future TRIPP framework and Armenian jurisdiction, without substantiating the detailed 99-year grant claim. This is insufficient evidence, not proof that no separate agreement existed. Politico retrieval was blocked. Evidence: [Prime Minister of Armenia](<https://www.primeminister.am/en/press-release/item/2025/08/09/Nikol-Pashinyan-visit-US-declaration/>) (opened); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2025/08/07/us-deal-armenia-azerbaijan-00499285>) (blocked).

- **2025-09-08: contradicted.** Geographical attribution of nineteen protest deaths. The cited Sky article gives seventeen deaths in Kathmandu and two in Itahari, while the portal sentence places nineteen in Kathmandu. This is a geographic aggregation issue. Source wording is preserved; any researched account must distinguish locations. Evidence: [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-14-dead-in-nepal-protests-over-social-media-ban-13427038>) (opened).

- **2025-10-10: supported.** 2025 Nobel Peace Prize recipient and stated reason for the award. Official committee announcement supports the recipient and democratic-rights rationale. This check does not endorse unrelated political background or additional claims. Evidence: [Norwegian Nobel Committee](<https://www.nobelpeaceprize.org/articles/nobels-fredspris-2025-1>) (opened).

- **2025-11-16: supported.** Referendum/consultation subjects, rejection outcomes and event/publication dates. The following-day report supports rejection of three referendum questions and the constituent-assembly consultation. Publication date November 17 is distinct from the Sunday November 16 vote. Evidence: [El Pais](<https://elpais.com/america/2025-11-17/el-primer-gran-reves-de-noboa-ecuador-dice-no-a-todas-sus-reformas-constitucionales.html>) (opened).

- **2025-12-14: partially supported.** Victim/perpetrator death distinction, injury totals and source-update scope. ABC supports fifteen victims plus one gunman dead and reports 38 injured in its December 15 update; portal has 42. These evolving totals need reporting-time reconciliation, not an automatic correction. Bomb details are unverified. Original live source exposes only a closed-page shell. Evidence: [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-12-14/what-we-know-bondi-beach-shooting/106141672>) (opened); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/14/bondi-beach-shooting-live-two-in-custody-sydney-police-operation-ongoing?update=4173903>) (opened).

## January

### 2025-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362429197](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20January%201&oldid=1362429197>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip kill at least 26 Palestinians, including four children. At least ten others are missing and believed to be buried under rubble.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/1/israel-kills-at-least-22-palestinians-across-gaza-on-new-year-day>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-0-4"></a>

Context: 2025 New Orleans truck attack.

**Archived source account.** A man kills 14 people and injures 35 others, including two police officers, in a vehicle-ramming and shooting attack on Bourbon Street in New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, before being shot dead. The FBI says that it found an Islamic State flag in the suspect's vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/multiple-fatalities-truck-crashes-into-new-orleans-crowd-cbs-news-says-2025-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission, endorsed by the United Nations Security Council on December 27, replaces the African Union Transition Mission as the African Union's peacekeeping mission in Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of Nigeria](<https://von.gov.ng/un-approves-new-au-force-in-somalia/>); [UN Press](<https://press.un.org/en/2024/sc15955.doc.htm>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-01-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 Russia–European Union gas dispute.

**Archived source account.** Russia's gas firm Gazprom suspends exports of Russian natural gas through Ukrainian pipelines after Ukraine refused to renew the transit agreement between its operator Naftogaz and Gazprom. However, Hungary will continue receiving Russian natural gas via the TurkStream pipeline.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russia-halts-gas-exports-europe-via-ukraine-2025-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Mexico.

**Archived source account.** Mexico's Tax Administration Service implements new tariffs, including a 19% duty on goods from countries without international trade agreements with Mexico and a 17% duty on goods from Canada and the United States under certain value thresholds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-unveils-new-tariffs-popular-e-tailers-like-shein-temu-may-be-crosshairs-2024-12-31/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-1-5"></a>

Context: Moldova–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** As announced, Russia's Gazprom halts its gas supplies both to Moldova and the self-proclaimed Transnistrian Republic alleging non-compliance with payment obligations.,

Source citations (as archived): [bne IntelliNews](<https://www.intellinews.com/russia-cuts-gas-deliveries-to-moldova-in-attempt-to-undermine-political-stability-359712/>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/moldova-gas-russia-cut-off-russia-cuts-off-gas-to-moldovan-separatists-risking-humanitarian-crisis/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-01-01-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-seven migrants from sub-Saharan Africa are killed, and 83 others are rescued after two boats capsize off the Kerkennah Islands near Tunisia, with searches ongoing for additional missing passengers.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250102-27-sub-saharan-african-migrants-die-off-tunisia-in-shipwrecks>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and over twenty others are injured in a fireworks explosion at a house in Honolulu, Hawaii, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/rescuers-find-gruesome-scene-at-a-honolulu-home-after-a-fireworks-blast-kills-3-injures-over-20-1.7162295>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tour bus crashed into a tree in Surat Thani province, Thailand, killing five and 30.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/tour-bus-crash-in-thailands-surat-thani-leaves-5-dead-30-injured>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-01-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Honduras–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Honduran President Xiomara Castro warns that she might remove all US military bases from Honduras and seek to cancel the military cooperation with the United States if President-elect Donald Trump fulfills his threat to order mass deportations of Hondurans when he takes office next January 20.

Source citations (as archived): [The Tico Times](<https://ticotimes.net/2025/01/02/honduras-threatens-to-expel-u-s-military-bases-over-trumps-deportation-plans>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Cetinje shootings.

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed and four others are injured in a shooting spree in Cetinje, Montenegro. The perpetrator kills himself.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/montenegro-shooting-gunman-suicide-cetinje-7ab4ac905c4d08bca357251823dd4ee6>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/2/at-least-10-killed-in-mass-shooting-in-montenegro-suspect-kills-himself>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Al Jazeera controversies and criticism.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Authority suspends Al Jazeera's broadcasts and operations in Palestine, accusing the network of interfering in internal affairs and spreading incitement and misinformation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-authority-suspends-broadcast-qatars-al-jazeera-tv-temporarily-2025-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-5"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia announces the execution of six Iranian nationals convicted of smuggling hashish. In Tehran, the Iranian Foreign Ministry summoned the Saudi ambassador in protest.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-saudi-arabia-hashish-executions-efd48a3efcdbf2664e14c8ccf879f323>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-7"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in Liechtenstein.

**Archived source account.** Liechtenstein becomes the 37th country to legalize same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [GCN](<https://gcn.ie/liechtenstein-legalise-same-sex-marriage/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-9"></a>

Context: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas Tesla Cybertruck explosion.

**Archived source account.** A Tesla Cybertruck containing firework mortars and gas canisters explodes outside the Trump International Hotel Las Vegas in Paradise, Nevada, United States, injuring seven people. The driver died from a self-inflicted gunshot prior to the explosion. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is currently investigating the incident as a possible terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abc7.com/post/trump-tower-fire-police-investigating-vehicle-explosion-las-vegas-nevada-hotel-driver-dead/15737979/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed, several others are injured, and at least 330 people are arrested due to mishandling of pyrotechnics during New Year's celebrations in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/world/538011/five-dead-in-germany-from-new-year-s-fireworks-accidents>); [1News](<https://www.1news.co.nz/2025/01/02/german-government-condemns-violence-that-killed-five-on-nye/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed in a familicide mass stabbing when a son kills his four sisters and mother in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/uttar-pradesh/five-of-family-found-dead-in-lucknow-hotel-accused-held/article69049292.ece>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's Tatmadaw enacts a cybersecurity law imposing strict controls on digital communications, requiring service providers to store user data for three years, penalizing VPN use without government approval, and allowing authorities to block or shut down platforms deemed to spread disinformation or disrupt stability.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/internet-online-censorship-law-repression-8128ba7a2c02555217c6a64ab641eaf6>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** A police officer is killed and four other people are injured in a vehicle-ramming attack during a patrol in Nelson, New Zealand. A 32-year-old suspect is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/police-officer-killed-zealand-nelson-lyn-fleming-475f2a6aa1a5e7739b19d3fd1e724733>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are injured during a mass shooting outside a nightclub in Queens, New York, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nightly](<https://thenightly.com.au/world/new-york-nightclub-mass-shooting-11-people-reportedly-injured-after-incident-at-amazura-night-club-in-queens-c-17263836>).

<a id="event-2025-01-01-4-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** FBI agents announce the seizure of more than 150 homemade pipe bombs and other explosive devices from a home in Isle of Wight County, Virginia, United States, "the largest seizure by number of finished explosive devices in FBI history".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/homemade-bombs-seized-virginia-firearms-c68488480ef8bd3de7b432272399aa28>).

Source citations (as archived): [tagesschau](<https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/regional/berlin/polizisten-explosion-verletzungen-berlin-100.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-01-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Italy relations.

**Archived source account.** Italy summons Iran's ambassador to demand the release of Il Foglio reporter Cecilia Sala, detained in Tehran for alleged legal violations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/italy-iran-journalist-arrest-ambassador-6656e7f9df9db8b7216a180d69dde52c>).

<a id="event-2025-01-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Syria–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that Ukraine will pledge support to the Syrian transitional government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Press Democrat](<https://www.pressdemocrat.com/article/news/middle-east-latest-ukraine-pledges-support-for-a-new-syria-once-a-key-rus/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-01-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Venezuelan political crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government of Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro offers a US$100,000 reward for the capture of exiled opposition leader Edmundo González Urrutia, who claims that he is ready to take office as the legitimate president on January 10.

Source citations (as archived): [El Universal](<https://www.eluniversal.com/politica/198116/gobierno-nacional-ofrece-recompensa-de-100000-por-la-captura-de-edmundo-gonzalez-urrutia>); [El País](<https://elpais.com/america/2024-11-25/edmundo-gonzalez-asegura-que-tomara-posesion-como-presidente-el-10-de-enero-en-caracas.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-02-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ecuadorian president Daniel Noboa decrees the suspension of his vice president Verónica Abad accusing her of contempt, and the handover of her functions to national planning secretary Sariha Moya. Noboa already appointed Moya to replace Abad in November 2024, but a constitutional judge reversed the decree in December.

Source citations (as archived): [Swiss Info](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/noboa-vuelve-a-designar-vice-interina-de-ecuador-en-medio-de-pugna-con-abad/88668546>).

<a id="event-2025-01-02-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Ghana prevents a potential government shutdown by approving a provisional budget of ₵68.1 billion ($4.65 billion) to fund government operations through March, amid a transition to John Mahama's presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ghanas-parliament-passes-provisional-budget-averts-government-shutdown-2025-01-03/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-02-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Indonesia rules that the 20% electoral threshold for political parties to nominate a presidential candidate is not legally binding, potentially enabling smaller parties to participate in future presidential elections without the need to form coalition with larger parties.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-court-says-vote-threshold-presidential-candidates-not-legally-binding-2025-01-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-02-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chilean president, Gabriel Boric, begins a historic three-day trip to Antarctica along with civil, scientific and military authorities. According to the Chilean Government, the codenamed Operación Estrella Polar III seeks to strengthen the country's presence in the territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Government of Chile](<https://www.gob.cl/noticias/presidente-gabriel-boric-realiza-historico-viaje-polo-sur-operacion-estrella-polar/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-02-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jenniffer González Colón takes office as Governor of Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/puerto-ricos-new-governor-takes-office-amid-anger-following-major-blackout>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-01-02-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 in paleontology, Dinosaur finds in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The largest site of dinosaur footprints of the Cetiosaurus and Megalosaurus dating back to the Middle Jurassic Bathonian stage 166 million years ago is discovered at a quarry in Oxfordshire, England, United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c24nzeqq1l2o>).

### 2025-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1283169332](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20January%203&oldid=1283169332>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / East Aleppo offensive.

**Archived source account.** Clashes between the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army escalate near the Tishrin Dam in Aleppo Governorate, Syria. The Turkish Air Force also conducts airstrikes on SDF positions.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/352816/>); [SOHR 2](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/352846/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / US intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Deputy U.S. Defense Press Secretary Sabrina Singh says that, despite local reports, the U.S. Army has "no plans" to build a military base in Kobani, Aleppo Governorate, which is currently under the control of the Syrian Democratic Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<https://manage.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/030120254>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Haitian crisis / Gang war in Haiti, Guatemala–Haiti relations, El Salvador–Haiti relations, El Salvador–Guatemala relations.

**Archived source account.** A contingent of peacekeeping troops from Guatemala and El Salvador arrive in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, to enforce a United Nations-backed multinational security mission to restore order to Port-au-Prince amid an increase in gang violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/central-american-troops-arrive-haiti-fight-gangs-2025-01-03/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-0-9"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Defense Forces report the interception of a ballistic missile and a drone launched from Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20250103-israel-intercepts-new-missile-launched-from-yemen-says-idf>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-01-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Proposed acquisition of U.S. Steel by Nippon Steel.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden blocks a buyout bid by Japanese Nippon Steel for U.S. Steel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2vz83pg9eo>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Qatar Airways announces the resumption of flights to Damascus International Airport in Syria beginning on January 7, becoming the first major international airline to resume scheduled service to Syria since the Syrian civil war began in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Aviation Week](<https://aviationweek.com/air-transport/airports-networks/qatar-airways-resume-syria-flights>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-01-03-2-1"></a>

Context: January 2025 North American winter storm.

**Archived source account.** The National Weather Service issues winter storm warnings across the central Great Plains and an ice storm warning in Missouri, in anticipation of severe freezing rain and icing events. The winter storm begins impacting the northwestern continental United States with heavy snowfall.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2025-01-02-winter-storm-blair-forecast-snow-ice-plains-midwest-mid-atlantic>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-2-3"></a>

Context: 2024–25 Ethiopian earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** Evacuations are ordered in central Ethiopia due to increasing volcanic tremor and other unrest at the Mount Fentale stratovolcano, which last erupted in the 19th century.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/risk-ethiopian-volcano-eruption-prompts-evacuation-residents-2025-01-03/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least twelve people are killed and 30 others are injured after a bus carrying tourists falls into a ravine near the Pan-American Highway between Pasto and Rumichaca in Nariño Department, Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [EFE](<https://efe.com/mundo/2025-01-04/colombia-accidente-autobus/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-01-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Air quality technology company IQAir reports that Hanoi, Vietnam, has the worst air pollution of any city on Earth, with levels of hazardous small particles, known as PM2.5, measured at 266 micrograms per cubic metre.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hanoi-declared-worlds-most-polluted-city-authorities-seek-action-2025-01-03/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-01-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Egypt–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Egypt bans the entry of Syrians from all countries worldwide, except for those holding temporary residency permits for non-tourism purposes. The ban also includes Syrians married to Egyptians unless they obtain a security clearance.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Arab](<https://www.newarab.com/news/egypt-bans-entry-syrians-anywhere-world>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-4-3"></a>

Context: Germany–Syria relations, France–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock and French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot become the first European Union foreign ministers to travel to Damascus, Syria, after the fall of the Assad regime to discuss new diplomatic relations with the Syrian Transitional Government and Syrian civil society.

Source citations (as archived): [Der Spiegel](<https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/syrien-annalena-baerbock-reist-als-erste-eu-aussenministerin-nach-damaskus-a-6884f1be-3006-454b-9664-3ee76c0eda2e>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20250103-french-fm-visits-syria-with-german-counterpart-to-promote-peaceful-transition>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-01-03-5-2"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis / Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol.

**Archived source account.** Corruption investigators and prosecutors raid the central Seoul residence of recently-impeached South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol to arrest Yoon for refusing to respond to three court summons. The raid is unsuccessful due to the Presidential Security Service blocking further entrance into the residence, leading to a multi-hour standoff.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/jan/02/south-korea-police-on-way-to-arrest-president-yoon-suk-yeol-latest-updates?filterKeyEvents=false#maincontent>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-yoon-martial-law-impeachment-detention-c8dc1758647979455dbf0d56e70369a4>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-5-4"></a>

Context: 2024 Estlink 2 incident.

**Archived source account.** A district court in Helsinki, Finland, denies a request to release the impounded oil tanker Eagle S, suspected of damaging the Estlink 2 submarine power cable and carrying sanctioned Russian oil.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/3/finnish-court-upholds-oil-tanker-seizure-in-undersea-cables-probe>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-5-6"></a>

Context: War crimes in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian government arrests Aws Salloum, known as the "Angel of Death" of Sednaya Prison. Salloum is accused of multiple murders and abuse of prisoners at Sednaya, including the murder of Mazen al-Hamada.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Sharq Al Awsat](<https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5097881-arrest-aws-salloum-what-we-know-about-%E2%80%98azrael-sednaya%E2%80%99>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suspect is arrested in Rotterdam, Netherlands, for shooting and killing three men between December 21 and January 2. The victims were selected at random.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sun](<https://thesun.my/world-news/dutch-police-arrest-suspect-in-random-rotterdam-shootings-BO13480760>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-5-9"></a>

Context: Human trafficking in Southeast Asia.

**Archived source account.** Chinese actor Wang Xing went missing at the Thailand-Myanmar border. He was rescued later (Jan 7) by Thai authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/entertainment/2025/01/08/chinese-actor-wang-xing-says-he-was-forcibly-shaved-and-trained-as-scammer-in-myanmar>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-01-03-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives, composed of 219 Republicans and 215 Democrats, re-elects Mike Johnson as House Speaker over incumbent House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/2025-new-congress-sworn-in/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-6-3"></a>

Context: Next Ukrainian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that the country will not hold presidential elections as long as the country is under martial law, even if Russia puts it as a pre-condition for negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-again-rejects-elections-under-martial-law/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-03-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pula Nikolao Pula is sworn in as Governor of American Samoa.

Source citations (as archived): [Samoa Observer](<https://www.samoaobserver.ws/category/samoa/112622>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-01-03-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches the United Arab Emirates Space Agency's communications satellite Thuraya 4-NGS via a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Space News](<https://spacenews.com/spacex-launches-uaes-thuraya-4-mobile-connectivity-satellite/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-01-03-8-1"></a>

Context: 2025 PDC World Darts Championship.

**Archived source account.** Luke Littler defeats Michael van Gerwen 7–3 in the final at Alexandra Palace in London, England, to claim his first World Darts Championship title, becoming the youngest player to win a world title at the age of 17 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/darts/live/c4gwz153e7et>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign, Journalists killed during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-izvestia-says-reporter-killed-drone-strike-eastern-ukraine-2025-01-04/>).

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Armed Forces claims to have shot down eight American ATACMS missiles fired by Ukraine and vows retaliation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/04/europe/russia-retaliation-eight-atacms-missiles-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Haitian crisis, Guatemala–Haiti relations / Gang war in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** Another 75 Guatemalan Army troops arrive in Haiti, joining 75 that arrived yesterday, to combat escalating gang violence.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/03/americas/haiti-gang-violence-guatemala-el-salvador-soldiers-intl-latam/index.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2ld49lqq5qo>).

<a id="event-2025-01-04-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 70 Palestinians are killed and 14 others are reported missing in Israeli airstrikes on Gaza City and Khan Younis in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20250104-27-palestinians-killed-14-missing-from-israeli-airstrikes-on-gaza/>); [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/israel-hamas-war-70-dead-injured-in-fresh-strikes-2659873-2025-01-05>).

<a id="event-2025-01-04-0-12"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 offensive.

**Archived source account.** M23 rebels capture the strategic town of Katale in Masisi Territory, North Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Chimp Reports](<https://chimpreports.com/drc-m23-rebels-capture-strategic-town-of-katale-in-masisi-territory/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-04-0-14"></a>

Context: Anglophone Crisis.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen from Nigeria kill at least five Cameroonian soldiers and injure several others in Bakinjaw, Southwest Region, Cameroon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-nigeria-kill-five-cameroonian-soldiers-mp-says-2025-01-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-04-0-16"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and 35 others are injured, including soldiers, in a car bombing in Turbat, Balochistan, Pakistan. The Balochistan Liberation Army claims responsibility for the attack, which states it targeted a military convoy.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-balochistan-turbat-explosion-soldiers-72c4df692f4f0950d882d1b3961c32f2>).

<a id="event-2025-01-04-0-18"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Nigerian Army repels an ambush in Borno State and kills 34 Islamist militants in a gun battle in which six soldiers also die.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-troops-repel-boko-haram-ambush-borno-kill-34-insurgents-2025-01-08/>).

Context: January 2025 North American storm complex.

**Archived source account.** Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear declares a state of emergency for Kentucky, United States, amidst the upcoming winter storm.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-01-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar state media reports that the ruling military junta will release 5,864 prisoners, including 180 foreigners, under an amnesty marking the country's national independence day.

Context: 2024–2025 Georgian protests, 2024–2025 Georgian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Georgia's Ministry of Internal Affairs announces the expulsion of 91 foreign citizens, including 25 who participated in anti-Georgian Dream and pro-EU protests.

Source citations (as archived): [TVP World](<https://tvpworld.com/84360400/georgia-deports-foreigners-amid-anti-government-protests>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-05-4-2"></a>

<a id="event-2025-01-05-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Resurfaced videos show Syrian Justice Minister Shadi al-Waisi overseeing the execution of two women in 2015 on prostitution charges according to Sharia.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-01-05-5-1"></a>

Context: 2024–2025 Austrian government formation.

**Archived source account.** The ruling Austrian People's Party appoints Christian Stocker as its acting chairman to succeed Karl Nehammer, who resigned as party leader and Chancellor of Austria yesterday. Stocker says that he is open to negotiate with the Freedom Party of Austria to form the new post-election coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [DNYUZ](<https://dnyuz.com/2025/01/05/new-austrian-conservative-leader-ready-for-coalition-talks-with-far-right/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-05-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The German government reduces funding for two Israeli human rights groups, Zochrot and New Profile, that had advocated for Palestinian rights and antimilitarism.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-defunds-2-israeli-human-rights-groups/a-71217628>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-01-05-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 United Cup.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, the United States wins its second United Cup title after defeating Poland 2–0 in the final at the Ken Rosewall Arena in Sydney, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sports/tennis/united-states-claim-second-united-cup-title-with-win-over-poland-2025-01-05/>).

### 2025-01-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1347525844](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20January%206&oldid=1347525844>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in the Sahel / French military withdrawal from West Africa.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron says France was right to intervene militarily in the African Sahel against the mujahideen, that he is still waiting for the Sahel states to thank France and that the French Armed Forces were not forced out.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/still-awaiting-thanks-stopping-islamists-sahel-macron-says-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Gaza war, Israeli incursions in the West Bank / 2025 al-Funduq shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three Israelis are killed and eight others are injured in a mass shooting by Palestinian gunmen firing at a bus and two vehicles on Highway 55 in Al-Funduq in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdjgv1r4x81o>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-9"></a>

Context: Naxalite–Maoist insurgency / 2025 Bijapur Naxal attack.

**Archived source account.** A bomb blast attributed to Maoist rebels in Bijapur, Chhattisgarh, India, kills eight police officers and a driver traveling in a police vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/ten-policemen-feared-killed-bomb-blast-central-india-tv-report-says-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-12"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kherson strikes, Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A Russian drone attacks a civilian passenger bus in Kherson, Ukraine, reportedly killing at least one person and injuring at least nine others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-drone-kills-one-injures-nine-passenger-bus-ukraines-kherson-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-14"></a>

Context: 2024 Magdeburg car attack.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in the vehicle-ramming attack at the Magdeburg Christmas market in Magdeburg, Germany, on December 20, increases to six after a 52-year-old woman dies from injuries sustained in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cql5nlrp374o>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-16"></a>

Context: North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean military reports that North Korea has fired what appears to be an intermediate-range ballistic missile toward the Sea of Japan, in what would be the country's first missile launch in two months. The launch comes as U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken visits Seoul, South Korea, for talks with South Korean leaders.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crrwyv75g5xo>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-18"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** At least eight gunmen are killed and three policemen are wounded after security agents repels an attack near the Buenavista de Libertad, Yuriria, Guanajuato, Mexico. Security forces members seize four vehicles, ballistic vests, and twelve firearms. In the same area, another encounter was reported two months ago, leaving three officers wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Revista Proceso](<https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/estados/2025/1/6/fuerzas-de-seguridad-abaten-ocho-presuntos-criminales-en-yuriria-guanajuato-343294.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-0-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and two others are injured in an IED attack at a school near Abuja, Nigeria, with police identifying three men as suspects in bringing the device to the site.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-bomb-explosion-kills-two-people-nigerian-school-police-say-2025-01-06/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-01-06-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 Russia–European Union gas dispute.

**Archived source account.** According to Slovakia, a planned meeting between Slovak, Ukrainian, and European Commission officials over gas supplies scheduled for Tuesday has been cancelled due to Ukraine's refusal to participate in the meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/slovakia-says-gas-supply-meeting-with-ukraine-european-commission-cancelled-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian government announces that Indonesia has joined the BRICS trade bloc as a full member.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/indonesia-join-brics-bloc-full-member-brazil-says-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian bank Davivienda and Canadian bank Scotiabank announces a merger where Davivienda will absorb Scotiabank's operations in Colombia, Costa Rica and Panama, and, Scotiabank will acquire 20% of Davidienda's stakes.

Source citations (as archived): [Scotiabank](<https://www.scotiabank.com/corporate/en/home/media-centre/media-centre/news-release.html.html?id=4186&amp;language=en>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-01-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Assam mine incident.

**Archived source account.** Several miners are trapped in a coal mine in Dima Hasao, Assam, India, with rescue efforts underway involving the State Disaster Response Force, the National Disaster Response Force, and the Indian Army. Local authorities state that flooding may have caused the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/several-miners-trapped-coal-mine-indias-assam-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2025 H5N1 outbreak.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/louisiana-reports-first-bird-flu-related-death-us-state-agency-says-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-4-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Humanitarian aid during the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The International Committee of the Red Cross announces plans to expand its operations in Syria beyond an initial US$100 million program, citing urgent needs in the health, water, and power sectors.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/icrc-expand-syria-humanitarian-efforts-beyond-100-mln-programme-2025-01-06/>).

Context: International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election, Paraguay–Venezuela relations.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-01-06-5-1"></a>

Context: Volksverhetzung.

**Archived source account.** Germany reports a significant increase in far-right crime, primarily from increasing online expression offenses and hate speech, as well as an increase in Gaza war-related resentment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germany-sees-rise-far-right-crime-with-online-offences-main-driver-2025-01-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Court of Appeal of Malaysia orders a lower court to reconsider former Prime Minister Najib Razak's claim of a royal order granting him home detention, which he alleges was issued alongside his reduced prison sentence for his involvement in the 1MDB corruption scandal. The ruling follows the disclosure of a letter confirming the existence of such an order, which the government asserts they have not received.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-court-grants-jailed-ex-pm-najibs-request-see-document-he-says-allows-2025-01-06/>).

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan Interior Minister Diosdado Cabello says that 125 foreign citizens have been arrested on suspicion of serving as United States mercenaries in order to cause a coup in Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/venezuela-says-125-foreigners-including-one-israeli-arrested-on-suspicion-of-being-us-mercenaries/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Austrian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** After the Austrian People's Party fails to form a government, President of Austria Alexander van der Bellen gives the mandate to form a post-election government to the Freedom Party's leader Herbert Kickl, who is expected to rule within a coalition of the two parties.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/de/van-der-bellen-erteilt-fp%C3%B6-auftrag-zur-regierungsbildung/a-71227474>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-3"></a>

Context: Conscription in Israel, Exemption from military service in Israel.

**Archived source account.** More than 50 Haredi Jews join the Israel Defense Forces for the first time since the start of the Gaza war, forming the Haredi Hasmonean Brigade, after repeated protests against the conscription of yeshiva students.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/us/israel-defense-forces-recruit-first-ultra-orthodox-soldiers-for-hasmonean-brigade/articleshow/117000437.cms?from=mdr>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-5"></a>

Context: Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland.

**Archived source account.** The King of Denmark officially changes the Danish coat of arms to feature Greenland and the Faroe Islands more prominently, following suggestions from United States president-elect Donald Trump about the nation purchasing Greenland.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jan/06/danish-king-changes-coat-of-arms-in-apparent-rebuke-to-donald-trump>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-7"></a>

Context: Resignation of Justin Trudeau.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announces his resignation as leader of the Liberal Party and also announces that he will resign as Prime Minister once a new Liberal Party leader is chosen.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/clyjmy7vl64t>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-9"></a>

Context: Second presidential transition of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Congress certifies the results of the 2024 presidential election. U.S. Vice President and Democratic Party candidate in the 2024 presidential election. Kamala Harris presides over the ceremony and certifies her defeat, officially making Donald Trump the President-elect and JD Vance the Vice President-elect. Trump and Vance are expected to be sworn-in on January 20.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/congress-meets-certify-trumps-2024-election-victory/story?id=117380065>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis appoints Sister Simona Brambilla as Prefect of the Dicastery for Institutes of Consecrated Life and Societies of Apostolic Life, becoming the Vatican's first female prefect of the Roman Curia.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-01/vatican-first-female-prefect-simona-brambilla-consecrated-life.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-06-6-11"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<https://www.africanews.com/2025/01/06/sao-tome-and-principe-president-dismisses-government-by-decree/>).

### 2025-01-07

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-01-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Argentine debt restructuring.

**Archived source account.** Argentina's country risk index, measured by the JPMorgan GBI-EM Index, briefly drops to 444 points, its lowest level since 2018, before closing at 561 points due to technical adjustments linked to upcoming bond payment amid improved market sentiment driven by cooling inflation and signs of economic recovery.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-country-risk-plummets-lowest-level-since-may-2018-2025-01-07/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** International flights resume from Damascus International Airport in Syria for the first time since the fall of the Assad regime.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250107-international-flights-resume-at-damascus-airport>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The merger of the providers of stock photography Getty Images and Shutterstock, by the acquisition of the latter by the former, is announced.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/article/shutterstock-getty-images-e883ef74736e016315417c758ab17093>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-01-07-2-2"></a>

Context: 2025 California wildfires / January 2025 Southern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** An exceptional Santa Ana wind event reaching hurricane-force in some locations in southern California, United States, cause multiple power outages and wildfire outbreaks, including a rapidly-spreading &gt;2,900 acre wildfire in Los Angeles County which causes several burn injuries and forces 30,000 people to evacuate.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/07/weather/california-windstorm-fire-los-angeles-climate/index.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/wildfires/live-blog/live-updates-pacific-palisades-wildfire-rapidly-grows-california-rcna186685>).

Context: 2025 Tibet earthquake.

**Archived source account.** At least 126 people are killed and dozens of others are injured when a magnitude 7.1 Mw (6.8 Ms) earthquake strikes Tingri County, Shigatse, Tibet Autonomous Region, China.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/7/earthquake-hits-tibets-shigatse-city-tremors-felt-in-nepals-kathmandu>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/china-nepal-tibet-earthquake-himalayas-ca21bd4848209370b9eebcaf107208df>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A light aircraft crashes near Rottnest Island, Western Australia, killing the pilot and two tourists from Denmark and Switzerland while injuring three other passengers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/swiss-danish-tourists-among-three-dead-australian-plane-crash-2025-01-08/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirteen Cuban soldiers go missing after explosions at an arms and ammunition depot in Holguín Province.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/08/americas/cuban-soldiers-missing-explosion-ammo-depot-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-01-07-3-1"></a>

Context: HMPV outbreak in East Asia.

**Archived source account.** India confirms their first cases of the human metapneumovirus disease.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hmpv-human-metapneumovirus-india-cases-confirmed-symptoms/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-01-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Denmark–United States relations, Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland, Panama–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president-elect Donald Trump refuses to rule out using military force to take control of Greenland and the Panama Canal, declaring U.S. control of both to be "vital to American national security".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/trump-biden-offshore-drilling-gulf-of-america-fa66f8d072eb39c00a8128a8941ede75>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-4-2"></a>

Context: Denmark–United States relations, Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland, Panama–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Trump's son Donald Trump Jr. makes a personal visit to Greenland weeks after Trump announced that "ownership and control of Greenland is an absolute necessity". In response to the visit, Danish prime minister Mette Frederiksen states that "Greenland belongs to the Greenlanders".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yv10knyd9o>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-4-3"></a>

Context: Denmark–United States relations, Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland, Panama–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Panamanian foreign minister Javier Martínez-Acha asserts that only Panamanians operate the Panama Canal and that its sovereignty is non-negotiable, dismissing Trump's claims that China operates the canal and his suggestion of potential U.S. military action to regain control.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/panama-tells-trump-canal-sovereignty-is-non-negotiable/a-71243119>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-4-5"></a>

Context: Hungary–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Treasury imposes sanctions on Hungarian cabinet minister Antal Rogán for alleged corruption, accusing him of using his position to secure financial benefits for himself and political allies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-imposes-sanctions-senior-hungarian-official-suspected-corruption-2025-01-07/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-07-4-7"></a>

Context: Sudan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States accuses the Rapid Support Forces of committing genocide in Sudan during the ongoing civil war and imposes sanctions on the group's leader Hemedti.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/biden-sudan-genocide-7a0d20f857af3fd428750cf2dfd231ae>).

### 2025-01-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1272914063](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20January%208&oldid=1272914063>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency / 2025 N'Djamena attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunfire and military vehicles are reported near the Presidential Palace in N'Djamena, Chad, with the Chadian government accusing Boko Haram of being behind the attack. **Archived source account.** A general strike by Belgian unions to protest against government plans for pension reform occurs, with the work stoppages severely disrupting public transport in Brussels as well as rail and air travel throughout the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/belgian-transport-faces-severe-disruption-monday-by-national-strike/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-01-13-2-2"></a>

Context: 2025 California wildfires / January 2025 Southern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** AccuWeather releases a preliminary estimate of the total physical and economic losses caused by the ongoing wildfires in Southern California of between $250–275 billion, a figure attributed to exceptionally high property values in and near Santa Monica, which would surpass their estimates of the costs of the entire 2020 United States wildfire season as well as Hurricane Helene in 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/wildfires/live-blog/california-wildfires-live-updates-santa-ana-winds-continue-rcna187351>).

<a id="event-2025-01-13-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed and many others are missing in a landslide in Hpakant, Kachin State, Myanmar.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-jade-mine-landslide-e39761fcf484acf3ecc53576d3810692>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-01-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan attorney general Tarek Saab asks for an arrest warrant and a red notice from Interpol against opposition figure Leopoldo López, who is currently in exile. Venezuela accuses López of instigating the use of arms against the state and treason, among other charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-ag-requests-warrant-interpol-notice-against-opposition-figure-living-2025-01-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-13-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judge in Peru dismisses charges of money laundering against Popular Force leader and former presidential candidate Keiko Fujimori.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-judge-throws-out-keiko-fujimoris-money-laundering-trial-2025-01-13/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-01-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Impeachment of Sara Duterte.

**Archived source account.** Members of the Iglesia ni Cristo hold a nationwide National Rally for Peace in the Philippines to express their disapproval of impeachment efforts against Vice President Sara Duterte.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/philippines/photos-iglesia-ni-cristo-national-rally-peace-january-13-2025/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** International Court of Justice President Nawaf Salam becomes the prime minister-designate of Lebanon after winning an absolute majority of votes from parliament, while stepping down from the ICJ.

Source citations (as archived): [TVN24](<https://tvn24.pl/swiat/liban-prezes-mts-nawaf-salam-otrzymal-misje-tworzenia-rzadu-st8259027>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/13/middleeast/icj-judge-nawaf-salam-lebanon-prime-minister-intl/index.html>).

### 2025-01-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1317390166](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20January%2014&oldid=1317390166>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-14-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza war hostage crisis, Calls for a ceasefire during the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Hamas officials say that they have accepted a draft agreement for a potential ceasefire as well as the release of hostages. Mediators in the United States and Qatar also state that this is the closest that both sides have been to a ceasefire agreement so far.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-01-14-2025-a1495c0f4f13102903ce31a862c49baa>).

<a id="event-2025-01-14-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli incursions in the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** Four Al-Qassam Brigades militants and two civilians are killed during an Israeli airstrike in Jenin, in the occupied West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/1/15/live-israel-launches-fierce-strikes-on-gaza-as-ceasefire-deal-moves-closer?update=3442835>).

<a id="event-2025-01-14-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine strikes targets in the Republic of Tatarstan and Bryansk, Saratov, and Tula oblasts, Russia, with more than 200 drones and five ATACMS ballistic missiles, hitting ammunition depots, industrial plants and a refinery, in what Ukraine says is its "most massive" and "deepest" attack inside Russia so far.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/14/europe/ukraine-russia-drone-missile-attack-intl-hnk/index.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwypg2z780go>).

<a id="event-2025-01-14-0-9"></a>

Context: North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** North Korea launches multiple short-range ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korea-fires-missile-off-east-coast-says-south-korea-military-2025-01-14/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-14-0-11"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** Yemen's Houthi forces fire a missile at Israel, triggering sirens in several areas, including Tel Aviv and some Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. According to the Israeli military, the missile was "likely intercepted" with no injuries reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20250114/7d596dc7d5e6418683867e53dbecb391/c.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-outbreak-marburg-virus-kills-eight-tanzania-who-says-2025-01-15/>).

### 2025-01-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1317390179](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20January%2015&oldid=1317390179>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency / Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** Allied Democratic Forces militants kill ten people in an attack on a village in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-islamic-rebel-attack-adf-kivu-makoko-faae44fe327d54ca619acd7c3fb30104>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** Israel and Hamas reach a diplomatic agreement mediated by Egypt, Qatar, and the U.S. to initiate a ceasefire and an end to military operations in the Gaza Strip, as well as to facilitate the exchange of hostages and prisoners, marking the first major cessation of hostilities since November 2023.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hamas-gaza-ceasefire-hostages-01-15-24/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force strikes a Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) vehicle convoy in Quneitra Governorate, Syria, killing two HTS personnel and the mayor of a local village. It is the first time that Israel has targeted HTS forces since the fall of the Assad regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/01/15/first-israel-strike-on-new-syria-security-forces-kills-3-medical-source-monitor>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-0-11"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches a major ballistic and cruise missile attack on regions across Ukraine, targeting energy production and compelling authorities to shut down the power grid.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-massive-attack-power-cuts-2dc7a30e36c9eca3e874476374c21eba>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-0-13"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** Yemen's Houthi movement claims that it launched a missile attack targeting the USS Harry S. Truman aircraft carrier and accompanying warships of the United States Navy in the Red Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/yemen-s-houthis-claim-missile-drone-attack-on-us-aircraft-carrier-in-red-sea/3451441>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-01-15-1-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Istanbul alcohol poisonings.

**Archived source account.** Bootleg alcohol kills 37 people and leaves 80 others hospitalized over the last 48 hours in Istanbul, Turkey. Turkish health officials say many of those in hospital are in intensive care.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/bootleg-alcohol-claims-lives-30-people-istanbul-dozens-117746365>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-1-3"></a>

Context: Stilfontein mine deaths.

**Archived source account.** Seventy-eight bodies of workers are retrieved from a closed illegal gold mine in Stilfontein, North West Province, South Africa following a months-long siege by police. Over 200 survivors are arrested as they exit the mine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/body-count-south-african-mine-rescue-operation-rises-60-2025-01-15/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-01-15-2-0"></a>

Context: Poland–Russia relations.

<a id="event-2025-01-15-4-2"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis / Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol.

**Archived source account.** Anti-corruption officials and police attempt to breach the residence of impeached South Korean president Yoon Suk Yeol for a second time in order to execute an arrest warrant, while facing resistance from the Presidential Security Service, People Power Party lawmakers, and pro-Yoon protesters. Following a five-hour standoff, Yoon is arrested, becoming South Korea's first sitting president to be arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250115005200004?rec_id=1736900123005&amp;site=recommendation_view>); [Yonhap 2](<https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250115069851001>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-yoon-martial-law-detain-8dd7f03661be39729741de9a3b5d1714>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-4-4"></a>

Context: 2024–2025 Georgian protests.

**Archived source account.** A general strike takes place in Georgia with hundreds of Georgian firms urging the government to release all political prisoners and hold new elections amid nationwide protests. Former Prime Minister and opposition leader Giorgi Gakharia is hospitalized after being assaulted, allegedly by members of the ruling Georgian Dream party.

Context: 2024–2025 Mozambican protests.

**Archived source account.** Daniel Chapo is sworn in as President of Mozambique, succeeding Filipe Nyusi. The inauguration takes place amid ongoing political unrest in Mozambique, with opposition leader Venâncio Mondlane continuing to insist that the October 2024 election was rigged. Since then, over 300 people have died in clashes with Police.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250115-mozambique-inaugurates-president-elect-daniel-chapo-amid-deadly-unrest>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mozambique-president-sworn-post-election-protest-deaths-rise-2025-01-15/>).

**Archived source account.** Maria Benvinda Levy is appointed Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Club of Mozambique](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-president-names-former-justice-minister-as-prime-minister-274141/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-15-5-5"></a>

Context: Exploration of the Moon, Commercial Lunar Payload Services.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-01-16-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** Blue Origin launches its New Glenn rocket for the first time from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, United States. The rocket's second stage, carrying a prototype Blue Ring spacecraft, successfully reaches a geocentric orbit, but its reusable first stage is lost during landing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/16/science/new-glenn-launch-blue-origin/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-16-5-2"></a>

Context: 2025 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** The twin satellites SDX01 and SDX02 of the SpaDeX mission, launched in December by the Indian Space Research Organisation, successfully conduct India's first spacecraft docking, with India becoming the fourth country to successfully dock a spacecraft after the United States, Russia, and China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8j89k02py0o>).

<a id="event-2025-01-16-5-3"></a>

Context: 2025 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX launches its seventh test flight of the Starship launch vehicle, with an improved second stage, at Starbase in Texas, United States. The first stage is successfully caught by the launch tower but the second stage breaks up shortly before engine shutdown.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2025/01/16/spacex-launch-starship-flight-seven-starlink-satellite-test.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-16-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nintendo officially reveals the Nintendo Switch 2 video game console, the successor to the Nintendo Switch.

Source citations (as archived): [Nintendo](<https://www.nintendo.com/us/whatsnew/nintendo-switch-2-to-be-released-in-2025/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-01-16-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 in sumo.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after withdrawing from the January 2025 Grand Sumo Tournament due to injuries, the 73rd yokozuna Terunofuji Haruo announces his retirement. If no other wrestler is promoted this tournament, his retirement leaves sumo without a yokozuna for the first time since 1993. Terunofuji also announced his intention to remain in the Japan Sumo Association as an oyakata.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2025/01/14bd63c63a6b-sumo-lone-yokozuna-terunofuji-pulls-out-of-new-year-meet.html>); [Nikkan Sports](<https://www.nikkansports.com/battle/sumo/news/202501160000520.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-01-20-2-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack / Pardon of January 6 United States Capitol attack defendants.

**Archived source account.** United States President Donald Trump formally pardons around 1,500 defendants who had been criminally charged with involvement in the January 6 attack on the United States Capitol. Fourteen convicted individuals have their sentences commuted to time served.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/trump-set-pardon-defendants-stormed-capitol-jan-6-2021-rcna187735>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-2-4"></a>

Context: 2024 Kolkata rape and murder.

**Archived source account.** A court in Kolkata, India, sentences a 33-year-old police volunteer to life in prison for raping and murdering a medical trainee in August 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-man-jailed-for-life-in-doctor-rape-murder-case/a-71346298>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-2-6"></a>

Context: 2024 Southport stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Axel Rudakubana pleads guilty to all 16 charges, including three charges of murder in relation to a mass stabbing in Southport, Merseyside, England, in July 2024. Rudakubana is expected to be sentenced on Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV News](<https://www.itv.com/news/granada/2025-01-20/rudakubana-changes-pleas-to-guilty-on-first-day-of-trial-for-southport-attack>).

**Archived source account.** China executes the perpetrators of the 2024 Zhuhai car attack and the 2024 Wuxi stabbing attack.

<a id="event-2025-01-20-2-10"></a>

Context: China–Philippines relations.

**Archived source account.** Philippine police arrest a student of the People's Liberation Army for allegedly attempting to spy on several military facilities, including U.S.-accessible bases under the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-arrests-chinese-national-suspicion-espionage-2025-01-20/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-2-12"></a>

Context: Presidency of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** Outgoing U.S. President Joe Biden announces pre-emptive pardons for his siblings, former Chief Medical Advisor Anthony Fauci, former Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Mark Milley and members of the House Select Committee on the January 6 Attack prior to President-elect Donald Trump's inauguration. Biden also commutes the sentence of Indigenous activist and convicted murderer Leonard Peltier.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2025/01/20/biden-pardons-fauci-milley-jan-6-committee-00199244>); [HuffPost](<https://www.huffpost.com/entry/joe-biden-leonard-peltier-clemency_n_67608b04e4b0d06419ec6367>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-2-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and seven others are injured in an arson attack at a nursing home in Barajevo, Belgrade, Serbia.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-2"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Second inauguration of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump and JD Vance are inaugurated as the 47th president and 50th vice president of the United States in Washington, D.C., with Trump becoming the first president since Grover Cleveland to serve non-consecutive terms.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/live/trump-inauguration-updates>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-3"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Second inauguration of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The inauguration is held indoors in the United States Capitol rotunda due to extreme cold temperatures, making it the first inauguration since 1985 to be held indoors.

Source citations (as archived): [Today.com](<https://www.today.com/news/politics/donald-trump-2025-indoor-inauguration-weather-rcna188400>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-4"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Second inauguration of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** During celebrations of the inauguration, businessman Elon Musk makes two gestures to a crowd at the Capital One Arena that some on social media liken to Nazi salutes. The gestures were made as Musk thanked the crowd, stating "My heart goes out to you." Musk denied any meaning behind the gestures.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy48v1x4dv4o>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/elon-musk-salute-trump-inauguration-b2683095.html>); [AJ](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2025/1/21/musk-accused-of-giving-nazi-salute-during-trump-inauguration-celebrations>).

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.
