<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-8"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-9"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Trump signs executive orders calling for the renaming the Gulf of Mexico to the "Gulf of America" and for Denali to return to its former name "Mount McKinley". The rename would apply to all references from the federal government.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-rename-gulf-of-mexico-denali/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-10"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Trump declares illegal immigration a national emergency under the National Emergencies Act.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-declare-national-emergency-border-trump-official-says-2025-01-20/>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-11"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Trump officially creates the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) led by Elon Musk aimed at cutting spending of the U.S. government. DOGE is a temporary organization under the United States DOGE Service, not a federal executive department. Within minutes of the announcement, government employee unions, watchdog groups, and public interest organizations sued over this executive order.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-use-one-his-first-executive-orders-create-doge-semafor-reports-2025-01-20/>).

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Trump revokes Biden's removal of Cuba from the state sponsors of terrorism list.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/trump-revokes-biden-removal-cuba-us-state-sponsors-terrorism-list-2025-01-21/>).

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Protests against Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/gallery/2025/jan/20/anti-trump-protests-photos>).

<a id="event-2025-01-20-3-17"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Second cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate unanimously confirms Marco Rubio as Secretary of State, making him the first Cabinet official of Trump's second term to be confirmed by the Senate. Rubio also becomes the first Latino American to serve as Secretary of State.

### 2025-01-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb explosion inside a house in San Juan de Arama, Meta Department, Colombia, kills one person. Authorities confirm that the car was going to be used in an attack and the perpetrator was a member of the Estado Mayor Central.

Source citations (as archived): [El Tiempo](<https://www.eltiempo.com/colombia/otras-ciudades/alerta-en-meta-por-explosion-de-carro-bomba-que-se-activo-cuando-terrorista-lo-manipulaba-quien-esta-detras-3420193>).

Context: Moro conflict.

<a id="event-2025-01-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Constitutional crisis in Somalia, Transport in Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/union-investigates-claims-that-boeing-is-sending-work-non-union-locations-2025-01-23/>).

Context: Antioch High School shooting.

**Archived source account.** A student is killed and two others are wounded in a school shooting at Antioch High School in Nashville, Tennessee, United States. The perpetrator kills himself.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/22/us/antioch-high-school-shooting-nashville/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-01-22-4-8"></a>

Context: Illegal immigration in the United States, Murder of Laken Riley.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Congress passes the Laken Riley Act following a 263–156 vote in the House of Representatives, making it easier for immigration agents to detain and deport those without legal status who are charged with a variety of crimes ranging from theft to assault. It will head to President Donald Trump for his signature.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/01/22/nx-s1-5253926/congress-laken-riley-act>).

<a id="event-2025-01-22-4-10"></a>

Context: Hunt family murders.

**Archived source account.** Kyle Clifford, the perpetrator of the Hunt family killings in Bushey, England, in 2024, pleads guilty to three counts of murder.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy8pd7dn8v6o>).

<a id="event-2025-01-22-4-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and two others are injured in a mass stabbing at Nagano Station in Nagano, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/japan-nagano-stabbing-train-station-524044f684df1c62cbf2036bee7bfdcd>).

<a id="event-2025-01-25-5-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Australian Open.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** On January 26, Katerina Siniakova and Taylor Townsend won the Australian Open women's doubles final against Hsieh Su-wei and Jelena Ostapenko, 6-2, 6-7 (4-7), 6-3.

Editorial date: 2025-01-26. Checked: 2026-10-21. Calendar correction: this final belongs to January 26. The original January 25 placement remains archived.

Evidence: [Australian Open](<https://ausopen.com/articles/news/townsend-returns-rod-laver-take-doubles-title-siniakova>).

Original source account: Kateřina Siniaková and Taylor Townsend defeats Hsieh Su-wei and Jeļena Ostapenko 6–2, 6–7 (4–7), 6–3, to win the women's doubles final title.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-01-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 offensive / 2025 Goma offensive.

**Archived source account.** M23 rebels solidify control of Goma, North Kivu Province, and are confirmed to be holding captured Congolese troops and allied Wazalendo militants at the Stade de l'Unité. They also begin advancing on Bukavu, capital of the South Kivu Province, according to senior Congolese officials and a Rwandan diplomat.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/1/29/dr-congo-live-news-rwanda-backed-m23-rebels-tighten-grip-on-goma>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rwandas-kagame-says-he-agrees-with-us-need-ceasefire-congo-2025-01-29/>).

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 offensive / 2025 Goma offensive.

**Archived source account.** In an emergency address to the nation, Congolese president Félix Tshisekedi calls for calm and says "a vigorous and coordinated response against these terrorists and their sponsors is underway" by the armed forces, and also cancels participation in a regional summit with Rwandan president Paul Kagame.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Policy](<https://foreignpolicy.com/2025/01/29/congo-rwanda-m23-rebels-goma-tshisekedi-kagame/>); [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/01/30/dr-congo-president-says-army-mounting-vigorous-response-to-m23-advance_6737579_4.html>).

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 offensive.

**Archived source account.** Around 280 Romanian mercenaries fighting alongside the Congolese military in North Kivu surrender to the M23, according to the Rwandan military. They are now being transported to Kigali after being handed over to Rwandan authorities.

<a id="event-2025-01-29-0-9"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / War in Somalia / Islamic State insurgency in Puntland.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jan/200008/puntland_deports_hundreds_of_undocumented_ethiopians_over_isis_recruitment_concerns.aspx>); [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-oo-dib-ugu-celisay-dalkooda-boqolaal-itoobiyaan-ah/>); [Horseed Media](<https://horseedmedia.net/puntland-oo-masaafurisay-boqolaal-ajaaniib-ah-oo-sharci-darro-ku-joogay-deegaanadeeda/399908/>).

Context: Moldova–European Union relations / 2025 Moldovan energy crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Union and Moldova sign an energy deal that will integrate Moldova into the bloc's energy grid after Russia halted gas supplies over an alleged US$709 million unpaid bill. The European Commission says Moldova will receive €250 million ($258 million) this year to help its citizens afford rising energy bills as part of the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/eu-moldova-energy-russia-cuts-gazprom-3657d8204486044384a4b1a3b8105446>).

<a id="event-2025-02-04-3-5"></a>

Context: Second Trump tariffs / China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** The United States implements a 10% across-the-board tariff on Chinese products and eliminates the de minimis exemption for exports from China. In response, China imposes retaliatory tariffs on energy products, agricultural equipment, and automobiles from the United States, effective February 10, and export controls on critical minerals. It also adds U.S. companies PVH Corp. and Illumina Inc to its unreliable entities list and launches a probe into U.S. technology company Google for alleged anti-trust violations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/feb/04/trump-china-tariffs>).

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-apparent-suicide-blast-targets-ministry-complex/a-71591784>).

<a id="event-2025-02-13-2-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Sixth Fleet Public Affairs](<https://www.c6f.navy.mil/Press-Room/News/Article/4065260/uss-harry-s-truman-involved-in-collision-at-sea/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-13-2-6"></a>

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-13-3-1"></a>

Context: International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Israeli leaders.

**Archived source account.** The United States Treasury Department sanctions Karim Ahmad Khan, the top prosecutor at the International Criminal Court, over his decision to investigate Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Yoav Gallant regarding their conduct during the Gaza war.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Treasury Department](<https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions/20250213>).

Context: Investigations into the Eric Adams administration.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/13/politics/danielle-sassoon-eric-adams-us-attorney/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Royal Thai Army announces that 260 foreigners have been rescued from online scam centers in Myanmar near the two countries' border, where they were trafficked to and forced to work in.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-scam-centers-thailand-army-myawaddy-trafficking-853f556f08a2bacb3991589fc8ab3588>).

<a id="event-2025-02-13-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A van carrying members of the Union of Indigenous Communities of the Isthmus Region is ambushed near Río del Sol, in the limits of the municipalities of Santo Domingo Petapa and San Juan Mazatlán, leaving three local activists dead. The attack happened during the escalation of a local agrarian conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Revista Proceso](<https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/estados/2025/2/13/emboscada-deja-muertos-en-los-limites-de-santo-domingo-petapa-san-juan-mazatlan-oaxaca-345581.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Second cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is confirmed as the U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services by a Senate vote of 52–48.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/shots-health-news/2025/02/13/nx-s1-5294591/rfk-jr-trump-health-human-services-hhs-vaccines>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

<a id="event-2025-02-14-0-4"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

<a id="event-2025-02-14-0-5"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

<a id="event-2025-02-14-0-10"></a>

### 2025-02-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1317390404](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2015&oldid=1317390404>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

**Archived source account.** Mass looting and sporadic gunfire is reported in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as M23 rebels advance into the city. Mobs loot several facilities, including a World Food Programme depot.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1m5dppk5xmo>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-0-4"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Congolese military withdraws from Bukavu heading south towards Tanganyika Province.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-fighting-bukavu-m23-rwanda-9092314a99030530e43ba73bd332af50>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / Ituri conflict.

**Archived source account.** General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, Chief of the Ugandan military, claiming to act with the authority of his father, President Yoweri Museveni, threatens to invade the Democratic Republic of the Congo and take control of Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, unless local forces surrender their weapons within 24 hours. Kainerugaba alleges that the Hema people are being killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-military-chief-threatens-attack-eastern-congo-town-bunia-2025-02-15/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** Hamas releases three Israeli hostages in exchange for the Israeli government releasing 369 Palestinian prisoners, most without criminal charges or convictions, as part of the first stage of the 2025 ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/15/israeli-captives-story>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-ceasefire-hostages-02-15-2025-22a2d731961eb766e6c7914cb84e3990>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-0-11"></a>

Context: 2025 Munich car attack.

**Archived source account.** A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old child die as a result of injuries sustained in a vehicle-ramming attack in Munich, Germany, on Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [Stern](<https://www.stern.de/panorama/verbrechen/muenchen--kind-und-frau-nach-anschlag-mit-auto-gestorben-35470484.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-0-13"></a>

Context: 2025 Villach stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** A 14-year-old boy is killed and five other people are injured in a mass stabbing on a street in Villach, Carinthia, Austria. A 23-year-old man, an Islamic State member, is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/austria-stabbings-4913f6921c6f27e6d7fd8590da85cc9f>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/austria-stabbing-islamist-attack-interior-minister-says/a-71629831>).

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict.

#### Disasters and accidents

Context: 2025 New Delhi railway station stampede.

**Archived source account.** At least 49 people are killed and several others are injured when a gold mine collapses in Kéniéba, Mali.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio speak by telephone about the Russo-Ukrainian War, the Gaza war, the sanctions against Russia, and removing restrictions on each country's diplomatic missions. They also discuss preparations for a high-level summit in Saudi Arabia. This is the first time the U.S. and Russia had contact at the foreign minister level in almost two years.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/25c3bcf6-9da7-4c46-9054-d4a0778356c3>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-3-3"></a>

Context: South Africa–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of White South Africans hold a protest outside the U.S. embassy in Pretoria, South Africa, in support of U.S. President Donald Trump's claims that the South African government is discriminating against the country's white minority.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/trump-south-africa-white-afrikaners-b41aa729360af4d1d090ea1ac1e22cce>).

<a id="event-2025-02-15-3-5"></a>

Context: Weimar+.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron announces an emergency summit in Paris, France, between European leaders following a controversial speech given by U.S. Vice President JD Vance at the Munich Security Conference in which he criticized European leadership as the worst threat to Europe, particularly for imposing too much censorship and too little control over migration.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3960538-macron-invites-european-leaders-to-paris.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c04nw1pg3k2o>); [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/at-munich-conference-us-vp-vance-warns-european-allies-of-threat-from-within-/7975270.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/15/un-commander-injured-as-lebanese-protesters-torch-car-near-beirut-airport>).

Context: 2025 African Union Commission Chairperson election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/african-union-commission-new-leader-djibouti-4441f23a6e8861b5efd4bb3653a40a6d>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/djiboutis-foreign-minister-elected-top-african-union-post-2025-02-15/>).

### 2025-02-16

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

**Archived source account.** Local officials and residents report that Rwanda-backed M23 forces have taken over the center of Bukavu, the capital of South Kivu in eastern DR Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/16/dr-congos-m23-rebels-enter-centre-of-strategic-city-bukavu-report>).

<a id="event-2025-02-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo acknowledges the fall of Bukavu to M23 rebels and urges its roughly two million residents to shelter in place.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0rqr8q5v52o>).

<a id="event-2025-02-16-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Mykolaiv strikes, Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches drone strikes across Ukraine, injuring at least one person and damaging a thermal power station in Mykolaiv, leaving 46,000 people without heat. Ukraine says that it shot down 95 of 143 drones while disrupting 46 others by electronic countermeasures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-overnight-attacks-injure-one-damage-infrastructure-houses-ukraine-2025-02-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-16-0-9"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war, Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military announces that the Yemen Coast Guard had successfully intercepted an Iranian weapons shipment on its way to the Houthi movement in Yemen on 12 February.

Source citations (as archived): [i24 News](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/the-gulf/artc-yemeni-gov-t-intercepts-iranian-weapons-sent-to-houthis>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-02-16-1-1"></a>

Context: 78th British Academy Film Awards.

**Archived source account.** The BAFTAs are held at the Royal Festival Hall in London, England. The Brutalist and Conclave win the most awards, with four each, while the latter also wins Best Film.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/movies/story/2025-02-16/2025-bafta-awards-winners-list-best-moments>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio leads a delegation that includes National Security Advisor Mike Waltz and Special Envoy Steve Witkoff to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for initial talks with Russia. A Russian source reports that the meeting will occur on 18 February and that the Russian delegation is expected to include Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, Presidential Aide Yuri Ushakov, and SVR Director Sergey Naryshkin.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-trump-talks-negotiations-saudi-51b77cdf699f13ad16cb00bbf371b840>); [Kommersant](<https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/7513890?from=top_main_1>).

**Archived source account.** Amidst heightened tensions between the two nations, the Canadian men's ice hockey team defeats the United States team 3–2 in overtime in the final of the 4 Nations Face-Off, with Connor McDavid scoring the winning goal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce8ydg04xezo>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/02/21/g-s1-50085/canada-united-states-hockey-four-nations-face-off-connor-mcdavid-51st-state>).

### 2025-02-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1317390438](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2021&oldid=1317390438>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire, Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Israel says that forensic testing revealed one of the bodies returned by Hamas yesterday does not match with Shiri Bibas nor with any other hostages. Her sons Ariel and Kfir, as well as Oded Lifshitz, were all positively identified. Israel accuses Hamas of violating the ceasefire and demands the return of her body along with the other remaining hostages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjry3jzedl1o>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire, Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hamas claims that Shiri's body was "mistakenly mixed" with others who were killed and buried under the rubble in Gaza, and returns an additional body the group says is hers. The identity is soon afterwards positively confirmed by Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/02/21/hamas-says-shiri-bibas-remains-mixed-with-other-human-remains-after-israeli-airstrike>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjw20d3l4jpo>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-02-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2025 United States federal mass layoffs.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Defense announces it will jointly lay off 4,500 probationary workers, cutting 5-8% of the civilian workforce. The United States Forest Service also announces it will lay off 2,000 employees.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pentagon-job-cuts-trump-doge-31e3ed62f5f35a5e5a4a07fd8708232f>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Financial Action Task Force removes the Philippines from its grey list and adds Laos and Nepal to the list.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/fatf-global-financial-crime-watchdog-removes-philippines-grey-list-2025-02-21/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-02-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Real Plaza Trujillo collapse.

**Archived source account.** At least 6 people are killed and 79 others are injured after a roof collapses at the Real Plaza Trujillo shopping mall in Trujillo, Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/2025/02/22/shopping-centre-roof-collapses-killing-least-3-including-child-injuring-79-22606215/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed and twenty-one others were injured in a bus crash in São Paulo, Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/latin-america/twelve-university-students-killed-in-brazil-bus-crash-officials-18267535/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-02-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Sudan orders the closure of all schools in the country for two weeks due to a heat wave, with temperatures expected to reach 42 C.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/heat-wave-forces-south-sudan-to-close-schools-for-two-weeks/a-71698826>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A norovirus outbreak with a large number of ill passengers is reported on the MS Iona cruise ship in Belgium.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/2025/02/21/cruise-passengers-dropping-like-flies-norovirus-outbreak-22605507/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-21-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Gaza war ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** Egypt, Jordan, and the countries of the Gulf Cooperation Council meet in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to address possible future developments in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/arab-leaders-gather-in-saudi-arabia-to-hash-out-alternative-to-trumps-plan-for-gaza/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan relations.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan sign an agreement to delimitate their border, solving a decades-old border dispute that had sparked clashes between different ethnic groups that had killed over a hundred people.

Source citations (as archived): [Trend News Agency](<https://en.trend.az/casia/kyrgyzstan/4008880.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-settle-border-dispute-that-sparked-deadly-clashes-2025-02-21/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-02-21-5-2"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis / Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol.

**Archived source account.** South Korean police file a case against impeached president Yoon Suk Yeol for obstructing his arrest warrant.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-police-say-building-case-against-yoon-obstructing-arrest-2025-02-21/>).

Context: Berlin Holocaust memorial stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A 30-year-old Spanish tourist is seriously injured in a stabbing attack at the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe in Berlin, Germany. A 19-year-old Syrian man is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-berlin-stabbing-holocaust-memorial-1710be90a0e733d016e32db4d8353e1c>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/suspect-in-berlin-stabbing-wanted-to-kill-jews-police/a-71712971>).

Context: Flint water crisis.

**Archived source account.** Veolia Water agrees to pay $53 million in settlement for all remaining active class action lawsuits for the contamination of drinking water in Flint, Michigan, United States, but refuses to acknowledge any fault in the crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/flint-water-settlement-lead-3cadd9eb6ffbd699159c992de9cdbc27>); [WNEM](<https://www.wnem.com/2025/02/21/53m-civil-settlement-reached-flint-water-crisis-lawsuit/>).

Context: Stabbing of Salman Rushdie.

**Archived source account.** Hadi Matar is found guilty by a U.S. jury of attempted murder and assault for his stabbing attack on author Salman Rushdie in 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/salman-rushdie-stabbing-suspect-found-guilty-attempted-murder/story?id=118903519>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-5-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed in a shooting outside of a motor vehicle office in Louisville, Kentucky, United States.

<a id="event-2025-02-21-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people, including two police officers, are killed during a traffic stop in Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/22/us/virginia-beach-police-shooting.html?searchResultPosition=1>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Federal Court of Brazil orders the suspension of online video platform Rumble for refusing to comply to court orders and for refusing to remove the account of Brazilian fugitive Allan dos Santos.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-supreme-court-rumble-blocked-c45ab801d5bb23e6d9b2271bdcf7426e>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-02-21-6-1"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth announces the removal of multiple senior U.S. officers from their current roles, including the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Charles Q. Brown Jr. and the Chief of Naval Operations Lisa Franchetti.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/21/politics/trump-fires-top-us-general-cq-brown/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-6-2"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** American news agency The Associated Press files a lawsuit for freedom of speech against three Trump administration officials after they banned the news agency from attending presidential press events after the agency refused to refer to the Gulf of Mexico as the "Gulf of America".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ap-lawsuit-trump-administration-officials-0352075501b779b8b187667f3427e0e8>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/02/21/nx-s1-5305226/ap-sues-white-house-gulf-of-america-mexico-trump>).

<a id="event-2025-02-21-6-4"></a>

Context: Indonesia Gelap.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrations continue against the government in several cities in Indonesia. Nine students have been arrested and two are injured, along with four injured policemen and two parliament members.

Source citations (as archived): [Tempo](<https://en.tempo.co/read/1978141/police-deploy-2460-joint-personnel-for-indonesia-gelap-protest-in-jakarta-today>); [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/thousands-protest-against-budget-cuts-in-indonesia-5ac272a2>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-02-21-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency announces that the chances of asteroid 2024 YR4 impacting Earth in 2032 has decreased to 1.5% (1-in-67), and is likely to decrease further to less than 1%.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-00552-y>).

### 2025-02-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire, Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hamas releases six living hostages, including pre-war hostages Avera Mengistu and Hisham al-Sayed, both captive for more than nine years.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/these-are-the-six-living-hostages-set-to-be-released-saturday/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire, Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu orders the delay of the release of 620 Palestinian prisoners indefinitely, citing the "humiliating" procedure of the hostages' release.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-ceasefire-hostages-02-22-2025-364c7abeb679e910cb5acba234469574>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/live-blog/israel-hamas-ceasefire-live-updates-rcna193120>).

<a id="event-2025-02-22-0-6"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe / 2025 Mulhouse stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** A 69-year-old Portuguese Lino Sousa Loureiro is killed and seven other people are injured in a mass stabbing attack by a 37-year-old Algerian man at a market in Mulhouse, France. The stabbing is being treated as a suspected Islamic terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/france-stabbing-islamic-extremism-mulhouse-f360a94b520b199cdd7f389e6ff5e01c>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/22/europe/mulhouse-attack-intl-latam/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-22-0-9"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / 2025 Bukavu offensive.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Congolese police officers join the M23 movement in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the rebel group consolidates its control of the city. Around 1,800 police officers have surrendered their weapons to the new authorities, according to the Congo River Alliance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/hundreds-congolese-police-join-rebels-occupied-city-2025-02-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-22-0-12"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war / Operation Prosperity Guardian.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces launch surface-to-air missiles at a U.S. fighter jet and MQ-9 Reaper drone over the Red Sea for the first time with both missiles missing their target.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemens-houthis-launched-missile-us-fighter-jet-missed-2025-02-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-22-0-14"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** The Tuareg independence movement accuses Malian soldiers and Wagner Group mercenaries of killing 24 civilians, which constitutes a war crime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/22/malis-army-says-investigating-soldiers-accused-of-killing-24-civilians>).

Context: 75th Berlin International Film Festival.

**Archived source account.** Norwegian drama film Dreams (Sex Love) wins the Golden Bear award at the 2025 Berlin International Film Festival, while Tilda Swinton is awarded the Honorary Golden Bear for her range and legacy.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/coming-of-age-film-from-norway-wins-berlinales-golden-bear/a-71716079>); [Berlinale](<https://www.berlinale.de/en/festival/awards-and-juries/honorary-golden-bear.html>).

### 2025-02-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1278219955](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2023&oldid=1278219955>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Israeli occupation of the West Bank / 2025 Israeli operation in the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces deploy tanks into the West Bank for the first time since 2002, declaring that the 40,000 Palestinians who fled refugee camps in the region cannot return.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-ceasefire-hostages-02-23-2025-1c2dc86afd2e05888d5d588f462e898b>); [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/amid-growing-crackdown-israeli-tanks-enter-occupied-west-bank-for-the-first-time-since-2002>).

<a id="event-2025-02-23-0-7"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Islamic State insurgency in Puntland / Puntland counter-terrorism operations.

**Archived source account.** At least three IS–Somalia fighters are killed in a joint Puntland armed forces–U.S. Africa Command airstrike targeting IS militants hiding in the Cal Miskaad mountains of the Bari Region of Puntland, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Horseed Media](<https://horseedmedia.net/ciidamada-puntland-oo-raadadkii-duqaymaha-ugu-tegey-curaar-oo-ay-maanta-qabsadeen/401255/>); [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200376/somali_u_s_forces_conduct_airstrike_on_isis_hideout_in_puntland.aspx>).

<a id="event-2025-02-23-0-9"></a>

Context: Australian frontier wars.

**Archived source account.** The University of Newcastle publishes the final findings of its eight-year long attempt to record and map all major massacres of Indigenous Australians during the colonisation of Australia, finding that at least 10,000 were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2025/feb/23/more-than-10000-first-nations-people-killed-in-australias-frontier-wars-final-massacre-map-shows-ntwnfb>).

<a id="event-2025-02-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Israeli invasion of Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Israel launches airstrikes in the Baalbek area in northeastern Lebanon and other areas in the south of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-hitting-hezbollah-targets-in-fresh-lebanon-airstrikes/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-23-0-13"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese Army recaptures El Geteina, White Nile State, Sudan, after heavy fighting with the Rapid Support Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article297827/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-23-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two toddlers are killed when a buried land mine from a rocket-propelled grenade that was left from the Cambodian Civil War explodes in Svay Leu District, Siem Reap province, Cambodia.

Source citations (as archived): [Shanghai Daily](<https://www.shine.cn/news/world/2502231125/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 31st Screen Actors Guild Awards.

Political thriller film Conclave wins Outstanding Ensemble Performance in a Motion Picture.

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Ukraine–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Germans vote to elect the Bundestag. The opposition CDU/CSU wins a plurality, with 28.5% of the vote and 208 seats. The governing Social Democratic Party finishes in third place with 16.4% and 120 seats, while the far-right Alternative for Germany finishes in second place with 20.8% and 152 seats.

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-02-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In cricket under the ODI format, Indian cricketer Virat Kohli becomes the first player to reach the 51 centuries and the fastest player to reach 14,000 runs.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/icc-champions-trophy-2025/champions-trophy-2025-virat-kohli-leads-the-charge-as-india-demolish-pakistan-in-one-sided-affair/articleshow/118509034.cms>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/kohli-champions-trophy-fastest-14000-runs-record-2b390d8ada093df935cca708df133563>).

### 2025-02-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355616810](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2024&oldid=1355616810>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-24-0-3"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Islamic State insurgency in Puntland / Puntland counter-terrorism operations.

**Archived source account.** Puntland forces capture key locations, including Dararmadobe, Uraar and the Four Corners of Mountains in Gaatir Oodan, which have served as command and defense bases for the Islamic State militias. Troops uncover mass graves, including the bodies of senior Middle East ISIL members killed in UAE and US airstrikes. Vehicles and motorbikes rigged with explosives were found in the Cal Miskaad mountains of Puntland's Bari Region.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/puntland/somalia-mass-graves-discovered-in-puntland-as-isis-lose-grounds>); [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200395/puntland_forces_capture_key_isis_strongholds_in_al_miskaat_mountains.aspx>).

<a id="event-2025-02-24-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The Ryazan Refinery in Ryazan, Russia, suspends operations after an overnight drone attack by Ukraine destroys the main crude distillation unit at the facility. Locals report hearing at least five explosions during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-ryazan-oil-refinery-halts-operations-after-drone-strike-sources-say-2025-02-24/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-24-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Sectarianism and minorities in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Druze militia leaders announce the formation of the Suwayda Military Council as a coalition of southern Syrian forces for promoting regional secularism and democracy. The council accuses the Syrian transitional government of committing ethnic cleansing operations and extrajudicial killings, and vows to prevent Syrian Armed Forces from entering Druze settlements.

Source citations (as archived): [El Manshar](<https://elmanshar.com/2025/02/24/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7/>); [El Manshar 2](<https://elmanshar.com/2025/02/23/%d8%aa%d8%b4%d9%83%d9%8a%d9%84-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%ac%d9%84%d8%b3-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%b3%d9%83%d8%b1%d9%8a-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%88%d9%8a%d8%af%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%af%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%b2/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-24-0-11"></a>

Context: 2020s European re-armament.

**Archived source account.** German chancellor-in-waiting Friedrich Merz declares the rapid re-militarization of Germany and Europe as a whole to be an immediate priority, in order to provide military support for Ukraine against Russia, as well as to pursue European military independence from the United States and possibly NATO.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpv4n0dg3v3o>).

<a id="event-2025-02-24-0-13"></a>

Context: Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** Three molotov cocktails are thrown at the Russian consulate in Marseille, France. No perpetrators are apprehended, but police suspect terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20250224-russia-demands-investigation-into-explosions-heard-at-marseille-consulate>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-02-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American coffeehouse chain Starbucks announces that it is cutting 1,100 jobs across its stores in the United States as part of cost reduction measures. The company also announces that its menu will be "simplified" and shrunk by 33%.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3rnq2lv1lzo>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-02-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Health in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

**Archived source account.** Over 50 people die after an unknown virus outbreak in northwestern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/an-unknown-illness-kills-over-50-people-in-part-of-congo-with-hours-between-symptoms-and-death/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-24-2-3"></a>

Context: Measles resurgence in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Department of State Health Services in Texas, United States, places several major cities in the state on high alert due to a measles outbreak that spreads to 99 people in Texas and New Mexico, the third-largest outbreak since it was considered eliminated in the U.S. in 2000.

Source citations (as archived): [Texas Public Radio](<https://www.tpr.org/public-health/2025-02-23/breaking-news-possible-measles-exposures-in-san-antonio>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/texas-measles-outbreak-symptoms-vaccine-b2703631.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly votes 93–18, with 65 abstentions, to pass a resolution condemning Russia's war against Ukraine. The 18 countries that voted against include the United States, Russia, Israel, Belarus, and North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2025/02/24/politics/us-joins-russia-ukraine-un-vote>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/02/24/g-s1-50473/un-ukraine-resolution-russia>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-02-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian eSafety Commission fines instant messaging service Telegram A$1 million (US$640,000) for delaying its response to inquiries on preventing child exploitation and extremist content.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-fines-telegram-delay-answering-child-abuse-terror-questions-2025-02-23/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-02-24-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA formally announces that asteroid 2024 YR4 now poses "no significant threat" to Earth in 2032 and beyond as the chances of an impact drop to 1-in-59,000 (0.0017%). This means a planetary defense mission to intercept and deflect the object in 2028 during a close flyby of Earth is no longer necessary.

Source citations (as archived): [NASA](<https://blogs.nasa.gov/planetarydefense/2025/02/24/latest-calculations-conclude-asteroid-2024-yr4-now-poses-no-significant-threat-to-earth-in-2032-and-beyond/>); [Ars Technica](<https://arstechnica.com/space/2025/02/asteroid-2024-yr4-may-be-a-dud-but-we-will-soon-find-many-more-threats/>).

### 2025-02-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360167320](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2025&oldid=1360167320>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign / 2025 Uvira offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Congolese military launches an attack against M23-aligned rebels around the town of Minembwe in South Kivu in an effort to recapture it, and claims to have killed four rebel commanders in a drone strike.

Source citations (as archived): [Critical Threats Project](<https://www.criticalthreats.org/briefs/congo-war-security-review/congo-war-security-review-february-25-2025>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israeli invasion of Syria.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force strikes targets throughout Southern Syria as Israel begins a military operation to "demilitarize" the southern Syrian governorates of Daraa, Suwayda and Quneitra. Syrian state media reports airstrikes near Damascus. At least two people are reportedly killed.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/israel-conducting-strikes-southern-syria/story?id=119183725>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/israel-strikes-military-targets-in-southern-syria-two-killed/articleshow/118569022.cms>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-0-8"></a>

Context: 2020s European re-armament.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom announces an increase in military spending to 2.5% of its GDP by 2027, and 3% by 2034 at the latest. The move comes just before UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer is to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday in Washington, D.C.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/25/world/europe/uk-defense-spending-starmer.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-0-10"></a>

Context: Casamance conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Senegalese government and the Movement of Democratic Forces of Casamance reach an agreement to end their 40-year conflict at talks mediated by Bissau-Guinean President Umaro Sissoco Embalo.

Source citations (as archived): [The Defense Post](<https://thedefensepost.com/2025/02/25/senegal-casamance-rebels-peace-accord/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-0-12"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed and hundreds of homes are burned down in 3R rebel attacks in Bamingui-Bangoran, Central African Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/central-african-republic-3r-attack-c463bad4ff5e119ce5b355a128f3995b>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-02-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American fabrics and handicraft supplies retail chain Jo-Ann Stores files its second bankruptcy claim and announces it will close all 800 stores in the 49 states, with liquidation sales beginning immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/02/25/nx-s1-5307907/joann-closing-stores-bankruptcy>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraq agrees to reopen the oil pipeline between Iraqi Kurdistan and Turkey after a conversation between U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shia' Al Sudani, having been closed for two years due to a dispute between Iraq and Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/rubio-iraqi-prime-minister-agree-to-reopen-iraq-turkiye-pipeline-state-department/3493471>); [The Arab Weekly](<https://thearabweekly.com/rubio-discusses-iraqi-pm-iran-energy-us-business-investments>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-02-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Chile blackout.

**Archived source account.** A nationwide power outage occurs in Chile, impacting most of the country's population and causing the temporary stoppage of several significant industries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/power-outage-hits-vast-swaths-chile-largest-copper-mine-santiago-streets-2025-02-25/>).

**Archived source account.** At least twelve people are killed by a melioidosis outbreak caused by standing waters from persistent flooding in Queensland, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyn914g249o>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four workers are killed and six others are injured when an elevated highway under construction collapses in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, South Korea.

<a id="event-2025-02-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Rwanda–United Kingdom relations, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict.

**Archived source account.** The UK government suspends financial aid and imposes economic sanctions on several high-ranking Rwandan officials over the country's military support for M23 rebels in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uk-pause-bilateral-aid-rwanda-over-congo-conflict-2025-02-25/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-02-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Thiruvananthapuram mass murder.

**Archived source account.** A man brutally beat five people, including his brother, girlfriend, to death with a hammer in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, South India.

Source citations (as archived): [gulfnews](<https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/india/kerala-horror-23-year-old-kills-six-including-girlfriend-and-brother-surrenders-to-police-1.500045264>); [Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/new-updates/kerala-mass-murder-23-year-old-man-goes-house-to-house-killing-5-including-teen-brother-and-girlfriend-shocking-details-emerge/articleshow/118573876.cms?from=mdr>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-4-3"></a>

Context: Environmental issues in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Public Prosecutor's Office files a lawsuit against mining corporation Vale S.A. and the state of Pará for mass metal poisoning that has affected the Xikrin indigenous people, whose Indigenous Territory is located in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [News-Press NOW](<https://www.newspressnow.com/news/world_news/in-brazil-mining-giant-vale-is-sued-over-metal-contamination-found-in-indigenous-peoples/article_9b5bfe1d-2832-5228-bcc6-9cf96adcb615.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-25-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian Attorney General’s Office arrests three executives of state-owned oil and gas company Pertamina on charges of corruption and fraud regarding gasoline quality that cost the government more than $11 billion USD.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesian-prosecutors-arrest-three-pertamina-unit-executives-over-oil-imports>); [The Jakarta Globe](<https://jakartaglobe.id/news/pertamina-vows-cooperation-as-executives-named-in-119b-corruption-scandal>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-02-25-5-2"></a>

Context: Second presidency of Donald Trump / Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge for the Western Washington District Court Jamal Whitehead temporarily blocks President Donald Trump's executive order to suspend the Refugee Admissions Program, ruling that President Trump cannot nullify the law passed by Congress, following a lawsuit against the Trump administration by the International Refugee Assistance Project.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/trump-refugee-seattle-ruling-lawsuit-eef485154e2a3f008a01d6790ce0ee06>).

### 2025-02-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1340656092](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2026&oldid=1340656092>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** The Somalian government and the African Union finalize the troop distribution for the new peacekeeping mission AUSSOM, resolving prior disputes with Ethiopia and later Burundi. The mission will deploy 11,900 personnel, including soldiers, police, and civilian staff. Under the agreement, Uganda will contribute 4,500 troops, followed by Ethiopia with 2,500, Djibouti with 1,520, Kenya with 1,410, and Egypt with 1,091.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/au-somalia-agree-on-troop-numbers-for-new-mission/7987913.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-26-0-4"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war, 2024 famine in Sudan.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations-operated World Food Programme announces it has been forced to temporarily cease the distribution of humanitarian aid in the Zamzam refugee camp in North Darfur, Sudan, due to an escalation in fighting between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces in the region. Doctors Without Borders also temporarily ceased operations in the camp last week.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-un-food-agency-pauses-aid-in-famine-hit-refugee-camp/a-71763311>).

<a id="event-2025-02-26-0-6"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** A roadside bombing kills a Texan rancher in San Fernando, Tamaulipas, Mexico. Authorities say the victim was driving on his ranch when the explosive device detonated.

Source citations (as archived): [El Financiero](<https://www.elfinanciero.com.mx/border/2025/02/26/ranchero-de-texas-muere-por-explosivo-en-tamaulipas-advierten-que-carteles-amenazan-la-frontera/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Conservation and restoration of Pompeian frescoes.

**Archived source account.** Archeologists find monumental frescoes at the House of Thiasus in Pompeii, Campania, Italy, providing insight into the Dionysian Mysteries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/rare-frescoes-unearthed-pompeii-shed-light-ancient-rituals-2025-02-26/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Instagram Reels Violent Videos Incident.

**Archived source account.** Meta Platforms introduces a bug that results Instagram users' Reels feeds displaying violent and graphic videos despite these users having content filters enabled.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/whats-going-on-with-instagram-reels-possible-reasons-behind-surge-in-sensitive-and-violent-content-101740612751914.html>).

<a id="event-2025-02-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 United States tariffs against the European Union.

**Archived source account.** United States President Donald Trump announces impending 25% tariffs on the European Union, which he states will be generally applied to sectors such as the automotive industry.

<a id="event-2025-02-26-7-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Anguillian general election.

**Archived source account.** The opposition Anguilla United Front (AUF) wins a majority in the House of Assembly. AUF leader Cora Richardson-Hodge becomes the first female Premier of Anguilla.

Source citations (as archived): [Jamaica Observer](<https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2025/02/27/anguillians-elect-first-female-head-government/>).

Context: Freedom of the press in the United States, Gulf of Mexico–America naming dispute.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/white-house-bars-ap-reuters-other-media-covering-trump-cabinet-meeting-2025-02-26/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-26-7-5"></a>

Context: Constitutional crisis in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Somalia's Federal Parliament fails to meet due to a lack of quorum, with only 137 MPs present, two short of the required amount. The delay raises concerns about a potential no-confidence motion against Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre's council of ministers.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200428/somali_parliament_fails_to_meet_quorum_fueling_no_confidence_motion_speculation.aspx>).
