#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** As part of the first stage of the ceasefire deal, Hamas releases the bodies of four Israeli hostages in return for the Israeli government releasing 617 Palestinian prisoners. The second phase of the ceasefire has not been negotiated.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/final-swap-of-gaza-truce-deal-sees-return-of-4-dead-hostages/a-71767402>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / 2025 Karkur junction ramming attack.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are injured in a car-ramming attack in Pardes Hanna-Karkur, Israel. The suspect, a Palestinian residing in Ma'ale Iron, is later shot and killed by police after an attempted stabbing attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/teen-in-critical-condition-after-terror-suspect-plows-car-into-bus-stop-injuring-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-9"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / 2025 Bukavu offensive / 2025 Bukavu M23 rally bombings.

**Archived source account.** A grenade attack at an M23 rally in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, celebrating their recent victory over government forces in the city, kills at least eleven people and wounds 65 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/blasts-m23-rally-eastern-congo-kill-11-wound-65-rebel-leader-says-2025-02-27/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-12"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Jailed Kurdish leader and Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) founder Abdullah Öcalan calls for an end to the conflict with Turkey and asks the group to disarm and disband, amid peace efforts between the Turkish government and the PKK led by the pro-Kurdish Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/turkey/27022025>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-pro-kurdish-party-sets-off-visit-jailed-militant-leader-2025-02-27/>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-ocalan-calls-for-pkk-to-lay-down-weapons/a-71773113>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-14"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Somali capital city Mogadishu enters a security lockdown after several mortars were fired toward Aden Adde International Airport during a visit from Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<http://v.aa.com.tr/3494950>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-15"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Somali forces regain control of Balad after Al-Shabaab launches a coordinated attack, detonating roadside bombs and briefly seizing the town.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200443/somali_forces_regain_control_of_bal_ad_after_deadly_al_shabaab_attack.aspx>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-0-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** Villa Somalia security guards open fire on civilians at Lido Beach in Mogadishu while attempting to clear the beach ahead of a visit from Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, killing a teenage boy and wounding several others.

Source citations (as archived): [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/teenager-shot-dead-as-somali-security-forces-clear-beach-for-ethiopian-pms-visit/>); [HBN](<https://hbnonlinetv.com/khasaare-dhimasho-oo-ka-dhashay-rasaas-lagu-kala-ergayey-dad-shacab-ah-muqdisho/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-02-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Denmark–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Danish retailer group Salling Group, which operates around 34% of the retail market share in the country, announces it will start differentiating brands owned by European companies from American ones, in retaliation to U.S. President Donald Trump's proposed acquisition of Greenland, an autonomous territory of the Danish Realm.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/danish-grocery-chain-to-distinguish-european-from-us-goods/a-71773488>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-02-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at a three-story residential building in Quezon City, Philippines, kills eight people and injures one other.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/philippines-deadly-building-fire-ee49c46908c2d074b5a229faf773b170>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed when a Robinson R44 helicopter crashes on a private property in Uvalde, Texas, United States. The Federal Aviation Administration and the National Transportation Safety Board are currently investigating the accident.

Source citations (as archived): [KENS-TV](<https://www.kens5.com/video/news/local/texas/latest-details-in-deadly-helicopter-crash-in-kinney-county/273-77d7fde6-3362-4432-a665-e7642e95ffbd>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Russian tourists are killed in a shark attack while scuba diving in the Verde Island Passage off Batangas, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/philippines-shark-attack-2-tourists-killed-popular-diving-spot>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-27-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump meets with UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer in Washington, D.C., for talks that include the Russo-Ukrainian War peace negotiations. Starmer also presents a letter from King Charles III inviting Trump to visit London later this year.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/02/27/nx-s1-5310656/trump-keir-starmer-russia-ukraine>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-02-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Persecution of Uyghurs in China.

**Archived source account.** Forty Uyghur men detained in Thailand for over a decade are deported to China, despite concerns regarding their persecution.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/02/27/40-uyghur-men-detained-in-thailand-for-more-than-a-decade-have-been-deported-to-china>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The prosecutor's office in Paris, France, closes a criminal complaint case by the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) against technology company Apple for alleged money laundering and deceptive business practices related to the purchase of minerals in the DRC from armed militias. It is one of the DRC's two lawsuits, with another in Belgium.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/paris-prosecutor-closes-case-against-apple-over-congo-minerals-document-2025-02-27/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-02-27-5-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Austrian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** The Social Democratic Party, the Austrian People's Party, and the NEOS party in Austria agree to form a coalition government, leaving out the far-right Freedom Party, who won the most seats in the National Council in the 2024 legislative election. The coalition agreement ends Austria's longest period without a government since World War II.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/austria-centrist-parties-form-coalition-without-far-right/a-71765298>); [Euractiv](<https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/news/austria-centrist-parties-agree-on-coalition-government/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration bans NASA scientists and US government officials from attending the UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change conference that started this week in Hangzhou, China, which are focused on the seventh IPCC Assessment Report on climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-00596-0>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-02-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Meta Platforms says it has fixed an error that resulted in Instagram users' Reels feeds displaying violent and graphic videos despite these users having content filters enabled.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/02/27/meta-fixes-error-that-flooded-instagram-reels-with-violent-videos>).

<a id="event-2025-02-27-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** OpenAI releases their latest large language model, GPT-4.5.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/news/620021/openai-gpt-4-5-orion-ai-model-release>).

### 2025-02-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1318170367](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20February%2028&oldid=1318170367>).

#### Attacks and armed conflicts

<a id="event-2025-02-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Darul Uloom Haqqania bombing.

**Archived source account.** Five people, including Hamid Ul Haq Haqqani, the head of a faction of the Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (S) party and son of Sami-ul-Haq, are killed and twenty others are injured in a suicide bombing inside of a mosque in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/pakistan/injured-blast-islamic-seminary-training-taliban-9861319/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** At least four people are shot dead in a mechanical workshop in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz, Mexico. This is the second massacre this week in the state, the other in Perote, which left three workers dead and one wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [La Jornada](<https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2025/02/26/estados/matan-a-tres-en-ataque-armado-en-taller-mecanico-de-veracruz>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Three policemen and a civilian are killed in two attacks in Guanajuato, Mexico, the first in Celaya and the second in Apaseo el Alto.

Source citations (as archived): [Revista Proceso](<https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/estados/2025/2/28/van-tres-policias-asesinados-en-ataques-armados-dirigidos-en-las-ultimas-24-horas-en-guanajuato-346462.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-02-28-1-3"></a>

Context: Protests against Donald Trump / Protests against the second presidency of Donald Trump / Economic Blackout.

**Archived source account.** A 24-hour consumer spending boycott takes place across the United States, in protest of wealth and income inequality, high prices of essential goods, and the rollback of diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives by the Trump administration.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/feb-28-economic-blackout-2025-d6b0bf2d1c989ee3071016e36598d76c>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-1-5"></a>

Context: 2025 United States federal mass layoffs.

**Archived source account.** The United States Social Security Administration announces it will lay off over 7,000 jobs to align with President Donald Trump's executive order, despite its workforce already being at a 50-year low.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/02/28/nx-s1-5296986/trump-worker-cuts-social-security-administration>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-02-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2024–25 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed as tropical cyclone Garance makes landfall in Réunion in the Indian Ocean.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/reunion-island-cyclone-garance-damages-d20ddf429639502e67f97089626bc7ec>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-2-3"></a>

Context: 2025 disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

**Archived source account.** At least 60 fatalities and nearly 1,100 symptomatic cases are reported to be a result of a disease outbreak of unknown etiology in the Province of Équateur, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/congo-mystery-disease-deaths-who-investigation-deepens/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-2-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Uttarakhand avalanche.

**Archived source account.** 5 construction workers are trapped, 48 others are rescued and 4 people are killed after a group of 57 people are swept away by an avalanche near the Mana Pass, Uttarakhand, India.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/at-least-4-construction-workers-are-killed-in-an-avalanche-in-northern-india/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-02-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Southwest United States measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The number of measles cases in Texas, United States, increases to 146 with 20 people hospitalized, spanning nine counties in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/measles-outbreak-texas-vaccination-rfk-7e1df8310d6e139010ab7f4e4069c199>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-02-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations / Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2025 Trump–Zelenskyy meeting.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump, U.S. vice president JD Vance and Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy end their talks early after their meeting in the White House turns into a "heated" exchange. Trump rejects any discussion of specific security guarantees for Ukraine, being interested solely in discussing the Ukraine–United States Mineral Resources Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/7262883/trump-zelensky-meeting/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/zelenskyy-security-guarantees-trump-meeting-washington-eebdf97b663c2cdc9e51fa346b09591d>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-4-4"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations / Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2025 Trump–Zelenskyy meeting.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department terminates U.S. support of Ukraine's energy grid restoration amid an ongoing energy crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/state-department-terminates-us-support-ukraine-energy-grid-restoration-rcna194259>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-4-6"></a>

Context: Colombia–Israel relations, Israel–Malaysia relations, South Africa–Israel relations, Boycotts of Israel.

**Archived source account.** Colombian president Gustavo Petro, Malaysian prime minister Anwar Ibrahim, and South African president Cyril Ramaphosa release a joint statement announcing they will close their ports to any ship carrying weapons supplied to Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20250228-south-africa-malaysia-colombia-condemn-trumps-gaza-riviera-plan-as-ethnic-cleansing/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-4-8"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict.

**Archived source account.** The East African Community (EAC) and the Southern African Development Community (SADC) postpone the joint summit of their foreign ministers that would have agreed on a ceasefire plan for the conflict in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Congolese and Rwanda governments never received invitations to the meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [Critical Threats Project](<https://www.criticalthreats.org/briefs/congo-war-security-review/congo-war-security-review-february-28-2025>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-4-10"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia appoints Alexander Darchiev as its new ambassador to the U.S. following talks between the two countries in Istanbul on restoring regular diplomatic contacts and embassy staffs. The post has been vacant for several months.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/russia-names-new-ambassador-to-us-after-istanbul-talks-e9993f36>); [Interfax](<https://interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/110109/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-02-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexico extradites 29 alleged cartel members to the United States, including Rafael Caro Quintero, Miguel Treviño Morales, Omar Treviño Morales, Vicente Carrillo Fuentes and Jose Rodolfo Villarreal-Hernandez.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2995y25lyo>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/cartel-boss-el-gato-extradited-us-2013-north-texas-murder/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-02-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Greeks organize a 24-hour nationwide general strike on the second anniversary of the Tempi train crash, Greece's deadliest railway disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greece-standstill-ahead-mass-protest-anniversary-deadly-train-crash-2025-02-28/>).

<a id="event-2025-02-28-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the 2024 quota reform movement in Bangladesh, students who led the protests announce the formation of a new political party, the National Citizen Party, led by Nahid Islam, a student activist and the chief coordinator of the Students Against Discrimination movement.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/bangladesh-students-launch-new-party-to-shake-up-politics/a-71786361>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-02-28-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft announces it will shut down Skype in May 2025 to focus its support and development on Teams.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/microsoft-to-retire-skype-in-favor-of-teams/a-71786197>); [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-02-28/microsoft-msft-to-shut-down-skype-as-zoom-teams-dominate-video-calls>).


## March

### 2025-03-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1329750468](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%201&oldid=1329750468>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-4"></a>

Context: War on terror / War against the Islamic State / Islamic State insurgency in Puntland / Puntland counter-terrorism operations.

**Archived source account.** The Puntland Dervish Force captures an IS–Somalia base in Buqa Caleed, in the Cal Miskaad mountain range of Bari Region, Puntland, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Somali Digest](<https://thesomalidigest.com/puntland-forces-capture-key-isis-base-in-buqa-caleed/>); [Horseed Media](<https://horseedmedia.net/video-ciidanka-puntland-oo-soo-bandhigay-goobo-daacish-laga-qabsaday/401597/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-5"></a>

Context: War on terror.

**Archived source account.** United States Central Command says that it has carried out a precision airstrike in Syria, targeting and killing Muhammed Yusuf Ziya Talay, a senior military leader in Hurras al-Din.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/01/us-military-says-it-killed-senior-al-qaeda-leader-in-syria>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-8"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict / 2025 Catatumbo clashes.

**Archived source account.** Three men are found dead in a vehicle near the village of Orú in the Tibú municipality, Norte de Santander, Colombia, with one body dressed in a National Liberation Army (ELN) uniform.

Source citations (as archived): [El Heraldo de Colombia](<https://www.elheraldo.co/colombia/2025/03/01/hallan-tres-cadaveres-y-un-cilindro-abandonado-en-tibu/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict / 2025 Catatumbo clashes.

**Archived source account.** After placing an ELN flag at the entrance of the municipality of Saravena, Arauca, the ELN detonate an improvised explosive device, targeting Colombian soldiers attempting to remove the flag. No casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [El Heraldo de Colombia](<https://www.elheraldo.co/colombia/2025/03/01/ejercito-denuncia-que-el-eln-instalo-bandera-en-saravena-arauca-y-detono-un-explosivo/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-12"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** The first phase of the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas is scheduled to expire today while talks on the second phase, which aims to end the war, remain inconclusive.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/first-phase-of-israel-hamas-truce-set-to-expire/a-71791093>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-14"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza Strip famine.

**Archived source account.** Israel blocks the entry of all humanitarian aid from entering Gaza as the first phase of the ceasefire ends.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-ceasefire-hostages-03-02-2025-99402570996dcf33239d0492d99909e4>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-17"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Civil society groups in the Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, report that 23 people were killed and another 20 were taken hostage in raids by an Islamic State-affiliated faction of the Allied Democratic Forces militia over the past week.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2592094/world>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-20"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Kurdistan Workers' Party announces a ceasefire with Turkey after forty years of conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/1/pkk-declares-ceasefire-in-40-year-conflict-with-turkiye-kurdish-media>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-0-23"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Druze–Syria clashes.

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and approximately nine others are wounded in the Druze-majority city of Jaramana, following armed confrontations between local residents and security forces affiliated with the transitional government. In response, the Suwayda Military Council declares a state of alert, while Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz instruct the Israel Defense Forces to "prepare to defend" the city.

Source citations (as archived): [ANHA](<https://hawarnews.com/en/clashes-in-jaramana-as-suwaydas-military-council-declares-state-of-alert>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/netanyahu-directs-idf-to-prepare-to-defend-syrian-druze-village-under-attack-by-regime/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-03-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Brit Awards 2025.

**Archived source account.** At the 2025 Brit Awards, Charli XCX wins British Artist of the Year, while her album Brat wins British Album of the Year and her song "Guess" wins Song of the Year in collaboration with Billie Eilish. Ezra Collective wins Best British Group.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vw97397xqo>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of winter swimmers in Most, Czechia, set a new world record for the largest polar bear plunge with 2,461 participants. The previous record was 1,799 participants set in Mielno, Poland, in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/czech-record-polar-bear-dip-3015c17bf2efad8567a9bfeb35efb2aa>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-03-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people are killed and 30 others are injured when two passenger buses collide near Uyuni, Potosí department, Bolivia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4g02qx349do>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-01-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy meets with UK prime minister Keir Starmer in London, where they sign off on a British loan of GB£2.26 billion to buy military supplies for Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg4k137ezlgo>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-03-01-4-2"></a>

Context: 2025 Romanian presidential election / 2024–2025 Romanian election annulment protests.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of demonstrators hold a rally in Bucharest, Romania, in support of presidential candidate Călin Georgescu and demand that the second round of the annulled 2024 election is held instead of a new election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/romania-protest-elections-georgescu-europe-05444cb67c249bac7c3596f4ebc51ba5>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-4-4"></a>

Context: Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** United States President Donald Trump signs an executive order designating English as the country's official language.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/mar/02/trump-signs-executive-order-designating-english-as-official-language-of-us>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-4-6"></a>

Context: Presidency of Yamandú Orsi.

**Archived source account.** Yamandú Orsi and Carolina Cosse are inaugurated as the president and vice president of Uruguay in Montevideo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/uruguay-shifts-center-left-orsi-takes-office-2025-03-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-01-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italian nun Raffaella Petrini is sworn is as President of the Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State and President of the Governorate of Vatican City State, becoming the first woman to assume one of the highest political offices in the Vatican. She succeeds Spanish cardinal Fernando Vérgez Alzaga.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-tanker-and-a-tram-collided-at-a-crossing-in-germany-killing-3-people/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-11-3-2"></a>

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine / Coalition of the willing (Russo-Ukrainian War).

**Archived source account.** The military chiefs of all European NATO countries meet in Paris, France, to discuss a potential European peacekeeping force in Ukraine, alongside Ukrainian representatives. The U.S. was not involved in the meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/nato-europe-peacekeeping-mission-ukraine-paris-meeting/33344276.html>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-3-4"></a>

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine / Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. and Ukraine announce their intention to seek a 30-day ceasefire with Russia after talks in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, involving U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, National Security Advisor Mike Waltz, and Ukrainian presidential chief of staff Andriy Yermak.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ukraine-ceasefire-russia-us-talks-saudi-arabia/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-3-6"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict.

**Archived source account.** Angola announces it will mediate peace talks between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Rwanda-backed rebel group March 23 Movement (M23), following a visit by Congolese president Félix Tshisekedi to discuss a potential peace process with Angolan president João Lourenço.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/angola-congo-dakar-senegal-felix-tshisekedi-b2713329.html>); [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2025/03/12/angola-will-attempt-to-broker-direct-talks-between-congo-and-m23-presidency-says>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-11-4-2"></a>

Context: International Criminal Court investigation in the Philippines, Philippine drug war / Arrest of Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** Former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte is arrested by the Philippine National Police through the Interpol at Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Manila after being served an arrest warrant from the International Criminal Court upon arriving from Hong Kong. Duterte was later transferred and later extradited to The Hague, Netherlands on a chartered flight by the Philippine government.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/10/world/asia/icc-philippines-rodrigo-duterte.html>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-4-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Romanian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Romanian Constitutional Court upholds the decision to ban far-right presidential candidate Călin Georgescu from running in the 2025 presidential election after he appealed the decision last week. He is under investigation for campaign finance violations and allegations of being supported by Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/romanian-court-upholds-ban-against-far-right-candidate/a-71893694>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-03-11-5-1"></a>

Context: 2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests.

**Archived source account.** As protests against the Serbian government continue across Serbia, hundreds of students form a blockade around the headquarters of the Radio Television of Serbia in Belgrade, accusing the state television station of being biased towards President Aleksandar Vučić. At least one police officer is injured.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/serbia-student-protesters-block-public-tv-station/a-71885864>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-5-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Greenlandic general election.

**Archived source account.** Greenlanders and other citizens of Greenland vote to elect the 31 members of the Inatsisartut between 213 candidates from six parties.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/greenland-polls-open-in-parliamentary-election/a-71884152>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-5-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Greenlandic general election.

**Archived source account.** The centre-right opposition Demokraatit wins a plurality while the centre-left ruling Inuit Ataqatigiit–Siumut coalition loses their majority.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/12/europe/greenland-election-polls-close-demokraatit-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-5-6"></a>

Context: Next Portuguese legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Portuguese Prime Minister Luís Montenegro's minority government falls after a motion of confidence is passed in the Assembly of the Republic. Early elections are called.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/portugals-government-faces-likely-defeat-fresh-collapse-confidence-vote-2025-03-11/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-11-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States District Judge for the District Court of the District of Columbia Amir Ali orders the Trump administration to pay nearly $2 billion (€1.84 billion) in unpaid funds for promised USAID programs that the administration ended.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/trump-administration-ordered-to-pay-2-billion-in-foreign-aid/a-71883180>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-03-11-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA launches the SPHEREx near-infrared space observatory on a Falcon 9 Block 5 spacecraft from Vandenberg Space Force Base in Santa Barbara County, California, United States. The SPHEREx mission will perform a survey of and map approximately 450 million galaxies across the sky in color.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/science/space/several-delays-nasas-spherex-launches-mission-map-450-million-galaxies-rcna194925>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/nasa-launches-space-telescope-to-unveil-cosmic-secrets/a-71895769>).

### 2025-03-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1280577604](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%2012&oldid=1280577604>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2025 Shabelle offensive / 2025 Beledweyne hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Somali security forces end the 24-hour siege at a hotel in Beledweyne, Hiran, Somalia, with at least fifteen civilians and all six Al-Shabaab attackers killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2gdjd57lro.amp>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/somalia-attack-cairo-hotel-beledweyne-shabab-siege-54575e8873eae84990b61f75b4fa2811?utm_source=copy&amp;utm_medium=share>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-0-4"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2025 Shabelle offensive / 2025 Beledweyne hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Following the attack, over 100 Somali parliament members urge President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to resign, citing leadership failures amid worsening security and governance crises.

Source citations (as archived): [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/over-100-somali-lawmakers-demand-hassan-sheikh-mohamuds-resignation-amid-beledweyne-hotel-attack/>); [Garowe Online](<https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-president-urged-to-resign-over-security-foreign-policy-failures>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Western Syria clashes / 2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites, March 2025 Western Syria clashes.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights documents three further reprisal massacres of Alawite minority communities on 12 March in which 158 civilians were killed, totaling 1,383 civilian deaths as a result of fifty separate massacres conducted in western Syria since March 6.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/at-least-1-383-civilians-killed-in-syria-violence-new-monitor-toll-114f3900>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-0-11"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan / 2025 Jaffar Express hijacking.

**Archived source account.** Security forces rescue all surviving passengers and security personnel from yesterday's hijacking of the Jaffar Express passenger train in Pakistan by the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA). Officials confirm the deaths of all 33 BLA militants, as well as 29 passengers, and 8 soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [News 24](<https://news24online.com/world/pakistan-train-attack-jaffar-express-rescue-operation-ends-33-terrorists-killed-and-30-civilians-dead/500820/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/12/pakistan-forces-continue-operation-to-free-hundreds-from-hijacked-train>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-0-14"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian troops, backed by close air support, enter the town of Sudzha in Kursk Oblast, ending seven months of Ukrainian occupation.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/russia-reportedly-enters-ukraine-held-sudzha-in-kursk-oblast-kyiv-hasn-t-confirmed/ar-AA1ALhDd>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-verge-losing-kursk-pocket-its-foothold-inside-russia-2025-03-12/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-0-15"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kursk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Chief of the Russian General Staff Valery Gerasimov says that remaining Ukrainian forces in Kursk Oblast are entirely surrounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Proto Thema](<https://en.protothema.gr/2025/03/12/putin-visits-kursk-in-camouflage-uniform-a-day-after-u-s-kyiv-ceasefire-deal-ukrainian-forces-encircled/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-03-12-1-1"></a>

Context: 2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico, Canada–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Canadian finance minister Dominic LeBlanc announces retaliatory tariffs on CAD$29.8 billion (US$20.7 billion) of goods from the United States after U.S. president Donald Trump announced additional tariffs on Canadian metals.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/canada-announces-tariffs-on-207-billion-of-us-goods/a-71896104>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict.

**Archived source account.** Angola confirms that peace talks between the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and the Rwandan-backed March 23 Movement will begin on 18 March, after the DRC previously insisted on solely negotiating with Rwanda.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-m23-rebels-to-hold-peace-talks-in-angola/a-71904502>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-2-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian supreme leader Ali Khamenei rejects negotiations with the U.S. regarding Iran's nuclear program, stating that Iran is "not interested in nuclear weapons".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y02jexjxxo>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-2-5"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Houthi movement in Yemen announces it will resume targeting Israeli ships because its deadline for Israel to resume aid deliveries to the Gaza Strip has passed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/12/yemens-houthis-to-resume-shipping-attacks-over-gaza-aid-cutoff>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The City Court in Tbilisi, Georgia, convicts former president Mikheil Saakashvili of embezzlement and sentences him to nine years in prison. The court also fines the former head of the Special State Protection Service, Teimuraz Janashia, ₾300,000 (€99,936) in connection to the case.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/georgia-ex-president-saakashvili-jailed-for-9-more-years/a-71896528>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-03-12-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Belizean general election.

**Archived source account.** Belizeans vote to elect the 31 members of the House of Representatives between the incumbent People's United Party and the opposition United Democratic Party. The ruling party is re-elected by 26 seats to 5.

Source citations (as archived): [Breaking Belize News](<https://www.breakingbelizenews.com/2025/03/12/breaking-peoples-united-party-claim-another-wide-victory-in-2025-general-elections/>); [Jamaica Observer](<https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2025/03/13/belizes-ruling-party-wins-general-election/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Syrian presidential office announces the creation of the National Security Council as a means of confronting national and internal security problems.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-interim-president-sharaa-forms-national-security-council-2025-03-12/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-12-4-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Swiss Federal Council election.

**Archived source account.** Following the resignation of Swiss Defense Minister Viola Amherd, the Federal Assembly votes to elect the new member of the Federal Council. Martin Pfister is elected as the head of the defense ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/martin-pfister-elected-new-swiss-federal-council-member-2025-03-12/>); [Radio SRF](<https://www.srf.ch/news/schweiz/martin-pfister-gewinnt-das-war-die-bundesratswahl>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-03-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2024–25 FIS Ski Jumping World Cup.

**Archived source account.** Norwegian ski jumpers Marius Lindvik and Johann André Forfang are suspended by FIS and will not participate in Raw Air due to an ongoing investigation involving the manipulation of ski equipment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sports/ski-jumping-norwegian-ski-jumpers-suspended-amid-equipment-investigation-2025-03-12/>).

### 2025-03-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1341980456](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%2013&oldid=1341980456>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Western Syria clashes / 2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites, March 2025 Western Syria clashes.

**Archived source account.** Spiritual leader of Syria's Druze community Hikmat al-Hajari rejects any deal with the new Ahmed al-Sharaa-headed transitional government, accusing it of being "extremist in every sense of the word" and refusing to "recognize a terrorist" in reference to the concurrent sectarian massacres of Syrian Alawites.

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/130320256>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-845948>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-0-7"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Puntland counter-terrorism operations / Islamic State insurgency in Puntland.

**Archived source account.** Puntland forces claim to have killed a senior foreign ISIL commander responsible for orchestrating drone attacks using explosive-laden unmanned aerial vehicles in the Lugta-Huraanhur and Togga Raq-Raq valleys of the Cal Miskaad Mountains in Puntland's Bari Region.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/puntland-forces-kill-isis-drone-chief-in-calmiskaad-mountains-operation>); [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Mar/200673/puntland_forces_kill_senior_isis_drone_commander_in_targeted_operation.aspx>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-0-10"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Palestinian genocide accusation, Gaza genocide.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Council accuses Israel of committing genocidal acts and other war crimes against Palestinians in Gaza, including committing gender-based violence and sexual assault against prisoners and the systematic destruction of healthcare systems in the region. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismisses the reports and accusations, calling them biased and "antisemitic".

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/un-accuses-israel-of-genocidal-acts-sexual-violence-in-gaza/a-71912287>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-experts-accuse-israel-genocidal-acts-sexual-violence-gaza-2025-03-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-0-13"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin says that the U.S. proposal for the ceasefire in Ukraine would depend on Russia's conditions being met, and that there will be further discussions.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/03/13/putin-agrees-with-us-made-ceasefire-proposal-but-says-there-are-nuances>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/putin-puts-heavy-conditions-on-trumps-ukraine-ceasefire-plan/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-03-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Keir Starmer announces that NHS England will be abolished in a drive to reduce bureaucracy and bring National Health Service management back under "democratic control". The move is expected to result in around 6,500 job losses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cx29lrl826rt>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Qatar begins supplying natural gas to Syria via Jordan to increase production at the Deir Ali power plant in Rif Dimashq Governorate, which will provide electricity to Damascus and other major cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/13/qatar-begins-supplying-natural-gas-to-syria-through-jordan>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-13-2-2"></a>

Context: American expansionism under Donald Trump / Panama–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration reportedly orders the U.S. military to plan options to expand the presence of American troops in Panama and potentially try to reclaim the Panama Canal.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/trump-white-house-asked-us-military-develop-options-panama-canal-offic-rcna195994>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-2-4"></a>

Context: American expansionism under Donald Trump / Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland.

**Archived source account.** During a meeting at the White House with Secretary General of NATO Mark Rutte, U.S. President Donald Trump refuses to rule out the U.S. annexation of Greenland when questioned.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/donald-trump-says-he-thinks-us-will-annex-greenland-13327945>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-2-6"></a>

Context: Armenia–Azerbaijan relations.

**Archived source account.** Armenia and Azerbaijan agree on a peace treaty to formally end the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict and establish a mutually-agreed border between both countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/armenia-says-it-is-ready-sign-peace-agreement-with-azerbaijan-2025-03-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-2-8"></a>

Context: Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan relations.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and Tajik President Emomali Rahmon sign a deal to formally end the border dispute between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. Railways, roads, and air transport resumes between both countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-sign-deal-end-long-running-border-dispute-2025-03-13/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-13-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 United States federal mass layoffs.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge William Alsup of the Northern District of California orders the U.S. departments of agriculture, energy, interior, veterans affairs, and the Treasury to reinstate probationary workers who were fired by the Office of Personnel Management.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-judge-extend-block-trump-administration-ordering-mass-firings-2025-03-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Corruption in Belgium.

**Archived source account.** Federal Police searches Huawei's headquarters in Brussels, Belgium, on suspicion of bribery.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/03/13/belgian-authorities-searched-huawei-offices-in-fresh-european-parliament-corruption-probe>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-03-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Union State.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin announces that Russian citizens permanently residing in Belarus will be able to vote and run in local elections in Belarus, and that Belarusian citizens permanently residing in Russia will be able to vote and run in local elections in Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Belsat](<https://belsat.eu/85574110/rasejtsy-zdoleyuts-brats-udzel-u-myastsovyh-vybarah-u-belarusi>).

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza war ceasefire.

Context: Tornado outbreak of March 14, 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/hungarys-parliament-passes-law-banning-lgbtq-pride-events/a-71964198>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-03-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Boeing Crew Flight Test, SpaceX Crew-9.

**Archived source account.** Astronauts Sunita Williams and Barry Wilmore return to Earth aboard the SpaceX Crew-9 Dragon 2 capsule after nine months on the International Space Station (ISS). The astronauts were originally supposed to be aboard the ISS for eight days but their return was delayed due to technical problems with their Boeing Starliner Calypso capsule.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c9de6q52g8qt>).

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip / March 2025 Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/italian-coast-guard-finds-6-bodies-40-missing-in-mediterranean/a-71970922>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250319-italy-says-six-dead-40-missing-after-migrant-shipwreck>).

Context: Iran–United States relations.

<a id="event-2025-03-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu.

**Archived source account.** Istanbul mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is also the main opposition figure against President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, is arrested by Turkish Police along with more than 100 other people for alleged corruption and aiding terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-authorities-order-detention-istanbul-mayor-some-100-others-2025-03-19/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-istanbul-mayor-police-search-ead3dd38aa547ecd13bc336e7d6c4d58?utm_source=copy&amp;utm_medium=share>).

<a id="event-2025-03-19-4-3"></a>

Context: Dakota Access Pipeline protests.

**Archived source account.** A jury in North Dakota, United States, orders Greenpeace to pay at least $660 million to Energy Transfer Partners, the company responsible for the Dakota Access Pipeline, after ETP sued the organization for holding protests near Standing Rock Reservation concerning the violation of indigenous sovereignty of Native Americans.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/greenpeace-liable-for-millions-in-pipeline-lawsuit/a-71978898>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/mar/19/greenpeace-lawsuit-energy-transfer-dakota-pipeline>).

**Archived source account.** Bangladesh Police arrest Ataullah abu Ammar Jununi, the leader of the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army, a Rohingya insurgent group, in Dhaka, Bangladesh, accusing him of leading and carrying out attacks against the Tatmadaw since 2016 along with charges of illegal entry, murder, and sabotage.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/bangladesh-arrests-leader-of-rohingya-insurgent-group/a-71967724>); [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/bangladesh-arrests-leader-of-rohingya-insurgent-group-on-criminal-charges>).

<a id="event-2025-03-19-4-7"></a>

Context: Prosper family murders.

**Archived source account.** Nicholas Prosper, a 19-year-old who was convicted of killing three family members and plotting a school shooting in Luton, Bedfordshire, England, in 2024, is sentenced to minimum of 49 years in prison without parole.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/british-teenager-who-killed-family-and-planned-school-massacre-gets-minimum-49-years-in-prison/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Western Syria clashes / 2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR) reports that thousands of Syrian civilians are still missing following sectarian reprisal massacres committed by Syrian government-affiliated forces that killed at least 1,614 coastal civilians, including many Alawites and Christians.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a2%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%81-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%81%d9%82%d9%88%d8%af%d9%8a%d9%86-%d9%88%d9%85%d8%a6%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%ac%d8%ab%d8%ab-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%ac%d9%87%d9%88%d9%84%d8%a9-%d9%85/754056/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Western Syria clashes / 2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites.

**Archived source account.** The SOHR also reports several efforts by pro-government forces to hide the scale of the atrocities by gathering unaccounted bodies into mass graves, through cremation, or retaining hundreds of unidentified corpses from families.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a2%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%81-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%81%d9%82%d9%88%d8%af%d9%8a%d9%86-%d9%88%d9%85%d8%a6%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%ac%d8%ab%d8%ab-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%ac%d9%87%d9%88%d9%84%d8%a9-%d9%85/754056/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli–Lebanese conflict / Israeli invasion of Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Six people, including a child, are killed by Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon in the heaviest exchange of fire since the ceasefire with the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah almost four months ago. The strikes were carried out in retaliation for rockets from Lebanon being fired into Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/israel-hamas-war/article/israel-fires-on-lebanon-in-response-to-rockets-fired-at-israeli-targets/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Zaporizhzhia strikes, Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** An overnight Russian drone attack on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, kills three people and wounds twelve others. Several apartments in residential areas are targeted during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-ceasefire-drones-zaporizhzhia-84dab972755f90ad7592a2a13758ed9c>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-12"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Pokrovsk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian artillery targets Pokrovsk in Donetsk Oblast, killing three people and injuring one other person.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-shelling-kills-three-pokrovsk-ukraines-east-governor-says-2025-03-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-15"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2025 Shabelle offensive.

**Archived source account.** At least 100 al-Shabaab militant fighters are killed in a Somali Air Force airstrike in the Lower Shabelle region of the South West State, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [TRAC](<https://trackingterrorism.org/chatter/somali-air-force-conducts-airstrike-in-lower-shabelle-somalia/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-18"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese Armed Forces say that they seized control of the main headquarters of the central bank from the Rapid Support Forces as it continues to make advances in Khartoum, Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/22/sudans-army-seizes-control-of-central-bank-amid-steady-gains-in-khartoum>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-20"></a>

Context: Ethiopian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian National Defense Forces claimed to have killed more than 300 fighters from the Fano armed group in two days of clashes in the northern Amhara region of Ethiopia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ethiopias-army-says-it-killed-more-than-300-fano-militiamen-two-days-fighting-2025-03-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-22"></a>

Context: Fambita mosque attack.

**Archived source account.** Niger declares three days of national mourning after yesterday's attack in which 44 people were killed in a mosque in Fambita.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/22/niger-declares-three-days-of-mourning-after-mosque-attack-leaves-44-dead>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-0-24"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** A ballistic missile disintegrates over Saudi Arabia after being fired by the Houthis from Yemen against Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-847129>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-03-22-1-1"></a>

Context: March 2025 South Korea wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Three firefighters and a civilian are killed after multiple wildfires sweep across a large forested area in South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/wildfires-in-south-korea-turn-deadly-prompt-evacuations/a-72005968>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A de Havilland Canada DHC-5 Buffalo cargo plane en route from Dhobley Airport in Lower Juba, Jubaland, to Aden Adde International Airport in Somalia’s capital city, Mogadishu, crashes in the Ceel Xabaaloow settlement in Lower Shabelle, South West State, killing all five Kenyan crew members on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Somalia Civil Aviation Authority](<https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=973579984959953&amp;set=a.233160055668620&amp;type=3&amp;ref=embed_page>); [Idil News](<https://www.idilnews.com/cargo-plane-crashes-ceel-xabaaloow-in-lower-shabelle-emergency-team-responds/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Foreign ministers from Japan, China, and South Korea meet in Tokyo to discuss cooperation on shared challenges like aging populations and climate change, seeking to improve relations and prepare for a leaders' summit. Japan raises security concerns about North Korea while China criticizes protectionism and the politicization of science.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/japan-china-south-korea-foreign-ministers-313665d1a611abeb42180245d7e167f1>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States lifts a $10 million dollar reward for information leading to the arrest of Afghan warlord Sirajuddin Haqqani after the Taliban released an American citizen who had been kept in captivity for two years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/22/us-lifts-10m-reward-for-major-taliban-leader-haqqani>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-03-22-4-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza war protests in Israel.

**Archived source account.** More than 100,000 Israelis gather in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, and other cities in Israel to demonstrate and demand a deal for the Israeli government and Hamas to release all hostages. The protesters also accuse the Israeli government of working against its people, calling for a right of rebellion and new elections.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/03/25/nx-s1-5339490/israel-protests-netanyahu-hostages-gaza-war>).

<a id="event-2025-03-22-4-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Turkish protests.

**Archived source account.** Anti-Erdoğan government protests spread to fifty-five of Turkey's eighty-one provinces, with Republican People's Party leader Özgür Özel estimating that over half a million protesters are demonstrating in Istanbul alone. At least 343 protesters are arrested by Turkish police.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250322-more-than-340-held-after-mass-protests-in-turkey>).

### 2025-03-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1283660040](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%2023&oldid=1283660040>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip / March 2025 Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Hamas announces that an Israeli airstrike killed Salah al-Bardawil, a top member of the group's political bureau.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq5zxe5l58go>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip / March 2025 Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Hamas says that an Israeli airstrike killed Ismail Barhoum, a member of the group's political bureau, via the operating theater at Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis where Barhoum was receiving treatment after sustaining critical injuries in an air strike targeting his home in Khan Yunis last Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250323-hamas-source-says-israeli-strike-kills-hamas-official-in-gaza-hospital>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Somali Civil War / 2025 Garissa attack.

**Archived source account.** At least six police officers are killed and five others are injured in an Al-Shabaab attack on a police reservists camp in Fafi, Garissa, Kenya. Dozens of militants are also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://www.garoweonline.com/en/world/africa/al-shabaab-fighters-storm-police-camp-in-kenya-kill-six>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-9"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen Pakistani Taliban gunmen are killed by soldiers in a shootout while attempting to enter in to Ghulam Khan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-troops-killed-militants-afghan-border-71ae64fc851bec083e2abaea96db3a6a>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Eight people, including at least four police officers, are killed in two separate mass shootings in Nushki and Kalat District, Balochistan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Report.az](<https://report.az/diger-olkeler/pakistanin-iki-hucum-zamani-8-nefer-oldurulub/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-13"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces report that they intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis from Yemen, which triggered sirens across central Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/houthis-fire-ballistic-missile-at-israel-triggering-sirens-across-center-of-country/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-15"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed and dozens are injured across Ukraine by overnight Russian drone strikes, including three civilians killed in Kyiv.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/russia-ukraine-war/article/7-killed-after-moscow-targets-ukraine-with-a-mass-drone-attack-ahead-of-ceasefire-talks/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-0-16"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian troops reportedly recapture the village of Nadiia, Luhansk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/49428>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-03-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A van crashes into a ravine and catches fire in Nuevo León, Mexico, killing twelve people and injuring four others. The vehicle fire also sparked a small wildfire in the surrounding forest.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/northern-mexico-van-accident-kills-12-people-sparks-forest-fire-2025-03-24/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. National Security Advisor Mike Waltz says that the U.S. wants the "full dismantlement" of Iran's nuclear program and that "all options are on the table".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/23/trump-advisor-says-us-seeking-full-dismantlement-of-iran-s-nuclear-program>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/trumps-offer-talks-with-iran-aims-avoid-military-action-us-envoy-says-2025-03-23/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Turkish protests, Censorship in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** A statement by social media company X expresses that it objects to "multiple court orders" from the government of Turkey to block more than 700 accounts belonging to opposition political figures, journalists, news outlets, and student protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cq6yde479gdt>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Workers of the Shiv Sena party of Maharastra attack the Habitat Venue in Mumbai after a video posted by comedian Kunal Kamra allegedly attacking Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde

Source citations (as archived): [Business Today](<https://www.businesstoday.in/india/story/kunal-kamra-joke-row-show-venue-habitat-studio-attacked-by-shiv-sena-shuts-down-temporarily-469056-2025-03-24>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-03-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Turkish protests.

**Archived source account.** Several hundred thousands of anti-Erdoğan government protesters demonstrate outside of Istanbul City Hall, with the nationwide protests becoming the largest Turkish political demonstration movement in over a decade.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-mayor-jailed-istanbul-f962743f724f00a318f84ffaed7f58de>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-03-23-5-2"></a>

Context: 2025 WTA Tour / 2025 Miami Open.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, Alexandra Eala becomes the first Filipino player to defeat a top-10 opponent since the WTA rankings began in 1975, after winning in the third round of the Women's singles tournament at the Miami Open against world No. 5 Madison Keys.

Source citations (as archived): [The Athletic](<https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6225138/2025/03/23/tennis-alex-eala-madison-keys-result-analysis-miami/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-23-5-4"></a>

Context: 2025 CONCACAF Nations League Finals.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Mexico wins its first Nations League title after defeating Panama 2–1 in the final held at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [RFI](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/sports/20250324-jimenez-at-the-double-as-mexico-down-panama>).

### 2025-03-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359565884](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%2024&oldid=1359565884>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis / Airstrike campaign in Yemen / March 2025 United States attacks in Yemen / United States government Signal group chat leak.

**Archived source account.** A Signal group chat containing many of President Trump's cabinet, discussing several topics including potential strikes in Yemen, is discovered after journalist Jeffrey Goldberg is accidentally added to it.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/03/24/politics/yemen-strikes-journalist-cabinet-signal-chat/index.html?iid=cnn_buildContentRecirc_end_recirc>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis / Airstrike campaign in Yemen / March 2025 United States attacks in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military launches air raids across Houthi-controlled areas of Yemen overnight, killing at least four people and injuring 13 others in the capital city Sanaa.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/us-air-strikes-yemen-kill-four-wound-two>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Russian re-occupation of Sumy Oblast.

**Archived source account.** Ninety people are injured, including 17 children, in a Russian missile attack on a hospital, a school, and a residential area in Sumy, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/03/24/us-russia-talks-on-ukraine-ceasefire-end-after-12-hours_6739481_4.html>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Luhansk Oblast campaign.

**Archived source account.** A Ukrainian artillery strike kills six people, including several journalists from Russia's Izvestia newspaper and Zvezda state media network in Luhansk Oblast, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-artillery-attack-kills-six-east-including-three-journalists-regional-2025-03-24/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-0-12"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Russia conclude talks focusing on a ceasefire for the Black Sea between Kyiv and Moscow.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-delegation-aims-black-sea-ceasefire-ukraine-russia-talks-2025-03-23/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-03-24-1-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis.

**Archived source account.** British supermarket chain Morrisons announces that it will permanently close 52 cafés and 17 stores as part of cost-cutting measures, with the loss of at least 365 jobs expected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx0v5xprz4o>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American genetic testing company 23andMe files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and announces plans to sell its assets.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/23andme-chapter-11-bankruptcy-wojcicki-resigns-9827549d9171a537e76f60cb950d1823>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-03-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-two people are killed in a road accident in Gondola District, Manica, Mozambique.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20250325/88cff72ae234416dbd0ff63f17f9efe3/c.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-03-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland.

**Archived source account.** Greenlandic prime minister Múte Bourup Egede says a planned visit to the island by senior American officials, including National Security Advisor Mike Waltz and Second Lady Usha Vance, is "highly aggressive" and was designed to "demonstrate power over us".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/03/24/world/greenland-prime-minister-us-usha-vance-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Turkish protests.

**Archived source account.** Over 1,100 Turkish anti-government protesters have been detained since the arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu, with Turkish President Tayyip Erdoğan accusing the demonstrations of being a "movement of violence".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkey-detains-nine-journalists-over-protests-against-istanbul-mayors-arrest-2025-03-24/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/mar/24/journalists-among-more-than-1100-arrested-in-turkey-crackdown-istanbul>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Impeachment of Han Duck-soo.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of South Korea dismisses the impeachment motion of prime minister Han Duck-soo by the National Assembly of South Korea in a 7–1 vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250324002752315>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-koreas-constitutional-court-strikes-down-impeachment-pm-han-duck-soo-2025-03-24/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-24-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** One man is killed and another person wounded in a combined ramming, stabbing, and shooting attack by an Israeli Arab assailant at a bus stop in Yokneam Illit, Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/one-killed-suspected-ramming-attack-northern-israel-2025-03-24/>).

### 2025-03-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1291278357](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%2025&oldid=1291278357>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The United States says that Russia and Ukraine agree to cease all military attacks in the Black Sea to ensure safe passage for commercial shipping, while Russia says that it needs guarantees and an order from the U.S. to Ukraine to respect such a deal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c4g7w7521w0t>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-us-are-studying-outcome-talks-ukraine-riyadh-kremlin-says-2025-03-25/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / 2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR) announces that it has documented the names of 1,628 mainly-Alawite Syrian civilians who were killed in sectarian massacres by pro-Syrian government forces, in addition to several more missing civilians and bodies.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B1/754412/>).

<a id="event-2025-03-25-0-8"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

**Archived source account.** At least 54 people are killed in a Sudanese military airstrike on a market in Tora village, Darfur, Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/sudan-aid-groups-say-54-killed-in-an-airstrike-blamed-on-the-military-in-darfur/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-03-25-1-1"></a>

Context: March 2025 South Korea wildfires.

**Archived source account.** A wildfire in Uiseong County, South Korea, spreads uncontrollably to the north and east, resulting in at least 16 deaths and forcing tens of thousands of civilians to evacuate.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250325173500053>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-wildfires-dry-winds-sancheong-2485c8d2af33d66d9e549e6945ef79e8>).

<a id="event-2025-03-25-1-3"></a>

Context: Aviation accidents and incidents.

**Archived source account.** Three people are injured when two Alpha Jet planes from the French Air and Space Force aerobatics team Patrouille de France crash after a mid-air collision during rehearsals.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250326-three-survive-mid-air-crash-of-french-air-force-acrobatics-team>).

<a id="event-2025-03-25-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.7 magnitude earthquake hits New Zealand causing a tsunami warning to be issued. A tsunami was then spotted in Fiordland.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/67-southland-quake-struck-in-tsunami-prone-region-poorly-understood-by-scientists/MLZSBREMVZHXZNYS5B2QX2FKPI/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-03-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Turkish protests.

**Archived source account.** Over 1,400 Turkish civilians, including several journalists, are detained for participating in anti-government protests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/25/europe/turkey-protests-journalists-arrested-intl-latam/index.html>).

Context: Criticism of Unification Church in Japan.

Context: Second Syrian transitional government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-president-al-sharaa-forms-new-transitional-government-2025-03-29/>).

Context: German space programme.

**Archived source account.** The uncrewed German-built Spectrum orbital rocket is launched in Andøya, Norway, becoming the first orbital rocket to launch from mainland Europe. The rocket stays in the air for just over half a minute before striking the ground and exploding.

### 2025-03-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1286634629](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20March%2031&oldid=1286634629>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-03-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / War crimes in the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** The bodies of fourteen aid workers killed on March 23 are recovered from a mass grave in southern Gaza. One body had previously been recovered and one more is believed to remain buried. Of the sixteen workers, nine are members of the Palestine Red Crescent Society, six are civil defense workers, and one is a UN agency employee.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/31/middleeast/aid-workers-found-gaza-mass-grave-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-03-31-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2025-03-31-0-7"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian IRGC Navy seizes two foreign oil tankers in the Persian Gulf and is towing the vessels to the country's Bushehr port, claiming they are part of a "fuel-smuggling network". It is currently unknown what countries the vessels belong to.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/31/iran-s-irgc-seizes-two-foreign-tankers-carrying-smuggled-diesel-fuel>).

<a id="event-2025-03-31-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2561937-van-vogel-naar-vis-nieuw-geld-voor-curacao-en-sint-maarten>).

<a id="event-2025-03-31-2-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/heathrow-airport-bus-car-crash-deaths-roads-b2725169.html>).

Context: Australia–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The Royal Australian Air Force deploys a long-range maritime patrol aircraft P-8 Poseidon to Kadena Air Base in Okinawa Prefecture, Japan, to monitor North Korean maritime activities in the Yellow Sea, including weapons shipments prohibited under international sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [NK News](<https://www.nknews.org/2025/03/australia-deploys-aircraft-to-monitor-north-koreas-illicit-maritime-activities/>).

Context: Brazil–Syria relations.

Source citations (as archived): [G1](<https://g1.globo.com/ms/mato-grosso-do-sul/noticia/2025/03/28/vice-consul-da-siria-e-preso-com-mais-de-600-aparelhos-eletronicos-contrabandeados-em-ms.ghtml>).

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/us-sanctions-6-over-hong-kong-security-crackdown/a-72101752>).

Context: Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland, Denmark–United States relations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/greenland-trump-denmark-ff85e2f04c5e967b1bbd7714b9972bf8>).

Context: Killing of Zvi Kogan.

**Archived source account.** A court in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, sentences three people to death for killing Israeli-Moldovan rabbi Zvi Kogan in 2024. A fourth accomplice who aided in the murder receives a life sentence.
