#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-04-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Tariffs in the second Trump administration / China–United States trade war, 2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico / Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Donald Trump announced additional import tariffs: a 10% baseline scheduled for April 5 and higher country-specific rates for April 9, including 20% for the EU and 34% for China, subject to exclusions.

Editorial date: 2025-04-02. Checked: 2026-10-21. These are announced rates and dates, not a description of later implementation changes or total accumulated duties.

Evidence: [White House executive order](<https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/04/regulating-imports-with-a-reciprocal-tariff-to-rectify-trade-practices-that-contribute-to-large-and-persistent-annual-united-states-goods-trade-deficits/>); [White House, Annex I](<https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Annex-I.pdf>).

Original source account: U.S. president Donald Trump announces a universal 10% tariff on most imports into the United States, a 20% tariff on goods from the European Union, and a 34% tariff on all imports from China. The tariffs will take effect from April 5.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2025-04-02-2-4"></a>

Context: Tariffs in the second Trump administration / China–United States trade war, 2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico / Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech.

**Archived source account.** Exceptions include Canada, Cuba, Mexico, North Korea, and Russia. Canada and Mexico had tariffs placed on them in February, while Cuba, North Korea, and Russia are under U.S. sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c1dr7vy39eet>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20250402-live-us-stocks-fall-ahead-of-trump-s-liberation-day-tariff-announcement>); [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/russia-canada-north-korea-and-mexico-among-countries-missing-from-donald-trump-reciprocal-tariff-list-2703234-2025-04-03>).

<a id="event-2025-04-02-2-5"></a>

Context: Tariffs in the second Trump administration / China–United States trade war, 2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico / Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech.

**Archived source account.** In the 10% tariff, the U.S. lists the Australian territory of Heard Island and McDonald Islands near Antarctica, despite the fact that it has no human inhabitants, imports or exports. In response to finding these islands in the list, Australian prime minister Anthony Albanese commented that "Nowhere on earth is safe" for the tariff.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/apr/03/donald-trump-tariffs-antarctica-uninhabited-heard-mcdonald-islands>).

### 2025-04-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1299813446](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20April%2016&oldid=1299813446>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-04-16-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kherson strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russian artillery and glide bombs target Kherson, Ukraine, killing one person and injuring nine others. A sports facility, a supermarket, and residential buildings were among those hit.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-kherson-glide-bombs-72f7bda22f4fb8c990a026d55f4ce66e>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Dnipro strikes.

**Archived source account.** A large-scale drone attack on Dnipro, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, kills two people and injures 16 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/mass-drone-attack-kills-one-injures-seven-ukraines-dnipro-governor-says-2025-04-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2025 Shabelle offensive.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants capture the Adan Yabal District in Middle Shabelle, Somalia, as the group continues to advance towards the capital Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-shabaab-captures-strategic-somalia-town-it-presses-offensive-2025-04-16/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-04-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Tariffs in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** California Governor Gavin Newsom and California Attorney General Rob Bonta file a lawsuit against U.S. President Donald Trump and his administration over the tariffs, making California the first U.S. state to do so. The lawsuit also targets the International Economic Emergency Powers Act, the law used by Trump to impose tariffs against Canada, China, and Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2025/04/16/california-is-first-state-to-sue-trump-on-tariffs-00292637>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-04-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities recover the remains of a Filipino crew member from the sand barge Hong Hai 16 that capsized off Occidental Mindoro, Philippines, yesterday, bringing the total death toll to two. Nine others are reportedly still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/942984/death-toll-of-capsized-ship-off-mindoro-now-2-pcg-searching-for-survivors/story/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The HB Kongolo traveling from Matankumu to Bolomba, carrying around 400 people, catches fire and capsizes on the Congo River near Mbandaka, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing at least 50 people and leaving hundreds more missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-accident-fire-fb3aa610c4690348998803b3f3a1b50d>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and two others are injured when two boats collide on Lewis Smith Lake in Cullman County, Alabama, United States, during a Major League Fishing tournament.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/alabama-boat-collision-smith-lake/story?id=120887192>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-04-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom suspends the import of cheese and meat products from the European Union to prevent the spread of foot-and-mouth disease.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2vpp8zzd7o>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-04-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Brazil–Peru relations, Aftermath of the Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Following her sentencing to 15 years in prison, former First Lady of Peru Nadine Heredia and her son Samin flee to Brazil's capital Brasília after the country grants their right of asylum.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/peru-nadine-heredia-ollanta-humala-asylum-brazil-bfc9c4b0a8862bfb3bdb5aae04100808>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-04-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Democratic backsliding in Slovakia, 2025 Slovak protests.

**Archived source account.** The Slovak government passes a law requiring non-governmental organizations to disclose their funding sources and the names of major donors. Opposition groups criticize the law as it could restrict civil society institutions.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/slovakia-passes-law-on-ngos-amid-criticism/a-72268853>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/slovakia-adopts-russian-bill-targeting-ngos/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-5-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Lebanese conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese military detains a group of people, including several Palestinians, for firing rockets towards Israel in two separate attacks. Hezbollah denies their involvement in the rocket attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-israel-rockets-palestinians-detained-hamas-7c2be638daa75ecc39e5c89515d616b7>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-5-5"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in the United Kingdom, For Women Scotland Ltd v The Scottish Ministers.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom rules that legal gender is based upon biological sex for the purposes of the Equality Act 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvg7pqzk47zo>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A German palliative care doctor is charged for allegedly killing fifteen patients between 2021 and 2024 in Berlin. He is being investigated in an additional 75 suspected cases and also accused of trying to cover up the evidence by starting fires in their homes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-palliative-doctor-patients-deaths-berlin-fires-637c1779ca95cd085d80cb76ab2e5c12>); [Tagesschau](<https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/regional/berlin/palliativarzt-mord-anklage-berlin-100.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-04-16-6-1"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** The leader of the Sudanese Rapid Support Forces, Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, announces the establishment of the Government of Peace and Unity, a rival government to the country's armed forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgrgqjq8ynzo>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-04-16-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A research team at the University of Cambridge announces that the James Webb Space Telescope has detected dimethyl sulfide, a chemical thought to be produced in nature only by living organisms, on exoplanet K2-18b, a sub-Neptune planet around 124 light-years (38 pc) away from Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c39jj9vkr34o>).

<a id="event-2025-04-16-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A colossal squid is filmed in the Southern Atlantic Ocean for the first time since the species was discovered in 1925. The 30 cm-long juvenile was filmed by a team of scientists led by the University of Essex near the South Sandwich Islands at a depth of 600 m.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c99pg13yv32o>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-04-16-8-1"></a>

Context: Women's World Chess Championship 2025.

**Archived source account.** Chinese grandmaster Ju Wenjun wins her fifth consecutive Women's World Chess Championship title after defeating fellow Chinese grandmaster Tan Zhongyi with a score of 6.5–2.5. Ju becomes the first Chinese player to win the championship five times.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/17/sport/ju-wenjun-womens-world-chess-championship-spt-intl/index.html>).

### 2025-04-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1286365299](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20April%2017&oldid=1286365299>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-04-17-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Rafah offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces begins the expansion of the recently-established Morag Corridor buffer zone to include the southern Gaza city of Rafah, intending to connect it with the Philadelphi Corridor. Witnesses report the Israeli demolition of structures in Rafah.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://aje.io/sk8e1a?update=3649238>); [RBC Ukraine](<https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/israel-intensifies-operation-in-gaza-strip-1744845608.html>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Rafah offensive.

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people, including children, are killed in a series of Israeli strikes against displaced Palestinians in the Gaza Strip, according to the Palestinian Civil Defence agency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yrl891j23o>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-0-6"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis / March–April 2025 United States attacks in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy launches a wave of missile strikes across Houthi-controlled Yemen, killing at least one person in Sanaa.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/yemen-houthis-us-airstrikes-israel-hamas-war-7d9f3288f71746df4aeed7ce41b5bb47>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-0-9"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2025 Shabelle offensive, American military intervention in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** U.S. airstrikes kill twelve al-Shabaab insurgents in central Somalia, while a separate airstrike destroys an unflagged vessel suspected of carrying weapons for the militant group off the Somali coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/airstrike-army-attack-kill-dozens-al-shabaab-fighters-somalia-government-says-2025-04-17/>); [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20250417-somali-us-air-strikes-kill-al-shabaab-fighters-hit-weapons-ship-says-government/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-04-17-1-1"></a>

Context: Kočani nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the fire at a nightclub in Kočani, North Macedonia, in March increases to 62 as a burn victim dies in the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Sloboden Pečat](<https://www.slobodenpecat.mk/pochina-24-godishniot-stojanche-stefanov-povreden-vo-pozharot-vo-kochani/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-1-3"></a>

Context: Monte Faito cable car crash.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and one is injured after the collapse of an aerial tramway on the Monte Faito in Campania, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [Il Messaggero](<https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/monte_faito_funivia_incidente_cavo_rotto_precipita_cabina_passeggeri_ultime_notizie-8785431.html>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the capsized Hong Hai 16 two days ago off Occidental Mindoro, Philippines, rises to four. Seven others are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine News Agency](<https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1248317>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A middle school student is killed and several others are injured when a school bus returning from a field trip blows a tire, strikes a guard rail, and overturns on Interstate 77 in Chester County, South Carolina, United States. Two other buses travelling back from the field trip maneuvered to avoid crashing into it. Between the three buses, at least 35 students and four adults were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/school-bus-overturns-chester-county-south-carolina/story?id=120926898#amp_ct=1744936183826&amp;amp_tf=From%20%251$s&amp;aoh=17449361582666&amp;referrer=https://www.google.com&amp;amp_gsa=1&amp;amp_js_v=a9&amp;id=120926898&amp;usqp=mq331AQIUAKwASCAAgM=>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-04-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Tropic Air Flight 711.

**Archived source account.** A hijacker is killed and three others are injured when a U.S. citizen hijacks a Tropic Air Cessna 208 Caravan and attacks passengers with a knife before being fatally shot by a passenger with a firearm at Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport in Belize City, Belize.

<a id="event-2025-04-17-2-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Florida State University shooting.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and six others are hospitalized in a mass shooting at Florida State University in Tallahassee, Florida, United States. The suspect is arrested by local police.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/florida-state-university-shooter-alert-bf66a24ea91959697c7138089b2ef6fb>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/04/17/us/fsu-shooting-tallahassee.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/live-blog/florida-state-university-active-shooter-rcna201756>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-2-5"></a>

Context: Illegal drug trade in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkish police detain 525 suspected drug dealers in Ankara, in what is the biggest narcotics operation in the country's history, involving thousands of officers, sniffer dogs, drones, and helicopters, according to the interior ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-drug-raids-arrests-ankara-4d3a67fc68fa197c9fb50f632ca4b14d>); [Türkiye Today](<https://www.turkiyetoday.com/turkiye/525-turkish-drug-dealers-detained-in-massive-raid-in-ankara-145920/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Myanmar pardons and releases 4,893 prisoners, including thirteen foreigners who will be deported from the country, and 22 political prisoners, ahead of the country's New Year.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-junta-pardons-4900-prisoners-to-mark-new-year/a-72271886>); [Radio Free Asia](<https://www.rfa.org/english/myanmar/2025/04/17/myanmar-new-year-amnesty-release/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-17-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are severely injured in a stabbing attack at an Aldi supermarket in Rochlitz, Saxony, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-rochlitz-supermarket-stabbing-leaves-2-injured/a-72284065>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-04-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Chris Van Hollen meets with Kilmar Abrego Garcia in El Salvador to push for his release after being denied a meeting hours earlier by the Salvadoran government.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2025/04/17/van-hollen-visit-kilmar-abrego-garcia-el-salvador-00298258>).

### 2025-04-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1319399226](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20April%2030&oldid=1319399226>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-04-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis / US–UK airstrikes on Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The Royal Air Force launches airstrikes on buildings they claimed were used by the Houthis to manufacture drones south of Sanaa, Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/uk-military-launches-airstrikes-with-us-targeting-yemens-houthi-rebels/>).

<a id="event-2025-04-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Puntland–Somaliland dispute / Las Anod conflict, Puntland–Somaliland prisoner exchange.

**Archived source account.** Puntland releases fifteen prisoners of war in exchange for Somaliland releasing eleven combatants captured during the conflict in the contested Sool region. This is the second prisoner exchange of prisoners captured during the conflict in Las Anod.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Apr/201344/puntland_and_somaliland_exchange_prisoners_captured_during_las_anod_conflict.aspx>); [Horn Observer](<https://hornobserver.com/articles/3308/Puntland-and-Somaliland-Set-to-Exchange-Prisoners-in-Landmark-Agreement>).

<a id="event-2025-04-30-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / North Korean involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** South Korean intelligence claims North Korean troops have suffered around 4,700 casualties, including about 600 fatalities among 15,000 soldiers. Their combat capability has also significantly improved, with increasing proficiency in new weapons such as drones.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/north-korean-soldiers-ukraine-1.7522405>).

<a id="event-2025-04-30-0-10"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Colombian government says fifteen police officers and twelve soldiers have been killed over the past two weeks in targeted attacks by the Gulf Clan cartel and other armed groups.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czx1e0x762lo>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-04-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Nigeria and the International Monetary Fund.

**Archived source account.** Nigeria fully repays its US$3.4 billion debt to the International Monetary Fund that it borrowed during the COVID-19 pandemic. It is expected to pay some residual honorary charges for special withdrawing rights of US$30 million annually.

Source citations (as archived): [Jamaica Observer](<https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2025/05/15/nigeria-repays-us3-4-billion-debt-support-imf/>); [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-xl/asia/pakistan/nigeria-clears-imf-debt-ahead-of-schedule-exits-debtor-list/ar-AA1EQDGs>).

<a id="event-2025-04-30-1-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Ukraine sign the Ukraine–United States Mineral Resources Agreement to share profits from the future sales of Ukraine's mineral and energy reserves.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5ypw7pn9q3o>).

#### Disasters and accidents

Context: 2025 Israel fires.

**Archived source account.** Wildfires rage out of control in at least 100 different locations throughout Israel and the West Bank, prompting the Israeli government to declare a state of emergency and forcing evacuations near Jerusalem. At least 40 people are reportedly injured due to the fires.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/30/middleeast/israel-wildfires-jerusalem-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2025-04-30-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenyan parliament member Charles Ong'ondo is shot to death in Nairobi by unknown gunmen on a motorcycle in an apparent assassination.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/creq4gz0grzo>).

<a id="event-2025-04-30-3-2"></a>

Context: Belarus–United States relations.

#### Health and environment

**Archived source account.** The world's oldest person, Brazilian nun Inah Canabarro Lucas, dies at the age of 116 years and 326 days. The new oldest living person is British supercentenarian Ethel Caterham, who is the last person born in the 1900s decade, the last living subject of King Edward VII, and the oldest British person ever.

**Archived source account.** North America's three largest measles outbreaks continue to expand, with over 2,500 confirmed cases. U.S. President Donald Trump later nominates Waltz as the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations.

<a id="event-2025-05-06-3-0"></a>

### 2025-05-08

<a id="event-2025-05-08-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2025-05-08-1-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/article/vultures-rescued-from-mass-poisoning-in-south-african-game-reserve/>).

Context: Abundant Life Christian School shooting.

**Archived source account.** The father of Natalie Rupnow, the perpetrator of the shooting that killed three people, including herself, and injured six others at the Abundant Life Christian School in Madison, Wisconsin, United States, in December 2024, is charged with felonies in connection with the shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/father-of-15-year-old-who-killed-2-at-wisconsin-religious-school-faces-felony-charges/>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce9vzzxpdm7o>).

<a id="event-2025-05-08-2-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Toronto Sun](<https://torontosun.com/news/world/sadistic-ms-13-gang-member-sentenced-for-horrific-hacking-deaths>).

Context: 2025 papal conclave.

**Archived source account.** Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost of the United States is elected to the papacy on the fourth ballot and takes the name Leo XIV. He is the first pope from North America and the second from the Americas, after Pope Francis. A dual citizen of the United States and Peru, he also becomes the second South American pope.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/new-pope-conclave-day-two-05-08-25>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/may/08/new-pope-conclave-vatican-white-black-smoke-papacy-catholic-cardinals>).

<a id="event-2025-05-11-1-5"></a>

Evidence: [La Jornada, Alfredo Valadez](<https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2025/05/11/estados/muere-hombre-al-caer-de-un-globo-aerostatico-en-festival-de-zacatecas>).

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2025-05-21-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel's Foreign Ministry releases saying that after the delegation "deviated from the approved route", Israeli soldiers fired "warning shots" to distance them away.

Source citations (as archived): [a statement](<https://x.com/israelmfa/status/1925167721425080617>); [Time](<https://time.com/7287468/european-leaders-summon-israeli-ambassadors-warning-shots-diplomats/>).

<a id="event-2025-05-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Guyana–Venezuela territorial dispute.

**Archived source account.** Guyana Defence Force brigadier general Omar Khan warns Venezuelans living in Guyana against participating in the May 25 referendum on the Essequibo proposed by the Venezuelan government, with Khan saying that they will risk arrest for "treason and other felonies" as well as deportation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/guyana-venezuela-elections-essequibo-dispute-a74a9e86bb8ccffe8744a0068cba8502>).

<a id="event-2025-05-21-3-7"></a>

Context: Kenya–Uganda relations.

**Archived source account.** Kenya admits that it assisted Uganda in the kidnapping of opposition politician Kizza Besigye in Nairobi in November 2024. Besigye was later taken to Uganda, where he is currently on trial.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/kenya-admits-role-in-kidnapping-of-uganda-opposition-leader-a3fdae4b>).

<a id="event-2025-05-21-3-9"></a>

Context: South Africa–United States relations, White genocide conspiracy theory.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump confronts South African president Cyril Ramaphosa at the White House during a state visit by Ramaphosa, claiming that there is a genocide against Afrikaners in South Africa, which Ramaphosa strongly denied.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/under-attack-by-trump-south-africas-ramaphosa-responds-with-trade-deal-offer-2025-05-21/>).

<a id="event-2025-05-21-4-2"></a>

Context: Violent incidents in reaction to the Gaza war / 2025 killing of Israeli Embassy workers in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** Two Israeli Embassy staffers are shot and killed outside the Capital Jewish Museum in Washington, D.C., after attending an American Jewish Committee event at the museum. The suspect is arrested at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/rcna208427>).

<a id="event-2025-05-21-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Andriy Portnov, former People's Deputy of Ukraine and aide to former president Viktor Yanukovych, is assassinated in Madrid, Spain, by unidentified gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/aide-to-former-ukrainian-president-shot-dead-in-madrid-13372008>).

<a id="event-2025-05-21-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentine president Javier Milei issues a decree limiting the right to strike for several services, banning some trade unions from further suspending operations as a method of protest.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://www.abc.es/internacional/gobierno-milei-limita-decreto-derecho-huelga-argentina-20250521230811-nt.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-05-21-5-2"></a>

Context: 2024–25 UEFA Europa League / 2025 UEFA Europa League final.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Tottenham Hotspur wins the Europa League, its first trophy since 2008, after defeating Manchester United 1–0 in the final played at San Mamés Stadium in Bilbao, Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/05/21/sport/tottenham-win-europa-league-manchester-united-spt>).

### 2025-05-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-05-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 80 Palestinians are killed in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/5/22/live-israel-kills-87-in-gaza-shots-fired-near-diplomats-in-west-bank>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-05-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2025 San Diego Cessna Citation II crash.

**Archived source account.** Six people are presumed dead (including Daniel Williams, former drummer of metalcore band The Devil Wears Prada), eight others are injured, about 100 people are displaced, and damage to houses and vehicles are reported when a Cessna Citation II aircraft crashes on approach to Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport in the military neighborhood of Murphy Canyon in San Diego, California, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/plane-crash-san-diego-5e465454fc0282a81adafc1bfdc142a1>); [KNSD-TV](<https://www.nbcsandiego.com/news/local/murphy-canyon-plane-crash-live-updates/3831321/?cardId=1:13:3832011>).

<a id="event-2025-05-22-1-3"></a>

Context: 2025 New South Wales floods.

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed in major flooding in various Mid North Coast areas of New South Wales, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Nine News Australia](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/nsw-flooding-live-updates-latest-updates-news-warnings-evacuations-forecast/e02ae797-db4e-4084-b01e-7a51ce6acbd3>).

<a id="event-2025-05-22-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 17 more are missing after heavy rains triggered landslides in Guizhou, China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/twenty-one-people-missing-heavy-rains-soak-southern-china-triggering-landslides-2025-05-22/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-05-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Argentina–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan interior minister Diosdado Cabello announces the arrest of several foreign citizens on "conspiracy" charges. The government of Argentina acknowledged the arrest of an Argentine citizen and warned Argentines against travelling to Venezuela, accusing the Venezuelan government of "taking hostages".

Source citations (as archived): [MercoPress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2025/05/22/argentine-national-among-alleged-conspirators-arrested-in-venezuela>).

<a id="event-2025-05-22-2-3"></a>

Context: Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute, Mauritius–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British prime minister Keir Starmer signs a deal formally handing over sovereignty of the disputed Chagos Archipelago in its entirety to Mauritius. The UK and United States will retain control of the Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia for 99 years as part of the deal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/clyvv04wk8zt>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-05-22-3-0"></a>

<a id="event-2025-05-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem orders the termination of Harvard University's Student and Exchange Visitor Program certification, removing the institution's ability to enroll new international students and requiring current international students to transfer or lose their legal status.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-blocks-harvards-ability-enroll-international-students-nyt-reports-2025-05-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-05-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Philippine general election, 2025 Philippine cabinet reshuffle.

**Archived source account.** Philippine president Bongbong Marcos reshuffles the entire Cabinet, with all Cabinet secretaries ordered to submit their courtesy resignations in the wake of the results of the midterm elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/philippines/marcos-cabinet-courtesy-resignation-may-2025/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-marcos-asks-cabinet-secretaries-resign-enable-reset-2025-05-22/>).

### 2025-05-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1292665293](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20May%2023&oldid=1292665293>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

**Archived source account.** After the capture of Omdurman and the consequent end of the battle of Khartoum, Sudanese Armed Forces find a mass grave with around 465 bodies located in Omdurman.

Source citations (as archived): [The North Africa Post](<https://northafricapost.com/87267-sudans-army-claims-rsf-mass-graves-were-discovered-in-omdurman.html>).

<a id="event-2025-05-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Prisoners of war in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Ukraine begin the largest prisoner exchange since the war began in February 2022, consisting of three days and 1,000 prisoners of war from each side.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/05/23/nx-s1-5408714/ukraine-russia-prisoners-exchange>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/23/europe/ukraine-and-russia-biggest-prisoner-exchange-war-intl>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-05-23-1-1"></a>

Context: European Union–United States relations, Tariffs in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump announces the implementation of 50% tariffs on all goods imported from European Union countries starting June 1. European stock exchanges including the German DAX, the French CAC 40, and the British FTSE 100 report losses afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/trump-calls-for-50-tariffs-on-eu-imports-from-june-1/a-72648246>).

#### Disasters and accidents

**Archived source account.** At least 260 miners are trapped after a collapse at the KDC gold mine near Carletonville, Gauteng, South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/rescue-efforts-underway-260-workers-trapped-south-african-122105145>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-05-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Canada–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A group of U.S. senators visit Ottawa, Canada, to meet with Canadian prime minister Mark Carney in an effort to maintain the relationship between the two countries amidst Trump's tariffs on the country and calls to make it the 51st state.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/05/23/us/senators-canada-meeting-trade.html>).

<a id="event-2025-05-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Israel–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British Minister of State for the Armed Forces Luke Pollard says that the UK "does not recognize" the comments made by Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu yesterday, where he accused British prime minister Keir Starmer, along with French president Emmanuel Macron and Canadian prime minister Mark Carney, of "siding with Hamas" and being on "the wrong side of humanity".

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/israel-gaza-latest-youre-on-wrong-side-of-humanity-netanyahu-launches-attack-on-starmer-after-killings-in-us-13362469>).

<a id="event-2025-05-23-3-5"></a>

Context: Guyana–Venezuela territorial dispute.

**Archived source account.** Guyanese Foreign Minister Hugh Todd says that Guyana will defend its sovereignty in the face of Venezuela's referendum next Sunday, passing a motion in parliament and reaffirming warnings that Venezuelans voting in the referendum in Guyana will be deported.

Source citations (as archived): [News Room Guyana](<https://newsroom.gy/2025/05/23/guyana-will-not-be-bullied-threatened-or-intimidated-parliament-debates-motion-on-sovereignty/>).

**Archived source account.** A court in Georgia places opposition figure Zurab Japaridze, a leader in the country's largest opposition group Coalition for Change, in pre-trial detention for failure to appear before a parliamentary inquiry, after the group led protests against the current government and the ruling party Georgian Dream.

Source citations (as archived): [Tagesschau](<https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/regional/hamburg/hamburg-hauptbahnhof-messerangriff-100.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/23/hamburg-train-station-stabbing-attack-germany>).

### 2025-05-25

### 2025-05-31

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-05-31-0-2"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State, Islamic State insurgency in Puntland / Puntland counter-terrorism operations.

**Archived source account.** In a dawn offensive, Puntland armed forces, backed by airstrikes from the Puntland Air Force and international allies, capture Miraale Valley, the largest ISIS stronghold in Bari Region and a militant hub for nearly a decade with water wells, cultivated land, and fortified positions. ISIS fighters retreat to Sadow, near Baalade, where other units are stationed.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/May/201698/puntland_forces_capture_key_isis_stronghold_in_togga_miraale.aspx>); [Garowe Online](<https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/soomaaliya-puntland-oo-gacanta-ku-dhigtay-xarunta-dhexe-ee-isis-ee-dooxada-miraale>); [Horseed Media](<https://horseedmedia.net/somalia-puntland-forces-capture-last-isis-stronghold-in-miraale-valley-in-the-cal-miskaad-mountains/405973/>).

<a id="event-2025-05-31-0-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Russia / 2025 Russia bridge collapses.

**Archived source account.** An explosion causes a bridge to collapse onto a passenger train with 379 occupants in Bryansk Oblast, Russia, killing at least seven and injuring 70 others, one seriously, including three children. The incident is being probed as an act of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7zjy89304o>).

This includes staff from humanitarian offices, agencies supporting refugees, and other critical sectors.

Context: 2025 Polish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Poles vote in the second round to choose their president. Right-wing populist President of the Institute of National Remembrance Karol Nawrocki wins 50.89% of popular vote over pro-European incumbent Mayor of Warsaw Rafał Trzaskowski.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jun/01/poland-goes-to-the-polls-in-second-round-of-close-fought-presidential-election>); [TVN24](<https://tvn24.pl/polska/wybory-prezydenckie-2025-kto-wygral-dane-pkw-ze-100-procent-obwodow-glosowania-st8491422>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/2/karol-nawrocki-wins-polands-presidential-election-media-reports-say>).

<a id="event-2025-06-01-3-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Mexican judicial elections.

**Archived source account.** Nationwide elections are held to elect over 2,700 members of the Mexican judiciary branch in the first ever judicial election in the country's history.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-votes-first-judicial-election-amid-concerns-over-rule-law-2025-06-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-01-3-5"></a>

Context: 2025 South Korean presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Independent presidential candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn resigns from his candidacy for the upcoming presidential election and declares his support for People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo.

Source citations (as archived): [The Chosun Ilbo](<https://www.chosun.com/english/national-en/2025/06/01/TW2LTDSEHNDYBC46QQVPMS4YWI/>).

Context: 2025 CONCACAF Champions Cup.

**Archived source account.** Cruz Azul defeat the Vancouver Whitecaps 5–0 in the final of the CONCACAF Champions Cup at the Olympic University Stadium in Mexico City.,

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://eu.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/2025/06/01/concacaf-champions-cup-cruz-azul-vancouver-whitecaps/83985000007/>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250602-cruz-azul-thrash-vancouver-whitecaps-to-win-concacaf-champions-cup>).

### 2025-06-02

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-06-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2025 Shabelle offensive.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants reportedly seize control of Hawadley village in the Middle Shabelle region of Hirshabelle State following the withdrawal of Burundian forces under the AUSSOM from the strategic military base.

Source citations (as archived): [Kaab TV](<https://en.kaabtv.com/al-shabaab-militants-seize-control-of-hawadley-in-middle-shabelle-region/>); [FTL Somalia](<https://www.ftlsomalia.com/al-shabaab-seizes-hawadley-after-au-forces-withdraw/amp/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-0-5"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / American military intervention in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** New America, a Washington, D.C.-based think tank, reports that U.S. airstrikes in Somalia targeting Al-Shabaab and Islamic State militants resulted in up to 174 fatalities, including an estimated six to 30 civilian casualties, in 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/us-airstrikes-in-somalia-killed-up-to-174-people-in-2025-monitoring-group-says>); [New America](<https://www.newamerica.org/future-security/reports/americas-counterterrorism-wars/the-war-in-somalia/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Five police officers are killed after an ambush in a highway in the border municipality of Frontera Comalapa. Hours later, an attacker was arrested and authorities confirmed that the attack was a retaliation for the recent arrest of Aler Baldomero Samayoa Recinos, also known as “Chicharra,” leader of Los Huistas, a Guatemalan criminal group that established ties with both the Sinaloa Cartel and the CJNG.

Source citations (as archived): [Revista Proceso](<https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/estados/2025/6/3/detienen-uno-de-los-presuntos-responsables-de-emboscar-calcinar-cinco-policias-en-chiapas-352353.html>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cambodia says it will seek a ruling from the United Nations's International Court of Justice over border disputes with Thailand, which triggered a fatal military clash last week.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/cambodia-thailand-border-court-preah-vihear-dispute-ed4967fb809448ccf42542ea21de9839>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-06-02-1-1"></a>

Context: North Macedonia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** North Macedonia announces that it will remove import taxes on U.S. goods to seek a reciprocal measure from the United States, as Foreign Minister Timčo Mucunski says that the country is negotiating a free trade agreement with the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/north-macedonia-united-states-tariffs-trump-6ef2fed0413db8d6967ad4bb4153f05f>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-1-3"></a>

Context: Procurement in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission passes a measure to limit Chinese medical device supply bids on public contracts, alleging unfair access for EU companies to China's tenders. The measures are the first under the International Procurement Instrument.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/eu-backs-curbs-chinese-medical-device-firms-bidding-public-tenders-2025-06-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-1-5"></a>

Context: Tariffs in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** United States Midwest aluminum premiums rise by 164% after demand for aluminum in the physical market increased due to US president Donald Trump's plan to increase tariffs on imported steel and aluminum from 25% to 50%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aluminium-premium-us-buyers-soars-after-trump-doubles-tariffs-2025-06-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Damascus Securities Exchange reopens in Syria after six months of closure following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/business/economy/2025/06/02/damascus-stock-exchange-reopens-after-6month-closure>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-1-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Department of Transportation orders AirAsia to halt the sale of airline tickets in the country, citing alleged overpricing after reports revealed that fares on the airline's website significantly exceeded government-approved price ceilings.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-06-02/philippines-orders-airasia-move-shutdown-on-excessive-pricing>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-06-02-2-2"></a>

Context: 2025 Nigeria floods / 2025 Mokwa flood.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the flooding caused by torrential rain in Mokwa, Nigeria, increases to over 200.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/death-toll-in-nigeria-flooding-rises-to-at-least-200/video-72755995>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 41-year-old ski mountaineer dies after falling 3,000 feet while climbing Mount McKinley. His body was discovered two days later, on June 4.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/climber-falls-3000-feet-death-off-tallest-mountain/story?id=122522462>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-06-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump announces that the recent U.S. proposal for a deal on Iran's nuclear program does not allow any uranium enrichment by Iran, despite previous media reports to the contrary.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20250602-trump-iran-uranium-enrichment-nuclear>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-06-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Ukraine hold further negotiations in Istanbul, Turkey, resulting in an agreement for a prisoner of war exchange. Officials confirm that all sick and severely wounded prisoners of war, along with those younger than 25, will be exchanged. Russia and Ukraine also exchanged ceasefire proposals during the negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cgrg7kelk45t>).

<a id="event-2025-06-02-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Swedish commission recommends that international adoptions be stopped after an investigation found a series of abuses and fraud dating back decades. The commission was formed in 2021 following a report by Swedish newspaper Dagens Nyheter detailing Sweden's problematic international adoption system.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/sweden-adoption-846ce8d1fd20b680247254bc86eb4fee>).

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

Context: Gaza war / Rafah aid distribution incidents.

**Archived source account.** At least 27 Palestinians are killed by Israeli forces near an aid distribution centre in Rafah, Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-aid-06-03-2025-24ce3d395c7058362e650f2330a6476f>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-24-palestinians-killed-near-gaza-aid-site-medics-say-2025-06-03/>).

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Two people, including a suicide bomber, are killed near a Roman Catholic shrine in Kampala, Uganda, on Uganda Martyrs' Day. Police attribute the bombing to Allied Democratic Forces rebels.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/explosion-reported-near-catholic-shrine-ugandas-capital-2025-06-03/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-06-03-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A female doctor was attacked and beaten up by a 45-year old man in Koszalin, Poland. The woman was later hospitalized. Based on the information provided, police officers detained a 45-year-old man on a nearby street. At the time of his arrest, he continued to display aggression, so the decision was made to transport him to a specialist hospital for further observation and protection.

Source citations (as archived): [KoszalinInfo](<https://koszalininfo.pl/45-latek-napadl-na-lekarke-kobieta-trafila-do-szpitala/>).

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-jails-syrian-pro-assad-fighter-over-war-crimes/a-72776468>).

**Archived source account.** A French police officer goes on trial after being charged with killing 17-year-old Nahel Merzouk on June 27, 2023, whose death sparked the riots across France and other French territories.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/french-police-officer-go-trial-murder-teenager-2025-06-03/>).

Context: MI5 domestic abuse scandal.

**Archived source account.** MI5 apologizes to the UK High Courts for providing false evidence in regards to an agent who abused their partner.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/mi5-bbc-high-court-suella-braverman-london-b2762772.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4ge87g2lngo>).

<a id="event-2025-06-03-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two hundred and sixteen prisoners escape from a prison in the Malir District, Pakistan. During the escape, which was a result of panic caused by an earthquake, one prisoner is killed and two prison officers are injured. A search operation is ongoing and 80 prisoners have been recaptured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwyvwv0e55po>).

<a id="event-2025-06-03-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nineteen prisoners, including eleven members of the armed group West Papua National Liberation Army, escape from a prison in Nabire, Central Papua, Indonesia. Three prison staff were critically injured. A search around the city is ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [Tempo](<https://www.tempo.co/hukum/kronologi-19-anggota-opm-kabur-setelah-bacok-sipir-lapas-nabire-1633149>).

Context: Islamic State insurgency in Puntland / Puntland counter-terrorism operations.

The troops also destroy weapons caches and military equipment used by the group.

<a id="event-2025-06-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of the second Donald Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump signs a proclamation banning entry into the United States for nationals of 12 countries deemed "very high-risk" due to terrorist activity, hostile governments, and high visa overstay rates, while imposing additional restrictions on visitors from several others. Exemptions apply for select categories, including athletes and diplomats. Trump cited the recent firebombing attack in Boulder, Colorado, as reason for the ban.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/06/04/politics/trump-travel-ban-proclamation>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/06/04/nx-s1-5423787/trump-travel-ban>).

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2025/6/5/trump-bans-visas-for-new-foreign-students-at-harvard-0908>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1353718176](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20June%2010&oldid=1353718176>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-06-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution incidents.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-six Palestinians are killed by Israeli gunfire while trying to obtain aid in Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-aid-06-10-2025-fe6c6c36e302ee1766f1b0f2a7d5bc19>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kyiv strikes, Odesa strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches drone attacks on Kyiv and Odesa, Ukraine. In Odesa, drone attacks hit medical facilities and residential buildings, killing two people and injuring thirteen others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2jzp0ewe0o>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-0-7"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed, including two police officers, and 36 others are injured in nineteen bombings and shootings by FARC dissidents targeting police posts, municipal buildings and civilians in Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia. Another explosion is also reported in Jamundí.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250610-three-dead-as-wave-of-bombings-gun-attacks-rocks-colombia>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-multiple-dead-after-string-explosions-in-cali/a-72861011>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-06-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Fossil fuel phase-out.

**Archived source account.** The British government announces it will invest £14.2 billion (US$19 billion) to construct the new Sizewell C nuclear power station in Suffolk, England, to reduce the country's reliance on fossil fuels.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/uk-britain-nuclear-plant-suffolk-investment-27e13197344cf96b5b76c4503e5a8b9e>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/britain-invest-142-billion-pounds-sizewell-c-nuclear-project-2025-06-09/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Walt Disney Company closes a deal to acquire NBCUniversal's stake in the streaming service Hulu for $439 million, completing its acquisition of Hulu.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/disney-hulu-comcast-nbcuniversal-iger-876a9d6f00ffa6c037e9527bb8532682>); [Variety](<https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/disney-closes-hulu-deal-comcast-price-tag-1236423903/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-06-10-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Kenya bus crash.

**Archived source account.** Five tourists are killed and 35 others are injured in a bus crash in Gichage, Nyandarua County, Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/qatar/five-keralites-killed-in-tragic-bus-accident-in-kenya-1.500158981>); [Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/nri/latest-updates/five-indian-nationals-from-qatar-killed-in-a-road-accident-in-kenya/articleshow/121770390.cms?from=mdr>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-06-10-3-1"></a>

Context: War crimes in the Gaza war, Gaza humanitarian crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Norway impose sanctions on Israeli far-right ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Itamar Ben-Gvir, including asset freezes and travel bans, due to their conduct during the Gaza war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-sanction-israel-ministers-ben-gvir-smotrich-times-reports-2025-06-10/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-06-10-4-2"></a>

Context: Protests against Donald Trump / June 2025 Los Angeles protests.

**Archived source account.** Los Angeles mayor Karen Bass imposes a curfew to the Downtown Los Angeles area in California, United States, after several days of civil disobedience and public demonstrations against Immigrations and Customs Enforcement agents detaining locals.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/la-protests-live-downtown-la-declared-unlawful-assembly-area-after-third-day-2025-06-09/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/11/la-mayor-announces-curfew-amid-protests-over-trumps-immigration-crackdown>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-4-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Ballymena riots.

**Archived source account.** The second consecutive night of disorder in Ballymena, Northern Ireland, sees 17 police officers injured and five people arrested as protests spread to Belfast, Carrickfergus, and Newtownabbey.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0k3le25r8ro>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-4-6"></a>

Context: Graz school shooting.

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed, including the perpetrator, and several others are injured, in a mass shooting at a secondary school in Graz, Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/ce3vxrz6rpnt>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-4-8"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran hangs nine members of the Islamic State for a 2018 attack which killed three Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps personnel.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-executions-islamic-state-group-militants-2018-attack-7a86932a41dc3d321c69840e2e17e878>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Federal Police of Brazil arrest at least eleven people in an operation aiming to reduce drug trafficking in favelas in Rio de Janeiro.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-police-arrest-drugs-gangs-favela-61406e8418a7028f816ce7dfcd3b22ea>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Argentina ratifies the sentence of former president Cristina Fernández de Kirchner to six years in prison and a lifetime disqualification from holding public office for the crime of fraudulent administration.

Source citations (as archived): [La Nación](<https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/la-corte-suprema-confirmo-la-condena-a-cristina-kirchner-a-prision-y-no-podra-ser-candidata-nid10062025/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-06-10-5-1"></a>

Context: Impeachment of Sara Duterte.

**Archived source account.** The Senate of the Philippines votes 18–5 to return the articles of impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte to the House of Representatives for further deliberation.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/philippines/senate-returns-sara-duterte-impeachment-articles-house-representatives/>); [Inquirer.net](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2069279/sara-duterte-on-trial-22-senators-take-oath-as-senator-judges-2>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 15,000 people gather in Budapest, Hungary, to protest against Prime Minister Viktor Orbán and his government's conduct and alleged corruption relating to the ruling Fidesz party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/hungary-protest-orban-budapest-3ddc580235327dd06a73e38c66663536>).

<a id="event-2025-06-10-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Greece expels three lawmakers, including far-right politician Vasilis Stigkas, leader of the political party Spartans, due to their connection with and allegedly serving as proxies for the neo-Nazi criminal organization Golden Dawn.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/greece-far-right-lawmakers-expelled-spartans-golden-dawn-8379fb8f652d6e8428a5e44c931f028f>).

### 2025-06-11

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-06-11-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2025-06-11-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza war hostage crisis.

<a id="event-2025-06-11-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Gaza Health Ministry reports that the official death toll of Palestinians killed in the war since October 2023 has reached 55,000 people, with over 127,000 people wounded.

<a id="event-2025-06-11-0-9"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kharkiv strikes.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-06-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentine president Javier Milei is awarded the Genesis Prize during a state visit to Israel for his support for Israel, becoming the first non-Jewish person to receive such recognition.

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/politica/javier-milei-medidas-vivo-presidente-recibe-premio-nobel-judio-gira-israel_0_ivOw2nFlgR.html>); [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/jewish/2025-06-09/ty-article/.premium/unequivocal-support-for-israel-javier-milei-will-be-first-non-jew-to-win-jewish-nobel/00000197-54ad-d586-a3f7-fdaf6ffa0000>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-06-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian flag carrier Qantas announces the closure of its Singapore-based, partly owned low-cost airline Jetstar Asia due to rising costs and regional competition.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1e65yypd87o>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-06-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling.

**Archived source account.** At least eight migrants are found dead and 22 others are missing as the United Nations International Organization for Migration and the Djiboutian government launch a joint rescue operation after migrants were forced off a boat and forced to swim to shore off the coast of Djibouti.

**Archived source account.** At least 49 people are killed, including four schoolchildren, in flooding caused by heavy rainfall and snowfall in a winter storm in the Eastern Cape of South Africa.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-06-11-4-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 New York Peace Conference on Gaza.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration calls on countries not to attend a conference for ceasefire and peace in Gaza at the United Nations headquarters in New York City, New York, United States, and warns of potential diplomatic consequences should any measures be taken that are deemed hostile toward Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-warns-against-attending-un-conference-israel-palestinian-two-state-solution-2025-06-11/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-11-4-4"></a>

Context: Argentina–Israel relations.

**Archived source account.** Argentine president Javier Milei announces that the Argentine embassy in Israel will be moved to Jerusalem in 2026.

<a id="event-2025-06-11-4-6"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The military of South Korea shuts down its loudspeakers across the border with North Korea and stops its propaganda messages against the government of North Korea by order of President Lee Jae-myung to ease tensions between the countries.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-border-north-tensions-2ba545996b3daf1a9f81e23685792c11>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-06-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia.

**Archived source account.** A court in Moscow, Russia, sentences Leonid Volkov, an ally of Alexei Navalny, to 18 years in prison in absentia and fines him 2 million rubles (US$25,000) on criminal charges including justifying terrorism and organizing and financing an extremist group.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-courts-opposition-dissent-crackdown-ed6d394e8f1c8b6717bf1c07fa45d2e2>).

<a id="event-2025-06-11-5-2"></a>

Context: Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The same court places Lev Shlosberg, chair of the opposition social-liberal party Yabloko, under house arrest for two months for discrediting the Russian army.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-court-orders-house-arrest-politician-accused-discrediting-russian-army-2025-06-11/>).

### 2025-06-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1296103942](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20June%2012&oldid=1296103942>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-06-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Rafah aid distribution killings.

**Archived source account.** At least 103 Palestinians are killed by Israeli fire in the past 24 hours across the Gaza Strip, including 21 people this morning near Gaza Humanitarian Foundation (GHF) sites, according to the Gaza Health Ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/humanitarian-workers-killed-gaza-bus-ambush-that-israel-blames-hamas-2025-06-12/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Rafah aid distribution killings.

**Archived source account.** Eight Palestinian GHF workers are killed and several others are injured after their bus was attacked en route to an aid distribution site in southern Gaza. The GHF says that Hamas was responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/06/11/world/middleeast/gaza-aid-hamas-attack.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/humanitarian-workers-killed-gaza-bus-ambush-that-israel-blames-hamas-2025-06-12/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli invasion of Syria.

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces kill one person and detain seven people, all Syrians, whom they allege are Hamas members in an early-morning raid on the village of Beit Jinn in Rif Dimashq Governorate, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-israel-hamas-beit-jin-incursion-lebanon-843512c2af36aac7a10f14808cb996d1>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-06-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch-Israeli writer Yael van der Wouden wins the 2025 Women's Prize for Fiction for her novel The Safekeep, which was also shortlisted for the 2024 Booker Prize. British physician and writer Rachel Clarke wins the sister prize, the Women's Prize for Non-Fiction, for her book about palliative care, The Story of a Heart.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/womens-prize-fiction-nonfiction-winners-6581756b842a58e81d779e725cfae34d>); [The Bookseller](<https://www.thebookseller.com/news/yael-van-der-wouden-and-rachel-clarke-named-womens-prize-2025-winners>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-06-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Air India Flight 171.

**Archived source account.** An Air India Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner carrying 230 passengers and 12 crew members crashes into a residential area shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad Airport in Gujarat, India. Authorities find one survivor from the plane, and 204 bodies have been recovered from the crash site so far.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/air-india-plane-crash-ahmedabad-airport-5177241>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/london-bound-plane-carrying-more-than-200-people-crashes-after-takeoff-india>).

<a id="event-2025-06-12-2-3"></a>

Context: 2025 South Africa floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in the flooding caused by heavy rainfall and snowfall from a winter storm in Eastern Cape, South Africa, increases to 57, with several others still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/rescuers-south-africa-search-missing-after-floods-death-122761587>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-06-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The International Atomic Energy Agency finds Iran in breach of its obligations to limit uranium enrichment and provision of information on its nuclear materials.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce3v6w2qr12o>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jun/12/un-watchdog-finds-iran-failing-comply-nuclear-obligations>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-06-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Disappearance of Annie McCarrick.

**Archived source account.** A man in his 60s is arrested on suspicion of the murder of Annie McCarrick, who went missing in Dublin, Ireland, in 1993.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news/crime/2025/0612/1518029-annie-mccarrick/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-12-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Internal Security Agency of Poland announce the arrest of a teenager in Olsztyn, Warmian–Masurian Voivodeship, accused with two other men, arrested in April, of planning a far-right terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/poland-olsztyn-arrest-terrorist-plot-cbc25a9b2eeec1f84cf9d8db7806c734>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-06-12-5-1"></a>

Context: Constitutional crisis in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Somalia's federal government calls for the dissolution of the C6+ international coordination framework, saying it is outdated and misrepresents the country’s current political and security progress.

Source citations (as archived): [Garowe Online](<https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-labels-c6-obsolete-as-opposition-withdraws-from-dialogue>); [ChimpReports](<https://chimpreports.com/somalia-declares-c6-framework-obsolete-urges-shift-to-bilateral-engagement/>); [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jun/201833/somali_government_calls_for_dissolution_of_c6_framework_citing_obsolescence.aspx>).

<a id="event-2025-06-12-5-3"></a>

Context: June 2025 Los Angeles protests.

**Archived source account.** United States senator Alex Padilla of California is forcibly removed, pushed face-down to the ground, and handcuffed after attempting to ask Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem a question at a press conference in Los Angeles.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/alex-padilla-noem-immigration-protest-california-f67d220a0254473c53c16aa96f554239>).

<a id="event-2025-06-12-5-5"></a>

Context: Death of Albert Ojwang.

**Archived source account.** Police fire tear gas at demonstrators gathered in Nairobi, Kenya, to protest against the police and its chief, Eliud Lagat, after blogger Albert Ojwang is confirmed to be killed in custody by the police force, demanding Lagat's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/kenya-police-clash-with-protesters-over-bloggers-death/a-72886994>).

### 2025-06-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1341751982](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20June%2013&oldid=1341751982>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / Twelve-Day War.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force launches a bombing campaign against Iran targeting nuclear facilities with the main goal of the operation being to destroy Iran's nuclear program. A special state of emergency is declared in Israel by Defence Minister Israel Katz and Israeli airspace is closed to all flights. Iranian state television reports that 60 people were killed in the attacks, while Israel claims only three people died and dozens got injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / Twelve-Day War.

**Archived source account.** Israel also launches targeted assassination strikes against senior Iranian government officials, Iranian military leadership and senior nuclear scientists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-likely-killed-iranian-chief-staff-top-nuclear-scientists-official-2025-06-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / Twelve-Day War.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military confirms it has targeted nuclear facilities in Iran with the main goal of the operation being to destroy Iran's nuclear program. Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirms Israeli warplanes have targeted Iran's main Natanz Nuclear Facility. It is later confirmed that the underground nuclear reactor at Natanz has been destroyed by a bunker buster.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-857603>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-6"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / Twelve-Day War.

**Archived source account.** Iranian state media reports that all flights to and from Imam Khomeini International Airport have been suspended until further notice and that several residential buildings in Tehran have collapsed due to missile strikes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-june-12-2025/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-7"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / Twelve-Day War.

**Archived source account.** Israeli decapitation strikes kill commander-in-chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Hossein Salami, senior nuclear scientist and former head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran Fereydoon Abbasi, and chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran Mohammad Bagheri and Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/report-head-of-irans-elite-quds-force-killed-in-israeli-strike/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / Twelve-Day War.

**Archived source account.** Exiled crown prince Reza Pahlavi, the son of Iran's last Shah, writes in Farsi calling for the Iranian military to abandon the Islamic Republic and accuses Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei of forcing Iranians into the war. He also refers to the war as "Khamenei's war and the Islamic Republic's war".

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-857604>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-10"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / June 2025 Iranian strikes on Israel.

**Archived source account.** Iran launches over 100 Shahed drones and ballistic missiles towards Israel in retaliation for the strikes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/over-100-drones-launched-by-iran-at-israel-in-last-few-hours-idf-working-to-shoot-them-down/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-says-it-strikes-iran-amid-nuclear-tensions-2025-06-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-13-0-11"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict / June 2025 Iranian strikes on Israel.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and 172 others injured in Israel after Iran's retaliatory strikes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/2025-06-12/live-updates-857426>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-06-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Air India Flight 171.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the crash of an Air India Boeing 787 Dreamliner shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad Airport in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, yesterday rises to 279 as a police source says 38 ground fatalities are confirmed.

Context: Kincora Boys' Home scandal.

**Archived source account.** Gary Hoy, a survivor of child sexual abuse at Kincora, resolves a legal action against the Police Service of Northern Ireland and Home Secretary with an undisclosed agreement. The legal action alleged that paedophile housemaster William McGrath was allowed to target children to gather information about the far-right paramilitary organization Tara..

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news/courts/2025/0616/1518712-kincora-boys-home/>).

<a id="event-2025-06-16-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thai police raid a house in Samut Prakan province, Thailand, and arrest 13 foreigners, mostly Australians and British people, for running a fraudulent electronic trading platform that has stolen over AU$1.9 million (US$1.2 million).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-australia-investment-scam-fraud-502276cd2888240c71e5aa1aa647e9c1>).

### 2025-06-17

<a id="event-2025-06-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war / Rafah aid distribution killings.

<a id="event-2025-06-17-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2025-06-17-0-8"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Twelve-Day War / Airstrikes during the Iran–Israel War.

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kyiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces launch a total of 440 drones and 32 missiles at Kyiv, Ukraine, damaging buildings and public facilities, killing 28 people and wounding dozens more.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx24g4850x4o>).

<a id="event-2025-06-17-0-13"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Ministry of Defence says its air defence units have intercepted and destroyed 147 Ukrainian drones overnight.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx24g4850x4o>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-06-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Puntland–Yemen relations.

**Archived source account.** Seven Yemeni fishermen who were detained for nearly two months after entering Puntland waters without authorization from Puntland’s Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources are released. The fishermen were apprehended by the Puntland Maritime Police Force after their vessel was intercepted by the coastguard in the Ras Aseir region of Puntland.

Source citations (as archived): [The Eastleigh Voice](<https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia/165980/puntland-releases-seven-yemeni-fishermen-arrested-over-illegal-fishing-in-somali-waters>); [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jun/201899/puntland_frees_seven_yemeni_fishermen_after_nearly_two_months_in_custody.aspx>).

#### Sports

Context: 2025 Stanley Cup Final.

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, the Florida Panthers defeat the Edmonton Oilers in six games in a rematch of last year's final, repeating as Stanley Cup champions.

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nhl/florida-panthers/article308763290.html>).

### 2025-06-18

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war.
