#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-06-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Acquisition of U.S. Steel by Nippon Steel.

**Archived source account.** After 18 months of negotiations, Nippon Steel finalizes its $14.9 billion acquisition of U.S. Steel. The deal allows U.S. Steel to retain its name and headquarters in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and gives the U.S. government the ability to veto corporate decisions as needed.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/nippon-completes-acquisition-of-us-steel/a-72963465>); [Business Wire](<https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250617350553/en/Nippon-Steel-Corporation-and-U.-S.-Steel-Finalize-Historic-Partnership>).

<a id="event-2025-06-18-2-2"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States / United States v. Skrmetti.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court votes 6–3 to uphold a law proposed by Tennessee to ban gender-affirming care for minors, allowing other states to implement similar bans.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/06/18/nx-s1-5421276/scotus-transgender-kids-decision>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crr7ej97y0eo>).

<a id="event-2025-06-18-2-4"></a>

Context: Management of HIV/AIDS.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approves Gilead Sciences's new lenacapavir drug, marketed as Yeztugo, for the treatment of HIV after successful clinical trials show the drug nearly eliminated the infection spread.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/fda-hiv-prevention-drug-prep-lenacapavir-rcna208387>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/hiv-prevention-shot-lenacapavir-gilead-80fb37e2c5ac9b452488d7b86a10d568>).

Context: Córdoba Neonatal Hospital baby serial murders.

**Archived source account.** A court in Córdoba, Argentina, sentences nurse Brenda Agüero to life in prison for the serial murders of five babies and the attempted murder of eight others between March and June 2022, whom she deliberately injected with potassium and insulin.

Source citations (as archived): [Página 12](<https://www.pagina12.com.ar/835303-perpetua-para-la-enfermera-del-neonatal>).

**Archived source account.** Bryan Kohberger, the suspect in the 2022 killings of four University of Idaho students, pleads guilty to all charges, avoiding the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/bryan-kohberger-plead-guilty-counts-idaho-college-murders/story?id=123356808>).

<a id="event-2025-06-30-4-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Boulder fire attack.

**Archived source account.** The death of an 82-year-old woman who was severely injured in the firebombing attack earlier this month is announced by leaders of the Boulder Jewish Community Center.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/boulder-attack-death-e6e45ad5a6e6becab9026994c758e09b>).

<a id="event-2025-06-30-4-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Kenyan protests.

**Archived source account.** A civilian vendor shot at close range by police during protests over the death of Albert Ojwang in Nairobi, Kenya, succumbs to his injuries in hospital after being declared brain-dead, bringing the death toll from nationwide protests in Kenya to 20.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/kenyan-civilian-shot-at-close-range-by-police-during-protests-dies/>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/kenya-gen-z-protests-see-press-freedom-under-fire/a-73078878>).

<a id="event-2025-06-30-4-7"></a>

Context: Murder of Louisa Dunne.

**Archived source account.** Ryland Headley, a 92-year-old man, is convicted for the 1967 murder of Louisa Dunne, which is believed to be the UK's longest-running cold case ever to be solved.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/louisa-dunne-ryland-headley-bristol-b2779623.html>).

<a id="event-2025-06-30-4-9"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Twenty bodies, five of them decapitated, are found either hanging from a bridge or inside a van abandoned beneath, near Culiacán, Sinaloa, amid clashes between factions of the Sinaloa Cartel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jun/30/mexico-sinaloa-cartel-violence>).

<a id="event-2025-06-30-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Baku, Azerbaijan, raid the office of the Russian state-owned news agency Sputnik, alleging its operations in Azerbaijan are via "illegal financing" after its official accreditation was revoked in February.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-azerbaijan-police-raid-baku-2d900b44bf72bdd92a8a463ed48babfb>).

### 2025-07-01

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-07-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Luhansk Oblast campaign.

**Archived source account.** Head of the Luhansk People's Republic Leonid Pasechnik says that Russian forces have captured the entirety of the Luhansk Oblast in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-germany-d402df83478e83d86b30bd9b942d2532>).

<a id="event-2025-07-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A Ukrainian SBU drone attack on a military factory in Izhevsk, Russia, which produced Tor surface-to-air missile systems, kills three people and injures 45 others. A state of emergency is later declared by Head of the Udmurt Republic Aleksandr Brechalov.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cyvjj9lmq3zo>).

<a id="event-2025-07-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin claims responsibility for attacks on several Mali Armed Forces positions near Senegal in Mali. The Malian army spokesperson said 80 attackers were neutralized while there were no details on casualties among soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/al-qaida-linked-group-claims-attack-against-mali-army-position-near-senegal/>).

<a id="event-2025-07-01-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** A boy and some insurgents are killed and nine others are injured when dozens of militants armed with guns and rockets storm a police station and set fire to two banks before fleeing in Mastung District, Balochistan, Pakistan. The Balochistan Liberation Army is suspected to be behind the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/militants-in-pakistan-storm-a-police-station-and-set-fire-to-banks-killing-a-boy/>).

<a id="event-2025-07-01-1-3"></a>

### 2025-07-02

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** The 14th Dalai Lama, Tenzin Gyatso confirms that after his death there will be a reincarnated successor. Chinese officials reject this statement and announce that the next Dalai Lama will have to be born in China and his appointment will have to be approved by the government.

The helicopter carrying eight people had been arriving from an airfield in the Lower Shabelle region of Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/somalia-african-union-crash-mogadishu-aden-adde-969f61f53c502f6da4fd579bd22b26b5?utm_source=copy&amp;utm_medium=share>).

Source citations (as archived): [Minor Planet Center](<https://minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K25/K25N12.html>); [Earth Sky](<https://earthsky.org/space/new-interstellar-object-candidate-heading-toward-the-sun-a11pl3z/>).

Context: Internal conflict in Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/13/peru-amnesty-military-police-human-rights-abuses>).

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/ukrainian-woman-stabbed-death-train-attack/story?id=125360100>); [CNBC](<https://www.wcnc.com/article/news/crime/deadly-stabbing-charlotte-nc-8-22-2025/275-01918405-4783-40c8-963f-0a6dd86c70c6>).

<a id="event-2025-08-22-2-7"></a>

<a id="event-2025-08-22-2-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States district judge Christine Arguello of Colorado sentences former Gambian paramilitary member Michael Sang Correa to 67.5 years in prison after a jury found him guilty of torture and conspiracy to commit torture related to abuses committed in 2006 as part of ex-president Yahya Jammeh's death squad. The case marks the first successful U.S. federal conviction for torture under its extraterritorial jurisdiction.

Source citations (as archived): [TRIAL International](<https://trialinternational.org/latest-post/former-jungler-sentenced-to-over-67-years-for-torture/>).

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250823-nigerian-airforce-kills-at-least-35-jihadists-near-border-with-cameroon>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nigerias-military-airstrikes-killed-35-islamic-militants-borno-124922385>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-08-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven students are killed and 28 others are injured in drownings on a school trip to the Abu Talat beach in Ajami, Alexandria, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/arabic/articles/cjw6gv2w9d9o>); [People](<https://people.com/students-drown-more-injured-school-trip-beach-alexandria-egypt-11796421>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-08-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Dharmasthala mass burial case.

**Archived source account.** Indian police arrest a man who recently alleged that he had been coerced into burying hundreds of bodies of women who were raped before being murdered from 1995 to 2014 at the Dharmasthala Temple in Dharmasthala, Karnataka, India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgm2z9zjgx7o>).

<a id="event-2025-08-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Pork barrel scam.

**Archived source account.** The Sandiganbayan appellate court of the Philippines sentences Janet Lim-Napoles to 55 years in prison over the diversion of ₱7.55 million (US$133,600) in the Priority Development Assistance Fund involving Davao del Sur vice governor Marc Douglas Cagas IV.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2099327/napoles-again-convicted-3-others-also-guilty-in-pork-scam-case>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Syrian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian electoral commission announces that the upcoming parliamentary election will exclude the Al-Hasakah, Raqqa, and Suwayda governorates due to security concerns, with seats for those regions left vacant until conditions allow voting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-delays-parliamentary-vote-sweida-after-sectarian-violence-2025-08-23/>).

Context: 2025 Taiwanese referendum.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan's referendum on reopening the Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant in Pingtung fails to meet the legal threshold for it to be binding, despite a majority voting in favor, leaving the facility closed as the government continues its shift toward renewable energy and liquefied natural gas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/taiwan-nuclear-plant-re-opening-vote-fails-approval-threshold-missed-2025-08-23/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-08-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025–26 FIS Ski Jumping World Cup.

**Archived source account.** The International Ski and Snowboard Federation suspends Norwegian Olympic ski jumpers Johann André Forfang and Marius Lindvik for three months and fines them CHF 2,000 (US$2,500) each after they admitted to equipment tampering during the men's large hill event at the 2025 World Ski Championships in Trondheim, Norway.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sports/ski-jumping-norways-lindvik-forfang-accept-suspensions-over-suit-tampering-2025-08-23/>).

The Norwegian Police are treating it as terrorism with a racist and right-wing extremist motive as the perpetrator has expressed Islamophobic views.

Context: Porepunkah police shootings.

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are shot and killed and a third is wounded in a suspected sovereign citizen terrorist attack in Porepunkah, Victoria, Australia, sending the town into lockdown. The perpetrator remains at large.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-08-26/porepunkah-alleged-shooter-sovereign-citizen-dezi-freeman/105699366>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-26-5-1"></a>

Context: 2026 Colombian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Miguel Uribe Londoño, the father of assassinated Colombian senator Miguel Uribe Turbay, announces his candidacy for president in the upcoming election, seeking the Democratic Centre's nomination.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/colombia-miguel-uribe-father-presidential-candidate-murdered-security-69a664ed0d561ec424c27ef3dcea7817>).

<a id="event-2025-08-26-5-3"></a>

Context: Martial law in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian prime minister Yulia Svyrydenko announces that men aged 18 to 22 may now freely cross the border under martial law, reversing earlier restrictions that barred men aged 18 to 60 from leaving the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/ukrainian-men-aged-18-22-now-allowed-cross-border-freely-pm-says-2025-08-26/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-26-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lithuanian Seimas elects Inga Ruginienė as the country's new prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2025/08/26/former-labour-union-leader-inga-ruginiene-becomes-lithuanias-new-prime-minister>).

<a id="event-2025-08-26-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Marshall Islands' parliament building in Majuro, including its library and archives, burns down in a fire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/26/marshall-islands-parliament-fire-burns-down>).

### 2025-08-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1320676274](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20August%2027&oldid=1320676274>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-08-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

**Archived source account.** At least 24 people are killed and 55 injured after Sudan's Rapid Support Forces shell residential areas of Al-Fashir, North Darfur. The city remains under siege as the last military stronghold in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/sudan-military-rsf-darfur-el-fasher-d5f8bb5589f1c77b95c107bd72d15449>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-0-4"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and seven others are injured in alleged Pakistani airstrikes on Nangarhar Province and Khost Province, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/taliban-blames-pakistan-for-airstrikes-that-kill-3-people-in-eastern-afghanistan/ar-AA1LqlP8?ocid=winp1taskbar&amp;cvid=0fab9a2a350249e2adb0f5702965899c&amp;ei=7>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-08-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 70 migrants are killed after a boat carrying about 150 people, mostly Gambian and Senegalese nationals, sinks off the coast of Mauritania, while over 30 others remain missing and 16 are rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-70-killed-capsize-migrant-boat-off-west-africa-gambia-says-2025-08-30/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 65 people are killed in flash floods and landslides in Jammu and Kashmir, India.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-ca/weather/topstories/flash-floods-and-landslide-kill-dozens-in-indian-controlled-kashmir/ar-AA1LjcpD?ocid=winp1taskbar&amp;cvid=09d62ab106224ac8cf04b3fbcc96fd71&amp;ei=7>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-08-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Extreme temperatures in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Japan Meteorological Agency reports that Tokyo recorded ten consecutive days of temperatures at or above 35 C, the longest streak since observations began in 1875.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2025/08/27/tokyo-logs-record-10-days-of-35-deg-c-or-more-weather-agency>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-08-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Denmark–United States relations, Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland.

**Archived source account.** Danish foreign minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen summons the U.S. chargé d'affaires in Copenhagen after individuals linked to U.S. president Donald Trump conducted covert influence activities in Greenland.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-08-28/denmark-summons-us-envoy-people-carrying-influence-in-greenland/105705686>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Myanmar–Thailand relations.

**Archived source account.** Thailand announces that around 80,000 long-term Myanmar refugees living in border camps will be granted legal employment rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thailand-grants-some-myanmar-refugees-right-legal-work-2025-08-27/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-08-27-4-2"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States / Annunciation Catholic Church shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 18 more injured, including at least four critically, in a mass shooting at the Annunciation Church in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States in an alleged anti-Catholic hate crime. The suspect died by suicide at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/active-shooter-at-annunciation-church-in-minneapolis/>); [KNSI-AM](<https://knsiradio.com/2025/08/27/multiple-casualties-reported-at-minneapolis-church/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-4-4"></a>

Context: Assassination of Miguel Uribe Turbay.

**Archived source account.** A Colombian court sentences a 15-year-old to seven years in juvenile detention for attempted murder and criminal possession of a weapon in connection with the assassination of Senator Miguel Uribe Turbay in June.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20250828-teen-shooter-colombia-miguel-uribe>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Bolivian court grants opposition leader Luis Fernando Camacho's transfer to house arrest after more than two years in pre-trial detention, allowing him to resume his duties as Governor of Santa Cruz while still facing trial on charges related to the 2019 political unrest and a 2022 strike.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/bolivia-evo-morales-luis-fernando-camacho-jail-872ae180aeb8a23eedf306f3f9e940ef>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Moroccan court rejects a request to provisionally release human rights activist Ibtissame Lachgar, who faces blasphemy charges for online content while experiencing serious illness.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/morocco-blasphemy-trial-lesbian-fdc38b2d491ae2c0ec3b6c565b3d3d9b>).

<a id="event-2025-08-27-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A South African equality court finds Limpopo representative and leader of the second-largest opposition party Julius Malema guilty of hate speech over remarks made at a 2022 rally, where he encouraged violence in the context of revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-race-white-trump-malema-aade286269e02e8e85a1394ea2e74d66>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-27-5-1"></a>

Context: Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Philippine president Bongbong Marcos orders lifestyle checks on government officials, beginning with the Department of Public Works and Highways, as part of an investigation into alleged corruption in flood control projects that have received ₱545 billion (US$9.5 billion) in funding since 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/economics/article/3323536/philippines-marcos-orders-lifestyle-checks-stem-flood-corruption-will-they-work>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-08-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ford recalls over 355,000 pickup trucks across the United States due to a dashboard display failure that prevents the display of warning lights and vehicle speed.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ford-recall-f150-instrument-panel-display-ecdd56ae9201020d4f848393fad827de>).

### 2025-08-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1309259654](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20August%2028&oldid=1309259654>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-08-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Red Sea crisis / 28 August 2025 Israeli attack on Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Israeli airstrikes hit Sanaa, Yemen, reportedly assassinating Houthi prime minister Ahmed al-Rahawi and several of his companions hours after the Houthis launched a drone towards Israel which was intercepted by the Israeli military.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/houthi-prime-minister-said-killed-in-israeli-strike-on-sanaa-apartment-yesterday/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/yemen-israeli-airstrikes-sanaa-mideast-wars-0af1a06ff8078a9659b44aa54d47f0c4>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese army reports that two soldiers were killed and two others were injured after an Israeli drone crashed and exploded in An-Naqoura, southern Lebanon, while they were inspecting it.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/two-lebanese-military-personnel-killed-by-israeli-drone-exploding-southern-2025-08-28/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council votes unanimously to withdraw its peacekeeping mission in Lebanon on December 31, 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/un-lebanon-peacekeeping-unifil-trump-290a9c481b7323bff4695c55f066a403>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-0-9"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Kyiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Armed Forces launch nearly 600 drones and more than 30 ballistic and cruise missiles at Kyiv, Ukraine, striking multiple residential areas, killing 25 people, including four children, and wounding 63 others, including 11 children.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvg3y7m2gz0o>); [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/death-toll-of-russian-august-28-attack-on-kyiv-rises-to-25-two-year-old-girl-and-mother-among-killed/ar-AA1LvcFl?ocid=winp1taskbar&amp;cvid=03a31e48304b4d1aa59f67dee00b6319&amp;ei=17>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian spy ship Simferopol is sunk by a drone strike in the Danube river, killing two people and leaving several others missing or injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/russia-hits-ukrainian-vessel-killing-1-crew-member-injuring-others-navy-says/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-0-13"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict / August 2025 FARC dissidents clashes.

**Archived source account.** Colombia's Ombudsman's Office confirms that 33 soldiers detained for three days in a village in Guaviare after clashes with dissident FARC fighters have been released following negotiations involving officials and the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2025/8/29/colombian-soldiers-freed-after-three-day-captivity-in-amazon>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-08-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Polish Air Force F-16 training jet crashes during rehearsals for the 2025 Radom Air Show in Radom, Poland, killing the pilot.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/f-16-crashed-during-rehearsal-before-polish-airshow-2025-08-28/>); [Echo Dnia](<https://echodnia.eu/radomskie/katastrofa-na-air-show-2025-w-radomiu-podczas-treningow-rozbil-sie-samolot-f-16-z-zespolu-tiger-demo/ar/c1p2-27914985>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-08-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A cholera outbreak in Bukkuyum, Zamfara State, Nigeria, kills at least eight people and infects over 200 others across eleven communities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/cholera-outbreak-northwest-nigeria-kills-eight-infects-over-200-2025-08-28/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-08-28-3-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine, Russia–United Kingdom relations / Kyiv strikes.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom summons Russia's ambassador to the UK, Andrey Kelin, after the British Council's office in Kyiv was heavily damaged and one employee was injured in an overnight Russian attack on Kyiv.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c890j8zye0wo>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-3-4"></a>

Context: Philippines–Taiwan relations.

**Archived source account.** Taiwanese foreign minister Lin Chia-lung visits the Philippines as part of a business mission. The Philippine Department of Foreign Affairs later states that it did not recognize any Taiwan official as a member of the business delegation, reiterating its adherence to One China.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://globalnation.inquirer.net/289597/dfa-neither-confirms-nor-denies-visit-of-taiwan-foreign-minister>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-08-28-4-2"></a>

Context: 2025 Indonesian protests / August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** A Mobile Brigade Corps armored tactical vehicle intentionally runs over and kills an online motorcycle taxi driver at an anti-government demonstration in Jakarta, Indonesia. The seven occupants of the vehicle have been detained.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/articles/c1mpvgvvjzeo>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian federal police and the taxation authority conduct nationwide raids targeting organized crime schemes in the energy sector, investigating money laundering and fraud involving more than R$10 billion (US$1.9 billion) in imports, R$52 billion (US$9.7 billion) in domestic sales, and R$46 billion (US$8.6 billion) in related financial transactions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/brazil-carries-out-raids-crackdown-organized-crime-fuel-sector-2025-08-28/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-28-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Croatian police detain a 54-year-old military officer and his Serbian partner on suspicion of spying for Serbia, with prosecutors opening an investigation into the case.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/croatia-detains-military-officer-girlfriend-suspected-spying-2025-08-28/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Algerian president Abdelmadjid Tebboune dismisses Prime Minister Nadir Larbaoui and appoints industry minister Sifi Ghrieb as acting prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/algerias-president-removes-prime-minister-appoints-new-acting-premier-state-2025-08-28/>).

### 2025-08-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1336832691](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20August%2029&oldid=1336832691>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-08-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Israel recovers the bodies of two hostages in Gaza, one of whom is identified as Elan Weiss, who was killed in the October 7 attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/08/29/middleeast/israel-recovers-hostage-bodies-weiss-intl>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-08-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A severe weather system in Greater Poland causes heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, and strong winds, triggering the evacuation of the Bałtyk office building in Poznań due to flooding. A tornado later forms in the vicinity of Gniezno. No injuries are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [TVP Info](<https://www.tvp.info/88616556/gniezno-poznan-traba-powietrzna-w-wielkopolsce-interwencje-strazy>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-08-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Diplomatic impact of the Gaza war, Israel–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey closes its airspace to Israeli government aircraft and maintains a ban on trade and maritime traffic with Israel in response to the Gaza war.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-israel-airspace-fidan-5a56f63218fda2a06a447c217c355ee3>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly, Palestine–United States relations, Visa policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** United States secretary of state Marco Rubio blocks Palestinian Authority president Mahmoud Abbas and 80 other officials from attending the United Nations General Assembly in New York City in September by revoking their previously-valid travel visas.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/us-blocks-palestinian-president-mahmoud-abbas-and-80-other-officials-from-united-nations-annual-meeting-in-new-york-13420954>); [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/u-s-revokes-visas-of-palestinian-president-other-officials-ahead-of-un-general-assembly>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-08-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** South Korean special prosecutors indict former prime minister Han Duck-soo without detention on charges of abetting the imposition of martial law on December 3, 2024, preparation of false public documents and perjury for falsely testifying that he had not been aware of the martial law declaration.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/60046>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Austria and Russian intelligence.

**Archived source account.** Austrian prosecutors indict former intelligence officer Egisto Ott on charges of espionage, abuse of office, and providing sensitive information to fugitive Wirecard executive Jan Marsalek and Russian intelligence services.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/austria-spying-scandal-ott-indictment-russia-marsalek-914952716fa5e3fe1df1e7b05d6ae538>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The English Court of Appeal rules that the government may continue housing asylum seekers in a hotel in Epping, Essex, overturning a previous order to relocate them.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/29/world/europe/uk-asylum-hotel-ruling-epping.html>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former South Korean first lady Kim Keon Hee is indicted on bribery and other charges related to a wider investigation into her and her husband, former president Yoon Suk Yeol.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-koreas-former-first-lady-kim-keon-hee-indicted-bribery-2025-08-29/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-29-4-2"></a>

Context: 2025 Indonesian protests / August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and four others are injured after protesters set fire to the Regional House of Representatives building in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/world/571555/three-killed-in-blaze-during-protest-in-indonesia-s-makassar>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-4-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Philippine House of Representatives elections.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Commission on Elections denies the right-wing Duterte Youth's motion to reconsider the cancellation of their party-list registration and disqualifies them from holding their three seats in the House of Representatives. However, Duterte Youth may still appeal to the Supreme Court.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/nation/2025/8/29/comelec-en-banc-upholds-cancellation-of-duterte-youth-party-list-registration-1012>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-4-6"></a>

Context: 2025 Samoan general election.

**Archived source account.** Samoans are called in a snap election to elect the members of the Legislative Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/polls-close-samoa-election-after-ruling-party-split-2025-08-29/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-29-4-8"></a>

Context: 2025 Thai political crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Thai Constitutional Court removes Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra from office for ethical misconduct over leaked phone calls she had with former Cambodian prime minister Hun Sen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/29/thai-court-removes-prime-minister-paetongtarn-shinawatra-from-office>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckgeqlw05rzo>).

<a id="event-2025-08-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Indonesian protests / August 2025 Indonesian protests.

<a id="event-2025-08-30-4-5"></a>

Context: Assassination of Andriy Parubiy.

**Archived source account.** Former speaker of the Ukrainian parliament Andriy Parubiy is assassinated by an unknown gunman in Lviv, Lviv Oblast, Ukraine. A manhunt is underway for the suspect.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjw6ep37469o>).

<a id="event-2025-08-30-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man drives a car into a crowd outside a bar in Évreux, France, after a dispute, killing one person and injuring five others, including two critically.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/30/car-rams-crowd-outside-bar-evreux-northern-france-death-normandy>).

<a id="event-2025-08-30-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nicaraguan opposition groups report that attorney Carlos Cárdenas, arrested on August 15 during police operations against government critics, has died in state custody, marking the fifth such death of a detainee since 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/second-opposition-leader-nicaragua-reported-dead-state-custody-this-week-2025-08-30/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** Hemedti, leader of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), is sworn in as head of a parallel government in Nyala, South Darfur, Sudan, where the RSF has established a presidential council and prime minister while continuing its conflict with the Sudanese army.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rsfs-hemedti-sworn-head-parallel-sudanese-government-2025-08-30/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza City offensive.

<a id="event-2025-08-31-0-3"></a>

<a id="event-2025-08-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

<a id="event-2025-08-31-0-10"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war.

<a id="event-2025-08-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The original 1920s manuscripts of The Good Soldier Švejk by Jaroslav Hašek, one of the most well-known works of Czech literature, are rediscovered by the Czech Museum of Literature.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2580608-manuscripten-wereldberoemd-tsjechisch-wo-i-boek-na-eeuw-teruggevonden>); [Radio Prague International](<https://english.radio.cz/lost-manuscripts-good-soldier-svejk-found-after-90-years-prague-archive-8861205>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-08-31-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Afghanistan earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://trt.global/world/article/f56040733e07>); [The Times](<https://www.thetimes.com/world/asia/article/afghanistan-earthquake-today-jalalabad-9h53wtjlt>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and eight Kenyan police officers are injured in an accident involving two armored vehicles in the Port-au-Prince Arrondissement, Haiti.

<a id="event-2025-08-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Armenia–Pakistan relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1938704>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-3-3"></a>

Context: Norway–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Norway agrees to purchase at least five new British-made anti-submarine Type 26 frigates for the Royal Norwegian Navy in a 10 billion (US$13.5 billion) deal. The ships will be built by a consortium of companies led by BAE Systems.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/norway-defense-navy-frigates-britain-b4dd3c7fc71fba6c13d1173237a21a4f>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-4-1"></a>

Context: August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** Mobs loot the houses of Indonesian finance minister Sri Mulyani and parliament member Nafa Urbach.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://jakartaglobe.id/news/indonesian-finance-minister-lawmakers-homes-ransacked-as-unrest-in-jakarta-escalates>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-4-2"></a>

Context: August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** In a press conference, President Prabowo agrees to revoke the allowance for parliament members and put moratoriums to their foreign trips.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-prabowo-subianto-revoke-allowance-protests-5324956>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-4-3"></a>

Context: August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** A university student dies one day after participating in a protest in Yogyakarta one day prior, after he was allegedly separated from other protestors and assaulted by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Kompas](<https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/08/31/174312778/mahasiswa-amikom-rheza-sendy-pratama-meninggal-saat-unjuk-rasa-di-mapolda>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-4-5"></a>

Context: Deportation in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** United States judge Sparkle L. Sooknanan of the District of Columbia issues an injunction halting the deportation of Guatemalan unaccompanied minors after advocacy groups filed an emergency appeal against the Trump administration's plan to repatriate them.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-judge-blocks-government-deporting-unaccompanied-guatemalan-children-2025-08-31/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-08-31-5-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** The Global Sumud Flotilla, the largest civilian-led maritime convoy, departs from four cities in the Mediterranean and heads towards Gaza to attempt to break the Israeli blockade, carrying humanitarian aid and activist Greta Thunberg and actors Mark Ruffalo and Gustaf Skarsgård, among others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/31/gaza-humanitarian-flotilla-departs-barcelona-to-break-israeli-siege>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/global-sumud-flotilla-gaza-israel-greta-thunberg/>).

<a id="event-2025-08-31-5-4"></a>

Context: Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Philippine public works secretary Manuel Bonoan resigns over the flood control controversy, while President Bongbong Marcos appoints transportation secretary Vince Dizon as Bonoan's replacement.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2102596/bonoan-resigns-dizon-appointed-as-news-dpwh-chief>).


## September

### 2025-09-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1350663263](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20September%201&oldid=1350663263>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip, Gaza Strip famine, Gaza genocide.

**Archived source account.** The International Association of Genocide Scholars, an international non-partisan research organization on genocide and crimes against humanity, declares that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [IAGS](<https://genocidescholars.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IAGS-Resolution-on-Gaza-FINAL.pdf>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cde3eyzdr63o>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-is-committing-genocide-gaza-scholars-association-says-2025-09-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least four South Sudanese soldiers and ten militia members are killed in clashes near Nasir, Upper Nile, an area where earlier violence led to the detention of First Vice President Riek Machar.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-sudan-clash-kills-14-renewed-violence-north-2025-09-02/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-09-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand prime minister Christopher Luxon announces that holders of investor residence visas may buy or build a single home valued above NZ$5000000, following changes to the visa rules previously preventing such investments.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-allow-some-foreign-investors-buy-homes-2025-09-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean trade ministry reports that semiconductor exports reached a record ₩21 trillion (US$15 billion) in August, up nearly one-third from last year, contributing to total monthly exports of ₩81 trillion ($58.4 billion).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/s-korea-posts-record-semiconductor-exports-in-august-b5d59a59>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Afghanistan earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The toll from yesterday's earthquake in Jalalabad, Nangarhar province, Afghanistan, increases to at least 1,100 people killed and 3,500 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/09/death-toll-from-afghanistan-earthquake-rises-to-1100/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghanistan-earthquake-kills-800-injures-2800-taliban-asks-world-help-2025-09-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An EastIndo passenger MBB/Kawasaki BK 117 helicopter goes missing with eight people on board in the Tanah Bumbu Regency, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [ASN](<https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/541816>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed when a Gilgit-Baltistan government helicopter crashes in Thor Valley, Chilas, Diamer District, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1938881/crew-of-5-dead-as-gb-govts-helicopter-crashes-in-chilas-officials>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Australia–Nauru relations.

**Archived source account.** Australian prime minister Anthony Albanese announces that Australia will pay Nauru to accept foreign-born criminals who are expelled from Australia following the signing of a memorandum by Nauruan president David Adeang.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/australia-nauru-criminals-deportations-5660a662c7587bd251bca88f6046122a>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-3-3"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean defense ministry announces that it has suspended the "Voice of Freedom" military radio broadcast to North Korea for the first time in 15 years as part of measures to reduce tensions between the two countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-suspends-anti-north-korea-radio-broadcasts-2025-09-01/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-01-4-1"></a>

Context: August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** The Commission for Missing Persons and Victims of Violence reports that 20 people are missing across Bandung and Depok, West Java, and the Jakarta metropolitan area, Indonesia, following the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250902-20-people-missing-after-deadly-indonesia-protests>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-4-2"></a>

Context: August 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** Police storm into the campuses of Universitas Pasundan and Universitas Islam Bandung in West Java, firing tear gas at protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [IDN Times](<https://jabar.idntimes.com/news/jawa-barat/polisi-berondong-kampus-unpas-dan-unisba-dengan-gas-air-mata-00-9y7yl-vrpmnn>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-4-4"></a>

Context: Indonesia–Peru relations.

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian diplomat attached to the embassy in Lima, Peru, is shot dead by an unknown assailant. The Peruvian foreign ministry opens an investigation into the shooting as the country sees a rise in extortion and homicide.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/peru-shooting-indonesia-diplomat-boluarte-crime-54ef403f19d3639ed99aa965bc8d11a8>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-4-6"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in Burkina Faso.

**Archived source account.** Burkina Faso passes a law criminalizing homosexuality, providing sentences of between two and five years in prison as well as fines.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250902-burkina-faso-s-junta-passes-law-banning-homosexuality>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Argentine federal judge bars media outlets from publishing audio recordings made inside the presidential palace, which reportedly include conversations involving President Javier Milei's sister and chief of staff, Karina Milei, amid ongoing corruption allegations against the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-federal-judge-bars-publication-audios-attributed-mileis-sister-2025-09-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Finnish court sentences Biafran activist Simon Ekpa to six years in prison for incitement, tax fraud, and terrorism, among other charges.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-finland-separatist-ekpa-d298d311058b4ae9261817bb346967c4>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2026 Beninese presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Benin's ruling coalition, composed of the Progressive Union Renewal and the Republican Bloc, nominates finance minister Romuald Wadagni as their presidential candidate in the upcoming election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/benins-ruling-parties-pick-finance-minister-wadagni-presidential-candidate-2025-09-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-5-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Guyanese general election.

**Archived source account.** Guyana votes to elect a new National Assembly and president, with polls favouring a second term for incumbent Irfaan Ali of the PPP/C.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/30/guyana-presidential-election-irfaan-ali-oil>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Senate Blue Ribbon Committee orders the arrest of two contractors who failed to attend hearings on alleged corruption in flood control projects, as part of its probe into incomplete or substandard works awarded under President Bongbong Marcos's infrastructure program.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/philippines-arrest-of-no-show-contractors-in-flood-control-probe-ordered-1.500252227>).

<a id="event-2025-09-01-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ghanaian president John Mahama removes Chief Justice Gertrude Torkornoo from office following a committee report recommending her dismissal for misconduct, which Torkornoo denies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ghanas-president-removes-countrys-chief-justice-after-investigation-2025-09-01/>).

### 2025-09-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1350663416](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20September%202&oldid=1350663416>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-02-0-3"></a>

Context: War on drugs, United States–Venezuela relations / 2025 United States war on cartels / 2025 United States strike on a Southern Caribbean boat.

**Archived source account.** The United States military conducts a precision strike and sinks a Venezuelan boat reportedly used by Tren de Aragua for smuggling drugs in the Caribbean Sea, killing 11 people. The Trump administration reports it currently has no plans of attacking the Venezuelan government.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/venezuela-drug-boat-us-strike/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2025/09/02/us-military-caribbean-sea-strike-drug-boat/85945169007/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 105 Palestinians are killed during Israeli airstrikes and shootings across the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/2/children-journalists-among-105-killed-in-israeli-onslaught-in-gaza>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed and dozens of others are injured, including seven critically, in a suicide bombing at a political rally in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Digital Journal](<https://www.digitaljournal.com/world/at-least-25-killed-in-pakistan-attacks-including-14-at-political-rally/article>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** An attack near the Iran–Pakistan border in Balochistan, Pakistan, kills five people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250902-at-least-25-killed-in-pakistan-attacks-including-14-at-political-rally>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-0-11"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Six soldiers and six militants are killed in a suicide attack on a paramilitary base in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bannu-pakistan-paramilitary-base-suicide-bombing-attack-militants-security-personnel-killed/article70005654.ece>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-09-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Federal Senate approves a constitutional amendment that phases in court-ordered debt payments to fiscal target calculations beginning in 2027, initially counting 10% of the total and gradually reaching full inclusion over up to ten years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-congress-clears-new-fiscal-rule-court-ordered-debt-payments-2025-09-03/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 60 people are killed and dozens rescued after an overloaded boat carrying more than 100 passengers strikes a submerged tree stump and capsizes on the Niger River near Borgu, Niger State, Nigeria, with search operations continuing for missing persons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-rises-60-nigeria-boat-accident-officials-say-2025-09-03/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Belgium–Palestine relations, Belgium–Israel relations, International recognition of Palestine.

**Archived source account.** Belgian foreign minister Maxime Prévot announces that Belgium will conditionally recognize a Palestinian state at the upcoming United Nations General Assembly session upon the release of hostages and removal of Hamas, and impose sanctions on Israel, including bans on products from Israeli settlements and restrictions on certain public contracts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/en/belgium-recognise-palestinian-state-un-general-assembly-2025-09-02/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** A Bolivian court sentences two Spanish Jesuit priests to a year in prison for failing to report child sexual abuse by a fellow priest, whose posthumous diary revealed he abused at least 85 minors between 1972 and 2000.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-sentences-priests-concealing-decades-child-sex-abuse-2025-09-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Prosecution of Syrian civil war criminals.

**Archived source account.** French judges issue arrest warrants for seven former senior Ba'athist Syrian officials, including former president Bashar al-Assad, on charges of complicity in war crimes and crimes against humanity for a 2012 rocket attack on a media center in Homs that killed journalists Marie Colvin and Rémi Ochlik and injured others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-seeks-arrest-assad-six-other-former-top-syrian-officials-over-2012-attack-2025-09-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are injured, including one critically and two seriously, in a mass stabbing attack at a hotel and a nearby street in Marseille, France. The perpetrator, a 35-year-old Tunisian, is fatally shot by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/france/article/2025/09/02/french-police-kill-man-suspected-of-stabbing-five-people-in-marseille_6744975_7.html>).

<a id="event-2025-09-02-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Argentine court places the daughter of Nazi adviser Friedrich Kadgien and her husband under house arrest and accuses them of stealing the painting Portrait of a Lady, which had been missing since 1945.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/argentina-nazi-art-dutch-goudstikker-restitution-kadgien-0773fe94c60f5656bf218fb8c137fc25>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Turkish court annuls the Istanbul provincial congress of the Republican People's Party over alleged procedural violations, dismissing local leaders including the Istanbul chair, and appoints an interim committee to oversee the branch.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-crackdown-opposition-istanbul-party-congress-annulled-09a6caaa41a96d062907799ceb94e3cd>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-court-ousts-main-oppositions-istanbul-head-over-congress-irregularities-2025-09-02/>).

### 2025-09-03
