#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** More than 70 Palestinians are killed by the Israeli military in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/3/live-europes-response-on-gaza-a-failure-as-israel-continues-attacks>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Houthis launch a ballistic missile at Israel, which is intercepted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-intercepts-missile-fired-yemen-2025-09-03/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-0-8"></a>

Context: War in the Sahel / Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Nigeria's air force kills more than 15 Islamist fighters in an airstrike on hideouts in Borno's Sambisa forest, while troops separately kill 13 Boko Haram militants after repelling an ambush on a military convoy along the Gubio–Damasak road.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-military-kill-over-28-militia-northeast-borno-state-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-0-10"></a>

Context: War in the Sahel / Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin spokesman Abou Houfeiza al-Bambari announces a blockade on all fuel trucks that enter Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [TRAC Terrorism](<https://trackingterrorism.org/chatter/jnim-demands-tanker-truck-drivers-that-they-stop-activities-mali-trac/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-0-13"></a>

Context: Islamic State insurgency in Puntland / Puntland counter-terrorism operations.

**Archived source account.** Puntland forces kill at least 15 ISIS fighters and capture key militant positions, including Ceelasha Burti-Cise and Af-ka Dharimood in the Baallade Valley, following a series of intense military operations in the broader Cal Miskaad Mountains of the Bari region, Puntland.

Source citations (as archived): [AllAfrica](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202509030390.html>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-0-15"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia fires more than 500 drones and two dozen missiles at Ukraine overnight, targeting mostly western and central Ukraine and wounding at least five people, in response to the attacks, Poland scrambles its fighter jets and places ground-based air defenses and radar systems on maximum readiness.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/poland-nato-fighter-jets-scramble-ukraine-russia-attack-drones-2123682>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-trump-zelenskyy-putin-9d6b9bf76a15971c17ae2de9ca1211b5>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-09-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nazi-looted painting Portrait of a Lady by Giuseppe Vittore Ghislandi is handed over to the Argentine justice system after being discovered on display in a private house in Mar del Plata, Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2581085-door-nazi-s-geroofd-schilderij-terecht-argentijnse-dochter-van-nazi-levert-het-in>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-09-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 United States–India diplomatic and trade crisis, Tariffs in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** India approves cutting taxes on hundreds of consumer goods in response to new U.S. tariffs imposed on India last month. The overhaul cuts the consumption tax from a four-tier structure to a two-rate structure.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/india-goods-services-tax-us-tariff-9538843a2bde3124004273756b26db6b>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-03-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Punjab, India floods.

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are killed in flash floods caused by cloudbursts, landslides, and waterlogging across north India, including in Punjab, Odisha, and Jammu and Kashmir. Casualty numbers are expected to increase.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/rains-wreak-havoc-in-northern-india/a-73863094>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/heavy-rain-lashes-northern-india-yamuna-river-breaches-danger-mark-delhi-2025-09-03/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Ascensor da Glória derailment.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and 22 others are injured when the Ascensor da Glória funicular crashes into a building in Lisbon, Portugal. The Portuguese government declares a day of mourning for the following day in remembrance of those deceased.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/portugal-investigates-crash-historic-lisbon-funicular-that-killed-16-2025-09-04/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1jzlgj915no>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/09/04/nx-s1-5528599/portugal-streetcar-accident-deadly-mourning>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven migrants are found dead on beaches after several boats from Algeria sink off the coast of Andalusia, Spain, as authorities rescue 26 people from one vessel and 38 from another and continue searching for additional victims.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1939542/seven-migrants-found-dead-on-spanish-beaches>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed, another is injured, and five others are reported missing during an accident on a Hanwha Ocean floating production storage and offloading ship at a shipyard in South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Upstream](<https://www.upstreamonline.com/safety/petrobras-official-rushed-to-hospital-after-fall-from-fpso-being-built-at-hanwha-ocean/2-1-1866254>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rescue team locates the burnt remains of the EastIndo passenger MBB/Kawasaki BK 117 helicopter that went missing on Monday in Kalimantan, Indonesia, on the island of Borneo and recovers one body.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-borneo-helicopter-crash-site-4b8a4c580416190d14e6e7e5ccca05ab>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-03-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 China Victory Day Parade.

**Archived source account.** China holds a military parade in Beijing to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the end of World War II. The event is attended by the leaders of about two dozen countries.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/china-military-parade-world-war-xi-jinping-ed1f7b3e245882dd91b597df24eafbea>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-4-3"></a>

Context: Czech Republic–Germany relations.

**Archived source account.** Czech defence minister Jana Černochová announces that the Czech government signed a deal to pay Kč34 billion (US$1.6 billion) for 44 Leopard 2A8 tanks from Germany as part of its efforts to modernize the Armed Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/czech-germany-leopard-tanks-defense-military-modernization-f3ed86b998653a82d01f04cdf8dfc2ed>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-03-5-1"></a>

Context: Odebrecht case.

**Archived source account.** A Peruvian court sentences former president Alejandro Toledo to 13 years and four months in prison for laundering S/18 million (US$5.1 million) in bribes from Brazilian construction company Odebrecht through offshore accounts to purchase and refinance properties in Lima, with the sentence to run concurrently with his earlier conviction for accepting S/124 million ($35 million) in kickbacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peruvian-court-hands-ex-president-toledo-second-corruption-sentence-2025-09-03/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and the perpetrator is injured in a mass stabbing in a pizza restaurant in Gwanak District, Seoul, South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2025/09/03/asia-pacific/crime-legal/stabbing-seoul-pizza-restaurant/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Moroccan court sentences human rights activist Ibtissame Lachgar to 30 months in prison and a fine of DH50,000 (US$5,510) for blasphemy, with her lawyers stating they will appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250903-moroccan-feminist-sentenced-to-30-months-for-blasphemy-due-to-t-shirt-slogan>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-03-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Jamaican general election.

**Archived source account.** Jamaicans vote to elect the 63 members of the Parliament using first-past-the-post voting. The two leading parties are the ruling Jamaica Labour Party and the opposition People's National Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Caribbean Life](<https://www.caribbeanlife.com/inside-life-jamaican-elections-2025/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-6-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Saint Helena general election.

**Archived source account.** Residents of Saint Helena, a British Overseas Territory, vote for the twelve members of the Legislative Council using plurality block voting.

Source citations (as archived): [MercoPress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2025/05/14/st-helena-general-election-scheduled-for-03-september-2025-12-legco-seats-at-stake>).

<a id="event-2025-09-03-6-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Thai political crisis, 2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis.

**Archived source account.** The ruling Pheu Thai Party of the acting government of Thailand moves to dissolve the parliament, setting up for a new election, after Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra was dismissed from office due to her phone call leak with Cambodia.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/thailand-ruling-party-moves-to-dissolve-parliament/a-73860361>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-09-03-7-1"></a>

Context: Composition of Mars.

**Archived source account.** Scientists report that Mars has a solid inner core of iron and nickel about 613 kilometers in radius, surrounded by a liquid outer core, based on seismic data from NASA's InSight lander.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mars-core-nasa-insight-ac38ae787b41d3d2727a693f3c2b7d28>).

### 2025-09-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1310182509](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20September%204&oldid=1310182509>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip, 2025 Gaza City offensive.

**Archived source account.** At least 75 Palestinians are killed, including 44 who are killed in Gaza City, during Israel's military assault.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/4/live-hamas-says-ready-for-truce-deal-as-israel-pounds-gaza-city-overnight>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-04-1-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Afghanistan earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of deceased people are found under the rubble of collapsed houses after the August 31 earthquake in Nangarhar Province, Afghanistan, bringing the death toll to 2,205.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-earthquake-deaths-50fe948763c786f36780267a8a7e9afc>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seventeen people are injured and 15 others are hospitalized when a double-decker bus crashes near Victoria station in London, England.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/london-bus-crash-victoria-station-injuries-275007304c62eff0d57cba27d45ab9d4>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-09-04-2-2"></a>

Context: Vaccination policy of the United States / Make America Healthy Again.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. state of Florida announces it will formally eliminate all vaccination mandates, including school and childhood mandates for chickenpox, measles, and polio.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/us-florida-to-abolish-all-vaccine-mandates/a-73886198>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/florida-vaccine-mandates-desantis-schools-health-38688345e8d2cac6ecc6e92f3babe0f8>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Republic of the Congo declares a new Ebola outbreak in Kasaï Province with 28 suspected cases and 15 deaths, confirmed as the Zaire strain.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/congo-declares-new-ebola-outbreak-three-years-after-last-2025-09-04/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Algeria–Mali relations.

**Archived source account.** The Malian transitional government files a lawsuit against Algeria at the International Court of Justice and accuses Algeria of destroying a Malian military drone near Tinzaouaten, Kidal region, to allegedly hinder Mali's campaign against armed rebels in the Mali War.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mali-icj-case-algeria-drone-0cc0b2aaea816d6386affac4e1556733>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Belarus–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** Belarus detains a Polish national and a Belarusian citizen on charges of espionage after authorities allege they possessed documents on Zapad 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/polish-national-held-neighbouring-belarus-suspicion-espionage-media-says-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-3-5"></a>

Context: Ecuador–United States relations, War on drugs.

**Archived source account.** The United States designates Ecuadorian drug cartels Los Choneros and Los Lobos as terrorist organizations. U.S. secretary of state Marco Rubio also says that the U.S. will support the Ecuadorian Navy by providing $6 million in drones and $13 million for general security in the fight against these gangs.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-designates-ecuador-gangs-terrorist-organizations-2025-09-04/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Chromebook procurement scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former Indonesian education minister and Gojek co-founder Nadiem Makarim is detained after prosecutors name him as a suspect in a corruption case over the alleged unauthorized procurement of Chromebook laptops that resulted in state losses estimated at Rp 1.98 trillion (US$121.85 million).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/indonesia-detains-former-minister-gojek-founder-suspect-graft-case-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-4-3"></a>

Context: Robodebt scheme.

**Archived source account.** Australia agrees to pay an additional A$475 million (US$309M) in compensation to victims of the unlawful "Robodebt" welfare debt recovery scheme, bringing total repayments and compensation to A$2.4 billion (US$1.6 bn) in what would be the country's largest class action settlement if approved by the courts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-agrees-record-309-million-payout-victims-illegal-debt-recovery-scheme-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-4-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Hollow Water First Nation stabbings.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed, including the suspect, and eight others are injured in a stabbing spree in Hollow Water First Nation, Manitoba, Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba/hollow-water-first-nation-serious-incident-rcmp-1.7624882>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Hong Kong jury convicts three people and acquits five others over 2020 bomb plots targeting hospitals and trains during the COVID-19 pandemic, finding them guilty of conspiracy to cause explosions but not of terrorism charges under the UN anti-terrorism law.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-jury-convicts-three-acquits-five-anti-terrorism-trial-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Thai prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra leaves Thailand after a court ruling that placed him at risk for arrest. Police indicate that he was allowed to leave the country as there is no active warrant for his arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thaksin-shinawatra-hospital-constitutional-court-politics-e65bf7a070c1e6548a6a4415d35703d5>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-04-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Jamaican general election.

**Archived source account.** Jamaica's Labour Party wins the general election with 34 seats in the House of Representatives against 29 for the People's National Party, securing a third term for Prime Minister Andrew Holness amid a voter turnout of 39.5%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/jamaicas-labour-party-wins-third-term-promising-tax-cuts-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-5-3"></a>

Context: Censorship in Nepal.

**Archived source account.** Nepal orders its telecommunications authority to block access to unregistered social media platforms after companies failed to meet government requirements to register locally and designate compliance representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/nepal-block-some-social-media-including-facebook-2025-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-04-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentina's Congress overturns President Javier Milei's veto of a bill expanding spending and protections for people with disabilities, marking the first such reversal of his presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-lawmakers-overturn-milei-veto-raising-stakes-before-elections-2025-09-04/>).

### 2025-09-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1310182272](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20September%205&oldid=1310182272>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hamas releases a video showing a speech by two Israeli hostages in Gaza kidnapped during the Nova music festival massacre in 2023.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-releases-video-israeli-hostages-held-gaza-2025-09-05/>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-866456>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 campaign.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Office reports that M23 rebels, the Congolese armed forces, and other groups in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo have committed serious abuses, including killings, torture, sexual violence, and child recruitment, some of which may constitute war crimes and crimes against humanity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/m23-congolese-forces-may-have-committed-war-crimes-congo-un-rights-report-finds-2025-09-05/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-7"></a>

Context: War on drugs, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration deploys ten F-35 fighter jets to Puerto Rico to take part in military action against drug cartels in Venezuela and Latin America.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/sep/05/trump-fighter-planes-puerto-rico-venezuela-drug-cartel>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-8"></a>

Context: War on drugs, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan Air Force F-16 fighter jets fly over the USS Jason Dunham in international waters for a second time in 24 hours as tensions mount between the United States and Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/venezuela-flies-military-aircraft-over-u-s-navy-ship-for-second-time-uss-jason-dunham/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-9"></a>

Context: War on drugs, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro accuses the U.S. of seeking a regime change in Venezuela under the guise of combating cartels.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/trump-plays-down-possible-regime-change-venezuela-us-deploys-stealth-fighter-2025-09-05/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-10"></a>

Context: War on drugs, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Caribbean Airlines halts all flights between Trinidad and Tobago and Venezuela for the entire month of September due to the military situation in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Guyana Times](<https://guyanatimesgy.com/caribbean-airlines-halts-all-tt-venezuela-flights-with-immediate-effect/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-12"></a>

Context: Anglophone Crisis.

**Archived source account.** A roadside bomb kills seven Cameroonian soldiers in the Southwest Region. An English-speaking separatist group claims responsibility for the bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/cameroon-separatists-claim-deadly-roadside-attack-killed-7-125318634>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-14"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** At least 63 people are killed, including seven soldiers, and others are reported missing in attacks by Boko Haram jihadists in Darul Jamal, Borno State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/boko-haram-kills-dozens-house-house-attack-nigerias-northeast-residents-say-2025-09-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-16"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Eight security officials are killed, four others are seriously injured, and five Chinese workers are kidnapped, with four rescued afterwards, in an attack on a Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps convoy in Edo State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/gunmen-nigeria-attack-chinese-workers-kill-security-officials-2025-09-06/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-0-18"></a>

Context: Terrorism in India.

**Archived source account.** Lashkar-e-Jihadi warns police that multiple terrorist attacks involving 34 explosive-laden vehicles and 14 terrorists are being planned for the Ganesh Chaturthi finale on Saturday in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, causing security to be tightened.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/34-human-bombs-planted-in-vehicles-mumbai-police-receive-terror-threat-on-whatsapp-lashkar-e-jihadi-message-cites-14-pakistani-terrorists-14kg-rdx/articleshow/123713402.cms>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying tourists plunges down a hill in Uva Province, Sri Lanka, killing at least 15 people and injuring 15 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/world/sri-lanka-bus-crash-deaths-10231848/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are reported missing, including children and an infant, and three others are rescued when a hippopotamus capsizes a boat on the Sassandra River near Buyo in Ivory Coast.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hippo-capsizes-boat-ivory-coast-children-baby-missing/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is killed in a shark attack off Long Reef beach in New South Wales, Australia. The species of shark is currently unknown but it is believed to be a large shark due to the injuries recorded.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2025/sep/06/fatal-shark-attack-long-reef-beach-sydney-northern-beaches-nsw>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-09-05-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023–2025 mpox epidemic.

**Archived source account.** World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declares that mpox is no longer a public health emergency of international concern, citing a consistent decline in cases in Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/mpox-no-longer-an-emergency-concerns-remain-health-body-says-2025-09-05/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Portugal records its hottest and driest summer since measurements began in 1931, with an average maximum temperature of 30.78 C and only 24% of normal rainfall, conditions that contributed to recent wildfires.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/portugal-records-hottest-driest-summer-since-1931-weather-agency-9224888>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-05-3-1"></a>

Context: China–Pakistan relations, China–Pakistan Economic Corridor.

**Archived source account.** During a state visit to Beijing, Pakistani prime minister Shehbaz Sharif announces new US$8.5 billion investment agreements with China, including $7 billion in a memorandum of understanding and $1.5 billion in joint ventures between the two countries.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-china-investment-agreement-beijing-70ca7b7098c11acf9a9d520328476c68>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-3-3"></a>

Context: Finland–Latvia relations, Belarus–European Union border crisis.

**Archived source account.** Finland accepts Latvia's request to deploy border guards at the Belarus–Latvia border to help manage increased migration from Belarus, with Estonia and Lithuania also providing support.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/finnish-border-guards-aid-latvia-amid-migrant-inflow-belarus-2025-09-05/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-3-5"></a>

Context: Finland–Palestine relations, Diplomatic impact of the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Finland joins the New York Declaration calling for the end of the Gaza war and advancing a two-state solution to the Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/finland-joins-declaration-two-state-solution-between-israel-palestinians-2025-09-05/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-05-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Commission fines Google €2.95 billion (US$3.47 billion) for allegedly abusing its position as the leading search engine to commit anti-trust violations in the advertising technology space.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/european-commission-fines-google-in-ad-tech-antitrust-case/a-73899986>).

<a id="event-2025-09-05-6-2"></a>

Context: AI boom / European High-Performance Computing Joint Undertaking.

**Archived source account.** The Jupiter supercomputer, capable of at least one quintillion calculations per second with 24,000 Nvidia chips, is inaugurated in Jülich, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, marking Europe's first system considered internationally competitive in training artificial intelligence models. On a partial system test, Jupiter has achieved a preliminary 793.4 Petaflop/s, placing it 4th in the Top 500 behind El Capitan, Frontier, and Aurora at the US Department of Energy.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** During Nepal's social-media-ban protests, officials reported 17 deaths in Kathmandu and two in Itahari. Sky reported 145 injuries in Kathmandu and a curfew in parts of the capital, including around parliament and the presidential residence.

Editorial date: 2025-09-08. Checked: 2026-10-21. The original 19-death Kathmandu total and citywide-government-building curfew wording exceed this report. Counts are as reported September 8.

Evidence: [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-14-dead-in-nepal-protests-over-social-media-ban-13427038>).

Original source account: Police open fire on protesters demonstrating against a government ban on social media in Kathmandu, Nepal, killing at least 19 people and wounding over a hundred more. A curfew is declared around all government buildings, including the Rastrapati Bhawan and Federal Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/nepal-deadly-protests-1.7627595>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78nd2zy9jgo>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-14-dead-in-nepal-protests-over-social-media-ban-13427038>).

**Archived source account.** A train collides with a double-decker bus at a level crossing in Atlacomulco, Mexico, killing at least ten people and injuring 41 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News Canada](<https://ca.news.yahoo.com/train-collision-bus-mexico-kills-162243311.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** Spain announces an indefinite ban on ships transporting fuel and planes carrying weaponry to Israel from all of its ports and airspace in response to the Gaza genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/spain-pm-sanchez-permanent-weapons-embargo-israel/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-3-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** Spain recalls its ambassador to Israel after the Israeli government accused Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez of being "antisemitic" and barred two Spanish officials from entering Israel, with Spanish foreign minister José Manuel Albares calling it "slanderous accusations" against the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/spain-recalls-ambassador-to-israel-over-antisemitism-spat-812f1f88>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-3-4"></a>

Context: Belarus–Czech Republic relations.

**Archived source account.** The Czech Republic expels a Belarusian diplomat accused of espionage after cooperating with Romanian and Hungarian intelligence services to dismantle a Belarusian spy network in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/czech-republic-expel-belarusian-diplomat-over-alleged-espionage-2025-09-08/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-3-6"></a>

Context: 2025 Georgia Hyundai plant immigration raid.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean foreign ministry charters a plane to repatriate more than 300 South Koreans who were detained during an ICE raid at a Hyundai plant in Ellabell, Georgia, United States, last Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/09/06/nx-s1-5532604/hyundai-immigration-raid-georgia-south-korea>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-08-4-2"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of the second Trump administration / Deportation in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Homeland Security launches "Operation Midway Blitz", an Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on undocumented immigrants in Illinois with serious criminal records, while state officials say they received no formal notice of the operation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-administration-says-it-launches-ice-crackdown-illinois-2025-09-08/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-4-4"></a>

Context: E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump, Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations, Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit rejects President Donald Trump's bid on the grounds of presidential immunity to overturn the civil ruling of Carroll I (2019), upholding that Trump must pay $83,300,000 to sexual abuse victim E. Jean Carroll for defamation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/09/08/nyregion/trump-e-jean-carroll-defamation.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/trump-fails-overturn-e-jean-carrolls-83-million-verdict-2025-09-08/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-4-5"></a>

Context: E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump, Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations, Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The US House Oversight Committee releases a "birthday book" compiled for Jeffrey Epstein in 2003, which includes a note allegedly signed by President Donald Trump; the White House denies its authenticity. The book is part of a larger set of documents.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgqnn4ngvdo>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-4-7"></a>

Context: Frédéric Péchier case.

**Archived source account.** French doctor Frédéric Péchier is tried for allegedly intentionally poisoning 30 people, including twelve fatally, at two clinics in Besançon, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, France.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crl5ngj9zwgo>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-4-9"></a>

Context: Phillips family disappearances.

**Archived source account.** Tom Phillips, a man who kidnapped his three children during a dispute with their mother and brought them to a remote countryside in 2021, is fatally shot by a police officer after shooting and critically injuring another officer in the head following a robbery at an agricultural supplies store in Waikato, New Zealand. All the three children are rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Zealand Herald](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/marokopa-children-found-after-tom-phillips-killed-in-police-shooting/GAVRHEIFR5DSBPD3QVWCNSG72U/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-4-11"></a>

Context: 2025 Balçova police station shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are killed and three other people are injured in a mass shooting at a police station in İzmir, Turkey. The 16-year-old perpetrator is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [WTOP](<https://wtop.com/world/2025/09/teenager-kills-2-officers-in-attack-on-turkish-police-station/>).

Context: 2025 Ivorian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Ivory Coast's Constitutional Council bars former president Laurent Gbagbo and former Credit Suisse CEO Tidjane Thiam from running in the upcoming presidential election, while approving five candidacies including President Alassane Ouattara and Gbagbo's wife Simone.

Context: 2025 Norwegian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The left-wing red–green coalition, led by the Labour Party, wins a majority with 87 seats, while the right-wing populist Progress Party becomes the second biggest party with 48 seats and the centre-right Conservative Party has its worst performance in 20 years, with 24 seats.

<a id="event-2025-09-08-5-9"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-09-08/philippine-senate-elects-new-head-as-corruption-scandal-builds>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2106201/escudero-ousted-sotto-is-new-senate-president>).

The removal of finance minister Sri Mulyani causes a sharp drop in the country's main stock market index as well as the rupiah.

Source citations (as archived): [Tempo](<https://en.tempo.co/read/2047100/prabowo-inaugurates-four-new-ministers-one-deputy-minister-in-cabinet-reshuffle>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-replaces-respected-finance-minister-with-economist-promising-rapid-2025-09-08/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-08-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ugandan police detain the deputy spokesperson of the opposition party National Unity Platform (NUP) outside a court in Kampala where he was attending a bail hearing for party members held on charges the NUP describes as politically motivated.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/police-detain-senior-ugandan-opposition-official-2025-09-08/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-10-7-2"></a>

Context: 2024–2025 French political crisis / Lecornu government, Bloquons tout.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Sebastien Lecornu received the handover from Francois Bayrou at Matignon on September 10, following his appointment as French prime minister on September 9. Bayrou's government had lost the September 8 confidence vote.

Editorial date: 2025-09-10. Checked: 2026-10-21. The official records distinguish appointment from handover; they do not substantiate the portal's sworn-in wording.

Evidence: [French presidency](<https://www.info.gouv.fr/upload/media/content/0001/14/ab3531418b78c44fd4e97eca09b636ba68241b44.pdf>); [French Government Information Service](<https://www.info.gouv.fr/actualite/passation-de-pouvoir-entre-francois-bayrou-et-sebastien-lecornu>); [French National Assembly](<https://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/17/scrutins/3054>).

Original source account: Sébastien Lecornu is sworn in as Prime Minister of France after previous prime minister François Bayrou failed a confidence vote on September 8.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2025-09-10-7-3"></a>

Context: 2024–2025 French political crisis / Lecornu government, Bloquons tout.

**Archived source account.** His appointment coincides with country-wide protests and strikes against austerity measures previously announced by Bayrou, with protestors calling to "block everything". Eighty thousand police officers and gendarmes are deployed nationwide, with at least 200 people arrested as of 10 a.m. local time.

Source citations (as archived): [RFI](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20250910-france-hit-by-block-everything-protests-as-new-pm-lecornu-sworn-in>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/world/europe/block-everything-protests-france-macron-budget-cuts-rcna230265>).

<a id="event-2025-09-10-7-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian government announces plans to bolster its military through a US$1.1 billion fleet of Ghost Shark underwater drones, with the first batch delivered to the Australian Navy in January 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/australia-to-spend-11-billion-on-ghost-shark-drone-subs/a-73942165>).

<a id="event-2025-09-10-7-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sri Lankan parliament votes 151–1 to abolish state-funded benefits, including housing, pensions, transport, and office staff, for former presidents and their spouses.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/sri-lanka-presidential-perks-funding-1808d8cc640b9b5a4631dd5fe89e5af6>).

Context: Life on Mars.

**Archived source account.** An article published in Nature announces that the Perseverance rover discovered vivianite, greigite, and various organic compounds in rocks at Cheyava Falls on Mars, in what NASA administrator Sean Duffy says may be "the clearest sign of life that we've ever found on Mars".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/09/10/science/mars-rock-nasa-perserverance.html>).

Context: Kivu conflict / Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict, M23 campaign.

**Archived source account.** M23 rebels hold a military parade of newly-trained recruits in eastern Congolese towns captured by the rebels in an offensive months prior.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-m23-rebels-rwanda-parade-peace-e9312a2261208eafff0432b7b4159db4>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-0-11"></a>

Context: Red Sea crisis / Israeli attacks on Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Air Force bombs at least ten Houthi targets near Hudaydah Port in Al Hudaydah, Yemen. The sites targeted by the airstrikes reportedly include a command center and locations used to smuggle weapons from Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-867640>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-0-14"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration approves its first weapons aid packages for Ukraine. This is the first use of a new mechanism to supply Ukraine with weapons from U.S. stocks using funds from NATO countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/trump-administration-clears-first-ukraine-arms-aid-paid-by-allies-sources-say-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-0-17"></a>

Context: War in the Sahel / Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) fighters ambush and burn at least 100 fuel trucks arriving in Mali from Senegal and the Ivory Coast. The attacks are part of a nationwide blockade on fuel and other goods enforced by JNIM as it besieges Malian government-held cities and towns.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.ottumwacourier.com/news/national_news/al-qaida-linked-militants-target-fuel-trucks-in-mali-in-a-blockade-that-could-squeeze/article_4a7730f5-e2f9-5b5e-bc3d-6a2764d23f64.html>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-0-19"></a>

Context: Naxalite–Maoist insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Naxalites declare an indefinite unilateral ceasefire and state their openness to peace talks with the Indian government amid ongoing military operations against their insurgency.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ucanews.com/news/indias-maoist-rebels-suspend-armed-struggle/110305>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-09-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Uganda.

**Archived source account.** Uganda announces that it will borrow US$358 million from the African Development Fund, the Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa, and Standard Chartered to fund a power grid link with South Sudan, a road to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and expanded clean water access.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/uganda-borrow-358-million-power-line-south-sudan-other-projects-2025-09-17/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and 16 others are missing when a cloudburst causes landslides and flooding across Uttarakhand, India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/india/uttarakhand-cloudburst-landslides-floods-killed-missing-10253722/?ref=archive_pg>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-09-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Climate of Spain.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish State Meteorological Agency announces that 2025 was Spain's hottest summer since records began in 1961, averaging a temperature of 24.2 C, and surpassing 2022's record of 24.1 C. The record-high temperatures caused three heatwaves over the summer, including the 16-day heatwave in August which sparked wildfires.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/spain-sees-hottest-summer-on-record-in-2025/a-74013753>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-16-4-2"></a>

Context: China–Philippines relations, Territorial disputes in the South China Sea / Scarborough Shoal standoff.

**Archived source account.** China's coast guard reports that a Datu Cabaylo-class multi-mission offshore vessel of the Philippine fisheries bureau rammed a Chinese coast guard vessel near the disputed Scarborough Shoal, while the Philippines say Chinese ships used water cannons that damaged the Filipino vessel and injured a crew member.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/philippines-south-china-sea-scarborough-shoal-collision-fc31a170189e4747b8314fb605ca7d0c>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-fires-water-cannon-philippine-ships-south-china-sea-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-4-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war / 2025 Houthi raids on UN buildings in Sanaa.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations relocates its resident coordinator's office for Yemen from Houthi-controlled Sanaa to Yemeni government-controlled Aden after the detention of UN staff by the Houthis, while maintaining operations across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-relocates-yemens-resident-coordinators-office-aden-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-4-7"></a>

Context: Australia–Papua New Guinea relations.

**Archived source account.** Australia announces that it will fund the construction of a new ministerial wing for Papua New Guinea's Parliament House in Port Moresby as the country marks its 50th anniversary of independence.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/papua-new-guinea-independence-celebrations-australia-7790f01cef654f2259f22312836d42cc>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-4-9"></a>

Context: Hungary–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States restores Hungary's full participation in the Visa Waiver Program after the Orbán government implements measures requested to address security concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-fully-restores-hungarys-status-visa-waiver-program-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mercosur signs a free trade agreement with Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mercosur-europe-trade-eu-tariffs-640e0a5189a0e5fb882a178608369c16>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Beirut explosion.

**Archived source account.** Bulgarian police arrest the owner of the ship that brought explosive material to Beirut, Lebanon, which caused an explosion in August 2020 that killed more than 200 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/bulgaria-arrests-russian-shipowner-relation-deadly-2020-beirut-blast-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Mannheim stabbing.

**Archived source account.** The Stuttgart Higher Regional Court sentences Afghan national Sulaiman Ataee to life in prison for the May 2024 mass stabbing in Mannheim, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, which killed one person and injured five.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-police-killing-mannheim-verdict-ebe0777ce0b6313d5026755830129fd1>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-5"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict, Kidnappings in Colombia.

**Archived source account.** Colombia's Special Jurisdiction for Peace sentences seven former FARC leaders, including ex-commander Timoleón Jiménez, to up to eight years of reparations work for their role in kidnappings.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250917-colombian-farc-leaders-ordered-to-make-reparations-for-over-21-000-kidnappings>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-7"></a>

Context: Controversies surrounding Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** A Brazilian regional federal court orders former president Jair Bolsonaro and the federal government to each pay R$1000000 in damages for racist remarks he made in 2021 while in office.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/16/bolsonaro-damages-brazil>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-9"></a>

Context: Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Court of Appeals orders the freezing of 135 bank accounts and 27 insurance policies linked to individuals and companies under investigation for alleged corruption in flood control projects, following a request by the Department of Public Works and Highways and the Anti–Money Laundering Council.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippine-court-freezes-assets-linked-flood-control-project-anomalies-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-11"></a>

Context: Killing of Brian Thompson.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, a New York judge dismisses the two terrorism charges brought against Luigi Mangione, the alleged killer of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, but allows a second-degree murder charge to stand.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj4y2p8qq5qo>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-13"></a>

Context: Modern immigration to the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Justice issues an interim injunction blocking the deportation of an Eritrean asylum seeker to France under a returns agreement, pending a hearing on his trafficking claim.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/16/uk-court-temporarily-blocks-deportation-of-eritrean-asylum-seeker>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-15"></a>

Context: Murder of Agnes Wanjiru.

**Archived source account.** Kenya's Magistrates' Court issues an arrest warrant and seeks the extradition of a British citizen over the 2012 murder of Kenyan woman Agnes Wanjiru near a British army training camp in Nanyuki, Laikipia County.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/kenya-issues-arrest-warrant-uk-citizen-murder-case-blamed-soldiers-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-17"></a>

Context: Nord Stream pipelines sabotage.

**Archived source account.** An Italian appellate court approves the extradition to Germany of a Ukrainian national allegedly involved in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions. The suspect's lawyer says that he plans to appeal the decision to the Supreme Court of Cassation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/italy-germany-pipleine-explosion-extradition-2db1be82baa27a41ac7d8e83a8c17643>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-19"></a>

Context: Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse.

**Archived source account.** Serbian prosecutors indict former construction minister Goran Vesić and 12 others on public safety charges over the Novi Sad railway station roof collapse that killed 16 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/serbia-indicts-13-railway-station-roof-collapse-that-killed-16-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** Romanian prosecutors indict former presidential candidate Călin Georgescu and 21 others on charges of attempting to undermine national security by planning violent protests after the cancellation of the 2024 election over alleged Russian interference.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/5248339f-3dcc-4ee3-b2b3-7b54e4ecf0bc>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** Senegalese authorities intercept 112 Gambian migrants aboard a pirogue off the coast of Dakar on the suspicion of irregular migration as they attempt to reach Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/senegal-intercepts-pirogue-carrying-112-migrants-attempting-atlantic-crossing-2025-09-16/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Seoul Central District Court issues an arrest warrant for former People Power Party floor leader Kweon Seong-dong on charges of receiving illegal political funds from the Unification Church during the 2022 South Korean presidential election campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [The Korea Herald](<https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10577045>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** The high court in Gauteng, South Africa, rejects an appeal by the family of former Zambian president Edgar Lungu, upholding its ruling that Lungu's remains must be returned to Zambia for burial.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/zambia-edgar-lungu-south-africa-burial-ruling-db3ffc3ee61ee40832112971e0566f18>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-5-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump files a $15 billion defamation lawsuit against the newspaper The New York Times after the paper published articles and a book alleging that part of The Trump Organization's wealth was acquired through fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/09/16/nx-s1-5543030/donald-trump-nytimes-lawsuit>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-16-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Malawian general election.

**Archived source account.** Malawians vote to elect a president, the 229 members of the National Assembly, and 509 local government councillors.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/election-malawi-president-parliament-africa-chakwera-397aa544946efd6e1dfc0258d406bfdf>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-6-3"></a>

Context: Internet in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Afghan supreme leader Hibatullah Akhundzada orders a complete ban on Wi-Fi internet in the northern Balkh Province to "prevent immorality".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/taliban-balkh-afghan-jalalabad-b2827557.html>).

<a id="event-2025-09-16-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Matteo Rossi and Lorenzo Bugli are elected the new captains regent of San Marino for the following semester.

Source citations (as archived): [San Marino RTV](<https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/politica-c2/eletti-i-capitani-reggenti-per-il-prossimo-semestre-saranno-matteo-rossi-e-lorenzo-bugli-a280382>).

### 2025-09-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1312473196](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20September%2017&oldid=1312473196>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / 2025 Gaza City offensive.

**Archived source account.** More than 83 Palestinians are killed in Israeli strikes and attacks across Gaza, including at least 61 of them in Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/17/live-israel-kills-a-dozen-palestinians-as-gaza-city-invasion-intensifies>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / 2025 Gaza City offensive.

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops and tanks advance into the Sheikh Radwan district of Gaza City as the ground offensive continues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gv881exj2o>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / American airstrikes in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** USAFRICOM claims that the airstrike conducted on September 12 in Badhan in the Sanaag region of Puntland, which targeted a traditional elder accused of being an Al-Shabaab member, was executed in coordination with the Somali federal government.

Source citations (as archived): [Hiiraan Online](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Sept/202957/u_s_airstrike_kills_alleged_al_shabaab_weapons_dealer_in_somalia_s_sanaag_region.aspx >); [AFRICOM](<https://www.africom.mil/pressrelease/35996/us-forces-conduct-strikes-targeting-al-shabaab>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-0-9"></a>

Context: 2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 28 people are injured as Cambodian protesters clash with Thai security forces in a disputed border area between Banteay Meanchey, Cambodia, and Sa Kaeo, Thailand, raising tensions despite a ceasefire agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-clashes-border-territory-dispute-ceasefire-2f69565a7747b0db6a1dc3b0066b04b8>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-0-11"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Niger.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen on motorbikes kill 22 people in Takoubatt, Tillabéri Region, Niger, most of whom were attending a baptism ceremony.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce863x3g7jko>); [Report](<https://report.az/en/other-countries/gunmen-fire-on-niger-baptism-ceremony-kill-22-villagers>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-09-17-1-1"></a>

Context: Firings related to comments on the assassination of Charlie Kirk.

**Archived source account.** American late-night talk show Jimmy Kimmel Live\! is suspended indefinitely by its broadcast network ABC, following comments by its host regarding Charlie Kirk's killing, which sparked criticism and threats from the Federal Communications Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/jimmy-kimmel-show-suspended-charlie-kirk-a2bfa904429c318fe52e7d3493c6883d>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five UN police officers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in a MINUSCA convoy are killed when their armored personnel carrier crashes and rolls into a river while crossing a bridge near Bangui, Central African Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/un-peacekeepers-central-african-republic-2434ac1228917e901666a918bdf9ab91>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four soldiers are killed when a Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk crashes near Summit Lake in Thurston County, Washington, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [KIRO-TV](<https://www.kiro7.com/news/local/army-confirms-4-soldiers-killed-black-hawk-helicopter-crash-near-summit-lake/I2GB4VUIYFD6DJJAPICK37OTSA/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-09-17-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 European heatwaves.

**Archived source account.** The Copernicus Climate Change Service reports that at least 53 percent of Europe experienced droughts in August, the highest level recorded since records began in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250918-europe-mediterranean-coast-saw-record-drought-in-august-afp-analysis-of-eu-data>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Australia–Papua New Guinea relations.

**Archived source account.** Australian prime minister Anthony Albanese and Papua New Guinean prime minister James Marape sign a communiqué in Port Moresby confirming agreement on a mutual defence treaty after earlier plans to sign the treaty failed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/australia-papua-new-guinea-sign-communique-after-mutual-defence-treaty-stalls-2025-09-17/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-4-3"></a>

Context: Israel–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union outlines a set of sanctions against Israeli settlers and Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu and far-right national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir and urges the 27 member states to issue these sanctions to freeze European assets and ban inter-EU travel.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/eu-israel-sanctions-tariffs-gaza-war-94aa802ef07e2483b06724800c5c0238>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-4-5"></a>

Context: Pakistan–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani prime minister Shehbaz Sharif and Saudi crown prince Mohammed bin Salman sign a Strategic Mutual Defense Agreement in Riyadh.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/17/saudi-arabia-signs-mutual-defence-pact-with-nuclear-armed-pakistan>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-17-5-2"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States / 2025 North Codorus Township shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three police officers are killed and two are critically injured in a mass shooting when a gunman opens fire during a search warrant at a farm in North Codorus Township, Pennsylvania, United States. The perpetrator is also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [WCAU-TV](<https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/live-updates-multiple-officers-shot-in-york-county-pennsylvania/4271002/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-5-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Indonesian protests.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia's Constitutional Court rules that parliament followed proper procedure in passing amendments to the military law, rejecting a petition that sought to annul the amendments.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-court-finds-no-procedural-flaws-with-law-expanding-militarys-role-2025-09-17/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Greece suspends the extradition of Moldovan businessman and politician Vladimir Plahotniuc, who is wanted in Moldova over a 2014 bank fraud case.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/greece-suspends-tycoon-plahotniucs-extradition-moldova-says-moldovan-prosecutor-2025-09-17/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-17-6-1"></a>

Context: Conflict in the Niger Delta.

**Archived source account.** Nigerian president Bola Tinubu lifts the state of emergency in Rivers State and reinstates Governor Siminalayi Fubara and state lawmakers after six months of federal control imposed during a political crisis and oil pipeline vandalism.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-rivers-state-emergency-rule-president-2d7268ac6b182caa379c6436362a99b6>).

<a id="event-2025-09-17-6-3"></a>

Context: Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Philippine house speaker Martin Romualdez resigns over his alleged involvement in the flood control controversy, with former deputy speaker Bojie Dy elected as the next speaker of the House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-09-17/marcos-cousin-to-step-down-as-philippines-congress-speaker>); [DZRH](<https://dzrh.com.ph/post/faustino-bojie-dy-assumes-seat-as-new-house-speaker-after-romualdez-resigns>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** A Jordanian truck driver bringing aid to the Gaza Strip kills two Israeli military personnel before being fatally shot by security personnel at the Allenby Bridge.

**Archived source account.** At least ten people are killed and 25 others are injured when a fire breaks out in a high-rise office building in Lagos, Nigeria.

<a id="event-2025-09-18-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/magnitude-78-earthquake-strikes-petropavlovsk-kamchatsky-region-russia-usgs-says-2025-09-18/>); [TVP Info](<https://www.tvp.info/89002018/rosja-trzesienie-ziemi-na-kamczatce>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-18-2-1"></a>

Context: Poland–Ukraine relations, 2025 Russian drone incursion into Poland.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine announces it will train Polish troops and engineers in counter-drone operations following recent Russian drone incursions into Polish airspace.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/18/ukraine-pledges-to-bolster-polish-drone-defence-with-training>).

<a id="event-2025-09-18-2-3"></a>

Context: Syria–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Syrian foreign minister Asaad al-Shaibani visits Washington, D.C. to attend meetings with the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund, and to meet with Israeli delegations and U.S. secretary of state Marco Rubio, marking the first time a Syrian official has visited the United States in 25 years.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-us-asaad-alshibani-trump-sanctions-alsharaa-526af7ef1ad6afc5ad1086e0707a5720>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt's interior ministry reports that a 3,000-year-old gold bracelet belonging to the pharaoh Amenemope, missing from the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, was stolen, melted and sold, with several suspects arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1kw8dwy4dro>).

<a id="event-2025-09-18-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraq receives 47 French nationals previously detained in northeast Syria on suspicion of Islamic State membership for prosecution on terrorism charges.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iraq-syria-france-islamic-state-0ec321ee15581c9ec2dd41500c18b18a>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-18-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Albanian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Albanian prime minister Edi Rama begins an unprecedented fourth term following the Socialist Party's victory in the last election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/albanias-rama-starts-fourth-term-pm-targets-eu-membership-2025-09-18/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-18-4-3"></a>

Context: Censorship in the Maldives.

**Archived source account.** Maldivian president Mohamed Muizzu ratifies the Media and Broadcasting Regulation Law, which allows fines, license suspensions, and closures of media outlets found in violation of its provisions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/maldives-media-freedom-law-muizzi-license-journalist-2ca60d731492ef11840850d76f7007e1>).

<a id="event-2025-09-18-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bulgarian prime minister Rosen Zhelyazkov's government survives their fifth vote of no-confidence this year over alleged failures to reform the justice and security sectors, with 133 lawmakers opposing and 101 supporting the motion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/bulgarias-government-survives-fifth-no-confidence-vote-2025-09-18/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-09-18-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, automaker Toyota recalls over 590,000 vehicles due to a software failure for its dashboard that hides vehicle speed, braking status, and tire pressure warnings. Meanwhile, Hyundai recalls over 568,000 Palisades due to seatbelt buckle failures.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/auto-recalls-hyundai-toyota-safety-87734fbc8c951415564c21a2f21d9fdf>); [Yahoo\! Autos](<https://autos.yahoo.com/safety-and-recalls/articles/toyota-hyundai-recall-more-1-144256702.html>).

### 2025-09-19

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Gaza City offensive.

**Archived source account.** At least 43 Palestinians are killed from Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip, including 26 people in Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/19/live-gaza-war-escalates-as-israel-defies-global-condemnation>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-0-5"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Siege of El Fasher.

**Archived source account.** The Rapid Support Forces attacks a mosque at an internal displacement camp with a drone strike near El Fasher, North Darfur, killing 75 people.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-rsf-drone-strike-kills-dozens-in-darfur/a-74060598>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Manipur.

**Archived source account.** Two Assam Rifles personnel are killed and five Assam Rifles personnel are injured in an ambush by People's Liberation Army of Manipur militants in Bishnupur, Manipur.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/assam-rifles-truck-ambushed-on-outskirts-of-imphal-confirms-army-9308221/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-0-9"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** At least 11 police officers are killed in an ambush by armed assailants in Benue State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Street Journal](<https://thestreetjournal.org/bodies-of-8-missing-policemen-recovered-after-deadly-attack-in-benue/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-09-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canada bans the Irish band Kneecap from entering the country, citing statements and alleged links to designated terrorist groups.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgrvw4ejn4o>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three workers are killed in an explosion at a silo operated by waste management company Ecopartenope near Caserta, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/italy-workers-deaths-waste-plant-explosion-naples-dbd4e6f626bfa904f7a1d7341a495bf9>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-09-19-3-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC's) Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices unanimously votes to abandon its recommendation for the COVID-19 vaccine and now recommends that Americans get the vaccine based on their personal choice. In a separate vote, the committee votes for the CDC to communicate clear risks about COVID-19 vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/cdc-hepatitis-bvaccine-vote-delayed-parents/story?id=125731004>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Estonia–Russia relations, Russia–NATO relations, Violations of non-combatant airspaces during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Estonia summons Russia's chargé d'affaires after three Russian MiG-31 fighter jets enter its airspace near Vaindloo unauthorized, prompting a NATO response from Italian Air Force F-35s.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/british-intelligence-mi6-russia-war-443df0c37ff2254fcc33d5425e3beaa6>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-4-3"></a>

Context: International sanctions against Iran, Snapback mechanism of sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) convenes to vote on a draft resolution concerning the snapback of sanctions on Iran. Nine UNSC countries voted against lifting Iran sanctions, four in favor.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-snapback-sanctions-nuclear-united-nations-e01bdcaf62c4144ff56731fed8144915>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-4-5"></a>

Context: France–Mali relations.

**Archived source account.** France suspends its joint counterterrorism agreements with the Mali government over the arrest of a French citizen. According to Mali officials, the French citizen was taken into custody for their alleged involvement in a purported coup plot. Also in response to the arrest, two Mali diplomats are expelled from an embassy in Paris by French authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/19/france-suspends-counterterrorism-cooperation-with-mali>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-4-7"></a>

Context: Ireland–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Ireland and the United Kingdom agree to replace the Northern Ireland Legacy Act with new laws that will establish investigative bodies to address killings during The Troubles.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2025/09/19/ireland-the-troubles-agreements/3711758321160/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Morocco becomes the 60th UN member state to ratify the High Seas Treaty, allowing it to enter into force in January 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/high-seas-treaty-marine-diversity-15061c0624d8e472603401b479870904>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-19-5-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of World War II / World War II bomb disposal in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Around 10,000 people are ordered to evacuate after authorities discover two pieces of World War II-era unexploded ordnance in Berlin, Germany, one in the Spree River near Mitte and another in Spandau.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-thousands-evacuated-in-berlin-over-2-wwii-bombs/a-74053192>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-5-4"></a>

Context: Detention of Barbie and Peter Reynolds.

**Archived source account.** British couple Peter and Barbie Reynolds are freed in Afghanistan after being detained by the Taliban for 8 months.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-couple-freed-by-taliban-after-qatari-mediation-official-says-2025-09-19/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese journalist Zhang Zhan, previously jailed for reporting on the early COVID-19 outbreak in Wuhan, is sentenced to an additional four years in prison on charges of picking quarrels and provoking trouble.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinese-covid-whistleblower-sentenced-4-more-years-jail-group-says-2025-09-21/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-19-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Palestinian authorities arrest Hicham Harb, a suspect in the 1982 Chez Jo Goldenberg restaurant attack in Paris that killed six people, after France issued an Interpol notice.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250919-palestinian-authorities-arrest-key-suspect-in-1982-anti-semitic-paris-attack>).

Context: 2025 Nashua shooting.

Context: 2024–2025 French political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Between 500,000, according to French authorities, and one million people, according to the unions, manifest or participate in labour strikes across France, to protest against austerity politics planned by President Emmanuel Macron, and to pressure him to finally choose a prime minister representative of the 2024 French legislative election results.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20250918-anti-austerity-strikes-and-protests-rock-france-pressure-macron>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-referendum-noboa-drugs-constitution-manta-ac43191767e191e44ca88d2d47fb3329>).

**Archived source account.** ABC parent company Disney announces that American late-night talk show Jimmy Kimmel Live\! will begin airing again on Tuesday after it was "indefinitely suspended" last week following pressure from the Trump administration after host Jimmy Kimmel commented on slain right-wing political activist Charlie Kirk and his fanbase.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/09/22/nx-s1-5550330/jimmy-kimmel-back-suspended-disney-trump>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-09-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Stocks in Kenvue Inc. fall by 5% after the second Trump administration issues statements citing acetaminophen under their brand name Tylenol as a cause of autism.

Source citations (as archived): [Fortune](<https://finance.yahoo.com/news/tylenol-maker-kenvue-stock-lost-185855115.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2024 European heatwaves.

**Archived source account.** Nature Medicine publishes a report that Europe had over 62,700 heat-related deaths in 2024, with women and elderly people representing the largest part of the death toll.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/22/asia/super-typhoon-ragasa-philippines-hong-kong-intl-hnk>); [News.az](<https://news.az/news/death-toll-from-super-typhoon-ragasa-in-philippines-climbs-to-3>).

<a id="event-2025-09-22-3-4"></a>

<a id="event-2025-09-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2025 H5N1 outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Poland reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza on poultry farms in Susz, Warmian–Masurian Voivodeship, where around 4,000 birds have died.

<a id="event-2025-09-22-4-4"></a>

<a id="event-2025-09-22-6-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/protesta-violencia-policia-indigenas-ataque-incremento-precio-diesel-c9b984004de09876aaa2a1e29fb0ec9d>).

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Court (ICC) charges former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte with crimes against humanity for his alleged involvement in the killing of at least 76 people during his term as president and Davao City mayor. He was arrested in March under an ICC arrest warrant and is currently held in a detention facility in the Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/09/23/g-s1-90024/icc-charges-former-philippine-president-duterte-crimes-against-humanity>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg5e1v85lrdo>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-22-7-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Guinean constitutional referendum.

**Archived source account.** Provisional results show that over 90% of voters in Guinea approve a constitutional change that permits members of the ruling junta to seek the presidency and extend term limits, amid opposition boycotts and criticism that the process consolidates military power.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/guinea-referendum-results-ff250763a11978489553a129e9653330>).

<a id="event-2025-09-22-7-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Moldovan police conduct 250 raids and detain 74 people as part of an investigation into an alleged Russia-supported plan to provoke unrest before the parliamentary election, with officials stating that suspects received training in Serbia while Russia denies involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/moldova-russia-arrests-plot-election-293ee902e878ce1efcca339759eb06d0>).

<a id="event-2025-09-22-7-5"></a>

Context: Human rights in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian president Abdel Fattah el-Sisi grants a presidential pardon to activist Alaa Abd El-Fattah after he was detained in 2015 and re-arrested in 2019 for participating in unauthorized protests. Abd el-Fattah was expected to be released in September 2024 after his 5-year sentence ended but was continuously detained until now.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/egypt-pardons-jailed-activist-alaa-abd-el-fattah/a-74095862>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/egypts-president-sisi-pardons-high-profile-egyptian-british-activist-alaa-abd-el-2025-09-22/>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP/BSS](<https://www.bssnews.net/news/314516>).
