**Archived source account.** All 23 miners trapped for two days in a collapsed gold mine shaft in Segovia, Antioquia, Colombia, are rescued alive after receiving food, water, and oxygen through pipelines during the operation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://gbcode.rthk.hk/TuniS/news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1824590-20250925.htm?spTabChangeable=0>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Costa Rica closes its airspace for at least five hours after a power outage disables radar systems and disrupts hundreds of flights, before reopening after systems were restored.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/costa-rica-closes-airspace-temporarily-suspends-flights-after-power-malfunction-2025-09-24/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Allenby Bridge shooting, Israel–Jordan relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel indefinitely closes the Allenby Bridge between Jordan and the West Bank days after reopening it following a shooting that killed two Israeli soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-close-allenby-crossing-wednesday-until-further-notice-palestinian-border-2025-09-23/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-2-3"></a>

Context: Africa–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Lesotho's commerce minister announces the United States's plan to extend the African Growth and Opportunity Act by one year following negotiations in Washington, D.C.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/lesotho-says-us-plans-extend-africa-trade-deal-by-year-2025-09-24/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-2-5"></a>

Context: Belarus–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** Poland reopens its border with Belarus after closing them during Russia-led military exercises, citing reduced security risks and economic considerations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/poland-reopen-border-crossings-with-belarus-pm-says-2025-09-23/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-2-7"></a>

Context: France–United Kingdom relations, English Channel illegal migrant crossings.

**Archived source account.** A family of three becomes the first group sent to the United Kingdom from France under the one in, one out policy that returns unauthorized Channel arrivals to France in exchange for vetted asylum-seekers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/britain-france-migrants-small-boats-31b08e97fe22be4bf46fd3722f100343>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-2-9"></a>

Context: General debate of the eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly.

**Archived source account.** Syrian president Ahmed al-Sharaa becomes the first Syrian leader to address the United Nations General Assembly since Nureddin al-Atassi in 1967.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/syria-united-nations-unga-c0471a2f7faece79fe15793fb0466501>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cjw7yy5l37no>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-2-11"></a>

Context: Syria–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Syria and Ukraine restore diplomatic relations as Presidents Ahmed al-Sharaa and Volodymyr Zelenskyy meet on the sidelines of the eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly, following Ukraine's 2022 break in ties with Syria when the Assad regime recognized Russian-occupied territories.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-restores-diplomatic-ties-with-syria-zelenskiy-says-2025-09-24/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Dallas ICE facility shooting.

**Archived source account.** A person is killed and two others are injured in a shooting at a United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility in Dallas, Texas, United States. The shooter is found dead on a nearby rooftop.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-09-25/-targeted-shooting-at-dallas-immigration-centre/105815636>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/us/live-news/ice-facility-dallas-shooting-09-24-25>).

<a id="event-2025-09-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Ladakh protests.

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed and more than 60 others are injured as protests held by demonstrators demanding statehood and the inclusion of Ladakh under the Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India turn violent in Ladakh, India. The local Bharatiya Janata Party office and a vehicle are set on fire in an arson attack.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/protests-demanding-statehood-for-ladakh-turn-violent-bjp-office-vehicle-torched-2792622-2025-09-24>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Malawian general election.

**Archived source account.** Former Malawian president Peter Mutharika is declared the winner of the presidential election, winning 57% of votes against the incumbent Lazarus Chakwera, who received 33%.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cp3wdzdwzlkt>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-flotilla-activists-5e7e0e22b2813f00a0b907fae84f9284>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/italy-sends-second-navy-ship-escort-gaza-aid-flotilla-2025-09-25/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-unga-macron-09-25-2025-a92c883b97b73a2d81e064c9d12589f1>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/25/live-israel-bombs-family-home-in-gaza-with-children-among-11-killed>).

<a id="event-2025-09-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Tattooing in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea's National Assembly passes a law legalizing tattoo artistry by licensed non-medical professionals for the first time since a 1992 court ruling restricted the practice to doctors.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp8jz0vrrp4o>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-09-25-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations, China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** China lists six American companies on its Unreliable Entities List, including several in the underwater drone and satellite sectors.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/china-us-trade-sanctions-a76e4e0890e126dd77d56dc4b17dddbe>).

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/russia-ethiopia-sign-action-plan-on-nuclear-power-project/3699303>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-09-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed after a bus collides with a truck head-on in Sundergarh, Odisha, India.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/libya-migrant-desert-death-remains-1279b00dc52a0dc509e3c78b03af942b>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-09-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the Netherlands, Foreign relations of Uganda.

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands and Uganda sign an agreement to establish a pilot transit hub in Uganda for rejected asylum seekers from nearby countries who cannot be directly returned from the Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/netherlands-uganda-sign-letter-intent-return-hub-deal-rejected-asylum-seekers-2025-09-25/>).

Context: France–Iran relations.

**Archived source account.** France withdraws its case at the International Court of Justice accusing Iran of denying consular protection to two French citizens detained at Evin Prison in Tehran for more than three years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/france-drops-world-court-case-against-iran-over-detained-citizens-2025-09-25/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-25-4-5"></a>

Context: France–Mali relations, French military withdrawal from West Africa.

Context: Israel–Slovenia relations, International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Israeli leaders.

<a id="event-2025-09-25-4-9"></a>

Context: Moldova–Poland relations.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-09-25-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Malagasy protests.

**Archived source account.** Unrest erupts in Antananarivo, Madagascar, following power and water cuts in the capital city. Security forces impose an evening curfew.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/madagascar-protests-curfew-electricity-water-0225f744e674220649fc5a0520cdfcfd>).

<a id="event-2025-09-25-5-3"></a>

Context: Alleged Libyan financing in the 2007 French presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Former French president Nicolas Sarkozy is sentenced to 5 years in prison for criminal association, becoming the first former French president to be sentenced to prison. His former interior ministers Brice Hortefeux and Claude Guéant are sentenced to two years and six years of house arrest under electronic tagging respectively, due to a French law allowing prison sentences equal or inferior to 2 years to be converted in another sentences, and to Guéant's health issues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp98kepmj9lo>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250925-france-s-sarkozy-set-to-learn-fate-in-libya-case>).

Context: Ecuadorian security crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 17 people are killed in a prison riot in Esmeraldas, Ecuador.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-prison-riot-leaves-least-17-dead-2025-09-25/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-25-5-7"></a>

Context: Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Department of Justice and the National Bureau of Investigation file criminal graft and malversation charges against Senator Chiz Escudero, former senator Nancy Binay, and former house speaker Martin Romualdez in connection with investigations into alleged corruption in flood control projects.

Source citations (as archived): [The Philippine Star](<https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2025/09/25/2475386/nbi-seeks-malversation-raps-escudero-binay-romualdez>).

<a id="event-2025-09-25-5-8"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250925-two-teens-killed-in-shooting-at-brazil-school>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-school-fatal-shooting-ceara-sobral-49424502f7b84fc7ceba27ef93e5754a>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-09-25-6-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Red Bull](<https://www.youtube.com/live/bZHZNsqNLzk?si=vDXH_DjhJqHK6Wol>); [Transworld Skateboarding](<https://www.skateboarding.com/news/sandro-dias-breaks-2-world-records-on-the-worlds-biggest-ramp>); [AFP/CBS Newspath](<https://local12.com/news/nation-world/centro-administrativo-fernando-ferrari-red-bull-sandro-dias-pro-skateboarder-sets-2-world-records-with-daring-stunt-hits-64-mph-on-descent-prada-possibility-dream-sports-tony-hawk-pro-tagging-cincinnati-seventy-meter-drop-stunt-dangerous-human-interest>).

Context: 1991 Austin yogurt shop murders.

Context: 2025 Department of Justice counterinvestigation into Russian interference in the 2016 election.

Context: Human rights in Afghanistan, Internet in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban imposes a nationwide internet blackout in Afghanistan to "prevent immorality", cutting fiber-optic services and reducing connectivity to about 14% of normal levels, according to monitoring group NetBlocks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-internet-crackdown-dfdda5c1ef1d29124db4649414584c6e>).

### 2025-09-30

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-09-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip, 2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings.

**Archived source account.** At least 59 Palestinians are killed by Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip, including 20 who were seeking aid.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/30/live-israel-kills-39-in-gaza-as-hamas-reviews-trumps-proposal-to-end-war>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Palestinian political violence.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man rams into Israeli pedestrians near Al-Khader in the West Bank, injuring two children, before being shot.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/two-teens-injured-in-car-ramming-terror-attack-on-west-bank-highway-near-jerusalem/>); [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-09-30/ty-article/.premium/two-teenagers-wounded-in-ramming-attack-at-west-bank-junction-near-jerusalem/00000199-9a9a-d0f3-a599-defb3aff0000>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-0-9"></a>

<a id="event-2025-09-30-0-12"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxqdpgznzeo>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-09-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two-year-old Aryatara Shakya is installed in Kathmandu as Nepal's new Kumari, succeeding Trishna Shakya who held the role since 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nepal-living-goddess-hindu-tradition-0cd93fa79e3446ffdf995210f44b8f99>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/video/2025/09/30/a-two-year-old-girl-is-chosen-as-nepals-new-living-goddess>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 26 people are killed in a boat accident on the Niger River in Ibaji, Kogi State, Nigeria. The cause of the accident is unknown.

<a id="event-2025-09-30-2-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Danish drone incidents, Denmark–Ukraine relations.

Context: France–South Africa relations.

**Archived source account.** South African ambassador to France and former sport, arts and culture minister Nathi Mthethwa is found dead outside his hotel in the 17th arrondissement of Paris. The ambassador had previously been reported missing by his wife.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/south-africas-ambassador-france-found-dead-paris-le-parisien-2025-09-30/>).

Context: Haitian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council approves a resolution to transform the Multinational Security Support Mission (MSS) in Haiti into a larger Gang Suppression Force (GSF) of up to 5,500 police and military personnel to combat gang violence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/30/un-security-council-approves-new-military-force-to-fight-haiti-gangs>); [UN News](<https://news.un.org/en/story/2025/09/1166006>).

Context: 2025 Moroccan Gen Z protests.

**Archived source account.** Large-scale youth-led demonstrations in Morocco continue for a third day, despite police arrests and tight security.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/morocco-squashes-youth-led-protesters-over-health-education-2025-09-30/>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

**Archived source account.** A military court in the Democratic Republic of the Congo sentences former president Joseph Kabila to death in absentia for treason.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/joseph-kabila-treason-convicted-death-sentence-m23-rwanda-b2a21a4203fd78e68cf4fc506d56544b>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-4-5"></a>

Context: Chinese intelligence activity abroad, China–Germany relations.

**Archived source account.** The Higher Regional Court of Dresden convicts a Chinese–German man of espionage for China while working for AfD politician Maximilian Krah, giving him a sentence of over five years. A co-defendant accused of supplying cargo and passenger information from her job at Leipzig Airport is given a suspended sentence of one and a half years.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-china-espionage-european-parliament-9882ee9aab8bdaa525b6d8eaa5f8db4f>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-4-7"></a>

Context: Nord Stream pipelines sabotage.

**Archived source account.** Polish authorities arrest a Ukrainian diver in Pruszków, Masovian Voivodeship, on a German warrant, suspecting his involvement in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions in the Baltic Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nord-stream-attack-poland-arrest-9764c17af74e594e40956f298c4d0db2>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-4-9"></a>

Context: Lèse-majesté in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** A Thai appeals court upholds a two-year prison sentence against opposition representative Chonthicha Jaengraew for defaming the monarchy in a 2021 speech, while granting her bail pending a Supreme Court appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-monarchy-appeals-court-chonthicha-royal-defamation-2f53fdd53621ccb66b29c2e9a0e24d23>).

<a id="event-2025-09-30-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexico's National Autonomous University cancels or shifts classes online in over half its departments after the killing of a student and threats against female professors, prompting authorities to strengthen security and provide support measures.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/mexico-mexico-city-claudia-sheinbaum-b2836965.html>).

**Archived source account.** Gabon's ruling party, the Democratic Union of Builders of President Brice Oligui Nguema, wins 55 of 145 seats in the first round of legislative elections, with a second round scheduled for constituencies without a majority winner.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/gabon-legislative-elections-results-aba1d9e6311269b9e670d1ae3e3f324c>).

Context: Gaza war / Donald Trump's September 2025 Gaza Strip proposal.

<a id="event-2025-10-03-0-3"></a>

<a id="event-2025-10-03-0-7"></a>

<a id="event-2025-10-11-0-2"></a>

### 2025-10-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1318021779](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20October%2013&oldid=1318021779>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-10-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza peace plan.

**Archived source account.** Hamas hands over the 20 remaining living Israeli hostages to the Red Cross, and Israel releases over 1,900 Palestinian detainees, including 250 people serving life sentences for convictions in attacks on Israelis, as part of the ceasefire agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/gaza-israel-hamas-hostages-ceasefire-10-13-2025-9e4921406e846189c90144609c1a9530>).

<a id="event-2025-10-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza peace plan.

**Archived source account.** Under the terms of the ceasefire agreement, local authorities shut down aid distribution sites run by the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, which were the locations of shootings by the Israeli military that killed over 2,600 people seeking food aid.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/gaza-aid-group-us-israel-ceasefire-dec2aa4e5d33f58eca34bf21603176bc>).

<a id="event-2025-10-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza peace plan.

**Archived source account.** Hamas returns the bodies of four of the 28 deceased Israeli hostages, partially violating a provision of the ceasefire agreement for all hostages to be returned in one day, though the agreement acknowledged the possible inability of Hamas to be able to locate all the bodies in the specified timeframe.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c740jx07vz0o>); [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-10-13/ty-article/.premium/hamas-to-return-bodies-of-four-hostages-breaking-agreement-to-return-all-on-same-day/00000199-ddc1-d253-a3bd-ffcbe9d50000>).

<a id="event-2025-10-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Hamas publicly executes eight men in Gaza City accused of being criminals and Israeli collaborators.

<a id="event-2025-10-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes / 2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Nineteen security forces are killed in two Pakistani airstrikes in Spin Boldak and Bahramcha, Afghanistan. A local high-ranking commander is among the fatalities.

Source citations (as archived): [Kabul Now](<https://kabulnow.com/2025/10/at-least-19-taliban-fighters-killed-in-pakistani-drone-strikes-in-southern-afghanistan/>).

It is expected that the focus will be on the future governance of the Gaza Strip, security, and humanitarian assistance.

At least 100,000 homes, 59 medical facilities, and 308 schools across the region are damaged by water and oil from the Gulf of Mexico.

### 2025-10-15

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-10-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes / 2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan claims that it killed at least 15 Taliban members in an airstrike in Spin Boldak, Afghanistan. The Taliban claims that twelve civilians are killed and over 100 are injured. Both countries also claim that they killed several soldiers during a shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3dnvnjdg1ro>).

<a id="event-2025-10-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes / 2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan carries out two airstrikes against Kabul, capital of Afghanistan. The target and the result are unknown. After the attack, both countries agree to a 48-hour ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3dnvnjdg1ro>).

<a id="event-2025-10-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza war hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hamas returns two more hostages' bodies to the Red Cross, with 19 still in Gaza despite the Gaza peace plan's deadline last Monday. Donald Trump also states Israel may resume fighting if he believes Hamas does not uphold their part of the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/gaza-israel-hamas-hostages-ceasefire-10-15-2025-435b7d15bc971f902d4dda967e4a609a>).

<a id="event-2025-10-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Kupiansk offensive, Humanitarian impacts of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian authorities order mass evacuations across 40 settlements and towns in northeastern Kharkiv Oblast, citing the worsening situation around the city of Kupiansk.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/ukraine-authorities-order-mass-evacuations-around-devastated-kupiansk-2025-10-14/>).

<a id="event-2025-10-15-0-11"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are killed by Indonesian soldiers during a six-hours battle with Free Papua Movement separatists in Intan Jaya Regency, Central Papua. The army claims that all of those killed were militants, while the group claims that nine civilians and three militants are among the dead.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-papua-insurgents-deadly-clash-army-cdd6c3213531be78d81d269f3ecbbd39>).

<a id="event-2025-10-15-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Explosive devices detonate on two bridges in Ecuador. No casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/explosions-reported-bridges-ecuador-violence-escalates-2025-10-15/>).

Context: Haitian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Doctors Without Borders announce that they are permanently closing their offices in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, due to safety concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/haiti-msf-doctors-without-borders-center-closes-violence-68595071309e258e9c67ca233eb31822>).

Context: 2025 Shinile train collision.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed and dozens of others are injured when an overcrowded train full of merchants crashes into a stationary train near Dire Dawa in Oromia Region, Ethiopia.

Source citations (as archived): [Africanews](<https://www.africanews.com/2025/10/22/14-killed-in-train-collision-in-a-remote-part-of-ethiopia-official-says/>).

<a id="event-2025-10-21-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 42 people are killed and 52 others are injured when a tanker truck transporting gasoline crashes and explodes in Bida, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c93dnd49l0jo>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-truck-explodes-gasoline-residents-killed-923f073a0cf0436e4ff73bfb15d6081f>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-10-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Attempted assassination of Robert Fico.

**Archived source account.** A Slovak court sentences 72-year-old Juraj Cintula, the perpetrator in the attempted assassination of prime minister Robert Fico in 2024, to 21 years in prison. Cintula continues to deny the accusations, saying he aimed away from vital organs.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-trial-fico-assassination-verdict-5f1c61fe91750bed7eb4b193366b93d1>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c051mj72ddjo>).

<a id="event-2025-10-21-3-3"></a>

Context: Irish anti-immigration protests.

**Archived source account.** Rioting takes place in Dublin, Ireland, with several thousand anti-immigration protesters attempting to storm a hotel housing asylum seekers in the city after the alleged rape of a 10-year-old Irish girl by an asylum seeker. A police vehicle is set on fire during the unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c629zg8v8jpo>).

<a id="event-2025-10-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Poland–Ukraine relations, Romania–Ukraine relations, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** A Ukrainian citizen is detained in Poland and two others are arrested in Romania for allegedly working for Russian intelligence agencies and preparing acts of sabotage on Ukrainian shipping routes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/poland-sabotage-war-ukraine-hybrid-russia-b62581c88b125d18b6f962c0c0b83b2f>).

<a id="event-2025-10-21-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Colombian court overturns a bribery conviction against former president Álvaro Uribe, who had been sentenced to 12 years of house arrest in August 2025. The court is still considering further appeals on a fraud charge.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombian-court-strikes-down-former-presidents-bribery-conviction-2025-10-21/>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-court-overturns-uribe-witness-tampering-conviction/a-74448191>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-10-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Peruvian political crisis (2016–present).

**Archived source account.** Peruvian president José Jerí declares a 30-day state of emergency in Lima in an attempt to curb rising crime.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-declares-30-day-state-emergency-lima-tackle-rising-crime-2025-10-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-10-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sanae Takaichi is elected as Japan's first female prime minister by the House of Representatives after her party, the Liberal Democratic Party, agreed to form a coalition government with the Japan Innovation Party.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2025/10/21/japan/politics/sanae-takaichi-elected-japan-prime-minister/>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/10/21/nx-s1-5581178/japan-sanae-takaichi-female-prime-minister>).

<a id="event-2025-10-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Billboard magazine revises the rules for its Hot 100 record chart and implements a maximum time spent on the list if a song drops below a certain rank, intended to shorten the age to be considered "contemporary".

Context: 2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico, Canada–United States trade relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump announces all trade negotiations with Canada are "terminated" following an advertisement featuring former U.S. president Ronald Reagan released by the government of Ontario.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/trump-trade-negotiations-tariffs-ontario-ad-9.6951469>).

<a id="event-2025-10-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations, Proposed Israeli annexation of the West Bank, International law and the Arab–Israeli conflict.

**Archived source account.** The United States rules out Israel's plan to annex the West Bank following a Knesset vote, while several other countries also affirm their standings against the plan, calling it a violation of international law.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-warns-israel-would-lose-all-us-support-if-it-annexes-west-bank-1.500318797>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/nearly-700-people-flee-thailand-after-myanmar-scam-centre-raid-2025-10-23/>).

Context: 2025 National Basketball Association illegal gambling prosecution.

**Archived source account.** A court in London, United Kingdom, sentences a Colombian man to life in prison for the murder and dismemberment of two men in London in July 2024. The man also pleaded guilty to three counts of possession of child pornography.

<a id="event-2025-10-24-4-9"></a>

Context: Pork barrel scam.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines' anti-graft court acquits former Senate president Juan Ponce Enrile, his former chief of staff Gigi Reyes, and businesswoman Janet Lim-Napoles of their remaining graft charges, citing failure to prove their guilt. The three had been charged over their alleged misuse of the Priority Development Assistance Fund.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2129441/enrile-acquitted-of-remaining-graft-charges-in-pork-barrel-case/>); [ABS-CBN News](<https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/nation/2025/10/24/enrile-acquitted-of-graft-in-pork-barrel-case-1019>).

<a id="event-2025-10-24-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** A manhunt is launched for Ethiopian national Hadush Gerberslasie Kebatu, whose sexual assault of a 14-year-old girl sparked anti-immigration protests in Epping, Essex, England, after he was accidentally released from prison.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2d5rl36vgo>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-10-24-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Irish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of the Republic of Ireland vote for the next President to succeed Michael D. Higgins, who is term-limited. The candidates are independent candidate Catherine Connolly and Fine Gael candidate Heather Humphreys.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2y04znx4ro>).

<a id="event-2025-10-24-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Croatian parliament votes to reintroduce compulsory military service, which had been shifted to a volunteer system in 2008. The new conscription will require two months of basic training, allowing conscientious objectors to opt for civilian service.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/croatia-compulsory-military-service-ukraine-32c84a8c4afc8790bee82644d8366e46>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Diplomat](<https://thediplomat.com/2025/10/hanoi-convention-vietnams-middle-power-moment/>); [UNODC](<https://www.unodc.org/unodc/cybercrime/convention/home.html>).

Context: Assassination of Shinzo Abe.

Tanzanian police use tear gas to break up the protests and impose a curfew. Internet connectivity is disrupted shortly after.

Context: 2025 United States elections.

<a id="event-2025-11-04-3-3"></a>

Context: 2025 United States federal government shutdown.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/government-shutdown-latest-record-history-trump-senate-votes/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-04-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican president Claudia Sheinbaum announces a security plan for the state of Michoacán following the assassination of the mayor of Uruapan, Carlos Manzo, who was shot and killed on Saturday. The plan includes the dispatch of the National Guard, more federal personnel, and the creation of a special unit at the state's prosecution office.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/morocco-declares-national-holiday-mark-un-resolution-western-sahara-2025-11-04/>).

Context: 2019 Bolivian political crisis.

<a id="event-2025-11-05-3-5"></a>

Context: Human rights in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** A Malaysian high court rules that police and the government are responsible for the enforced disappearances of activist Amri Che Mat and pastor Raymond Koh in 2016 and 2017, respectively, ordering investigations to be reopened and awarding damages exceeding RM 33 million (US$8 million) to their families. The decision marks the first judicial finding of state involvement in enforced disappearances in Malaysia.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nurse-life-sentence-murder-10-patients-germany/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-05-3-7"></a>

Governor Kenta Suzuki requested aid, saying that local authorities lack manpower to handle the situation.

**Archived source account.** Bulgaria's parliament approves legal amendments giving a state-appointed manager expanded authority over Lukoil's refinery in Burgas, including operational control and the power to sell shares, to prevent a shutdown when U.S. sanctions on the refinery's Russian owner take effect.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/bulgaria-lukoil-refinery-shutdown-russia-sanctions-11eff472c05a533eb64749cd598c8187>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-11-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and four others are injured, including one critically, in a fire at a perfume warehouse in Dilovası, Kocaeli Province, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0kprpy26k6o>).

<a id="event-2025-11-08-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and 15 others are injured by storm surges amid rough seas off the coast of Tenerife, Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/storm-surge-deaths-tenerife-canary-islands-86539457241ce2296015e1278cdb8994>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/three-die-heavy-seas-batter-spanish-island-tenerife-2025-11-09/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-08-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 G20 Johannesburg summit, South Africa–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces that it will send no delegates to the 2025 G20 summit in Johannesburg, South Africa, citing accusations of persecution of the Afrikaner minority.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/trump-g20-south-africa-farmers-f2596a3a41c1736fbcc0c1c8b624caa1>).

<a id="event-2025-11-08-3-3"></a>

Context: Bolivia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia and the United States announce that they will restore diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level after 17 years.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2025/11/1311026/bolivia-and-united-states-will-reestablish-relations-ambassador-level>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-08-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico, arrest a man suspected of participating in the 1994 assassination of presidential candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio Murrieta, and take him to a maximum security prison in central Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/new-suspect-arrested-1994-mexican-presidential-candidate-assassination-3b07ec37355a7c149dd532f825372303>).

Context: 2025 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** Rodrigo Paz is sworn in as the new president of Bolivia, succeeding Luis Arce.

<a id="event-2025-11-08-5-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Guinean presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Guinea's supreme court publishes a provisional list of nine presidential candidates for the upcoming election, including junta leader Mamady Doumbouya, while excluding former prime minister Lansana Kouyaté on procedural grounds.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/guinea-election-president-junta-doumbouya-f886c4d739e2a157db9e980c6d683dde>).

<a id="event-2025-11-08-5-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Tanzanian election protests.

**Archived source account.** Tanzanian authorities charge hundreds of people with treason over protests linked to the disputed elections, including opposition officials such as Chadema secretary-general John Mnyika, while additional arrest warrants are issued for others, including Kawe MP Josephat Gwajima.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/tanzania-election-protests-opposition-treason-charges-aba45579e7e2d37b268f902510734399>).

<a id="event-2025-11-08-5-7"></a>

Context: 2026 Djiboutian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Djiboutian president Ismaïl Omar Guelleh accepts his party's nomination to seek a sixth term in next year's election after parliament lifted the constitutional age limit for presidential candidates.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/11/08/djibouti-s-president-guelleh-announces-candidacy-for-sixth-term_6747263_4.html>).

<a id="event-2025-11-08-5-9"></a>

Context: Kenya–Uganda relations.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan president Yoweri Museveni confirms that two Kenyan activists were detained after attending an opposition rally and accuses them of working with rival political groups; both men are released to Kenyan authorities following diplomatic discussions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/uganda-kenyan-activists-museveni-142d6e10223d026e685f28b520d332db>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-11-08-6-2"></a>

Context: 2025 WTA Tour / 2025 WTA Finals.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, Elena Rybakina of Kazakhstan becomes the first Asian player to win a WTA Finals title after defeating Aryna Sabalenka, 6–3, 7–6(7–0) to win the singles title at the 2025 WTA Finals. By winning the title undefeated, Rybakina wins US$5.235 million in prize money, breaking the previous year's record for the largest prize money earned by a female tennis player at a single event.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sports](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/c33pl2j56vgo>).

Context: 2020 United States presidential election / Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election, Trump fake electors plot.

**Archived source account.** United States president Donald Trump grants pardons to 77 people, including political allies who are accused of electoral fraud-related charges from the 2020 presidential election, including several who have pled guilty.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2025/11/10/nx-s1-5604174/trump-pardons-2020-election>).

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** Former South Korean president Yoon Suk Yeol, former defense minister Kim Yong-hyun, and former Defense Counterintelligence Command leader Yeo In-hyung are indicted on additional charges related to Yoon's attempt to invoke martial law last December alleging that they ordered surveillance drones to be sent into North Korea to stoke tensions and justify their plans.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/south-koreas-ex-president-yoon-indicted-on-new-charges/a-74681478>); [The Chosun Ilbo](<https://www.chosun.com/english/national-en/2025/11/11/5YLGZFT6HNAIVBIOTUHZQZIAKI/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-graft-agency-says-arrest-warrant-issued-ex-oil-minister-sylva-over-fraud-2025-11-10/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Colombia–United States relations, 2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers.

**Archived source account.** Colombian president Gustavo Petro orders public forces to halt intelligence sharing with the United States Intelligence Community until the U.S. ceases its military strikes on vessels in the Caribbean Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombia-president-orders-suspension-intelligence-sharing-with-us-2025-11-12/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-2-3"></a>

Context: Japan–Russia relations, International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Russia indefinitely bans 30 Japanese nationals, including a foreign ministry official, from entering the country in response to Japan's sanctions on Russian entities over the war in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/russia-bars-30-japanese-individuals-response-ukraine-sanctions-2025-11-11/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-1"></a>

Context: 2006 Noida serial murders.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India acquits Surendra Koli of all remaining charges in the series of child murders and rapes which occurred between 2005 and 2006 in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, and ordering his immediate release. Koli was originally sentenced to death and was serving a life sentence for the remaining cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/nithari-killings-supreme-court-acquits-prime-accused-surendra-koli-in-last-pending-case/article70265652.ece>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-3"></a>

Context: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

**Archived source account.** A high court in Seoul, South Korea, issues an arrest warrant for former National Intelligence Service director Cho Tae-yong for allegedly tampering with evidence regarding former president Yoon Suk Yeol's declaration of martial law, among other charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-court-issued-arrest-warrant-former-spy-agency-chief-under-probe-2025-11-11/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-5"></a>

Context: 2025 Turkish football betting scandal.

**Archived source account.** A court in Istanbul, Turkey, issues arrest warrants for eight suspects involved in an investigation into alleged illegal sports betting by Turkish Football Federation referees, club presidents, and players.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-football-betting-scandal-arrest-warrants-issued/a-74698309>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-7"></a>

Context: Anti-war protests in Russia.

**Archived source account.** A court in Saint Petersburg, Russia, extends street musician Diana Loginova's detention for 13 days for allegedly violating public order during an October performance that included anti-war songs, marking her third consecutive sentence since mid-October.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-street-singer-arrest-44d922d3477b0bba75abef3371627c0a>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-9"></a>

Context: Corruption in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine starts investigating a large-scale corruption scheme in the country’s energy sector, involving the state nuclear power operator Energoatom.

Source citations (as archived): [EuroNews](<https://www.euronews.com/2025/11/11/ukraines-anti-corruption-watchdog-probes-alleged-energy-sector-scheme>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Gabonese court sentences former first lady Sylvia Bongo Ondimba and her son, Noureddin Bongo Valentin, to 20 years in prison each for receiving and embezzling public funds, among other charges. Both were tried in absentia as they live in exile.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/gabon-court-sentences-ex-leader-s-wife-and-son-to-20-years-in-jail-for-graft-f5e39f21>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Southwark Crown Court in London, United Kingdom, sentences Chinese fraudster Qian Zhimin to 11 years and eight months in prison for running a Ponzi scheme that defrauded over 128,000 investors and laundered the proceeds into Bitcoin, resulting in the recovery of about ₿61,000 in the country's largest cryptocurrency seizure.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/uk-china-cryptoqueen-bitcoin-fraud-b115ccc6e98f015dad01fa75d6ce0cf7>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-11-11-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Iraqi parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Iraqis vote to elect the 329 members of the Council of Representatives, who will elect the country's president and approve the president's appointment of a prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/iraq-vote-turnout-more-than-55-sharply-up-on-2021-fe90fb49>).

Context: 2025 Irish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Catherine Connolly is sworn in as the 10th president of Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cnveplv3lzmo>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-4-5"></a>

Context: Gun law in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand announces the transfer of gun licensing responsibilities from the police to an independent Firearms Safety Authority reporting directly to the government.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/christchurch-shooting-guns-new-zealand-semiautomatic-ban-f370885a43616f652410fe6d94768ef2>).

<a id="event-2025-11-11-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people protest in Belgrade, Serbia, against the proposed re-development of the former Yugoslav People's Army General Staff Building, which was delisted as a cultural asset last year.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/serbs-protest-kushner-backed-belgrade-project-at-army-site/a-74702710>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-11-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sun emits a X5.1-class solar flare from sunspot AR4274, the most intense since October 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [Space](<https://www.space.com/astronomy/sun/sun-unleashes-strongest-solar-flare-of-2025-sparking-radio-blackouts-across-africa-and-europe>).

### 2025-11-12

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-11-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Cambodia–Thailand relations / 2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis, Cambodian–Thai border dispute.

**Archived source account.** Cambodian prime minister Hun Manet accuses Thailand of shooting and killing a Cambodian villager near the border, two days after a Thai soldier was injured by a land mine in the area, increasing tensions and threatening the ceasefire that put an end to the conflict in July.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-border-conflict-ceasefire-5b4c71e8bccb49520478e2b54e0ad640>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-11-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Mint strikes its last penny for circulation, though it will remain legal tender. There are still an estimated 300 billion pennies in circulation according to the Treasury Department.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/bessent-us-treasurer-strike-final-penny-philadelphia-mint-2025-11-12/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-11-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed in a stampede during a military recruitment event in Accra, Ghana.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ghana-stampede-military-recruitment-ffea0f78cdbc5f9e82dfb980b25f1a92>).

<a id="event-2025-11-12-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people are killed and 20 others are injured when a bus collides with a truck and crashes down a ravine in Arequipa, Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/peru-scores-killed-in-bus-accident-in-arequipa-region/a-74718783>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/13/at-least-37-people-killed-in-peru-when-bus-crashes-into-ravine>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-11-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Canada–Russia relations, International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** During a G7 meeting on the Russo-Ukrainian war, Canadian foreign minister Anita Anand announces new sanctions targeting Russian entities involved in cyberattacks, drone production, energy infrastructure, and the transport of oil via the shadow fleet.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/11/12/g7-ministers-discuss-ukraine-support-as-canada-unveils-new-russia-sanctions>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-12-4-2"></a>

Context: Corruption in Ukraine / Operation Midas.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian justice minister German Galushchenko and energy minister Svitlana Hrynchuk resign following a National Anti-Corruption Bureau investigation into an alleged kickback scheme involving Ukraine's nuclear power plant operator Energoatom. The alleged head of the corruption group, Tymur Mindych, has fled Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/12/zelenskyy-fires-ministers-accused-of-involvement-in-bribery-scheme-as-public-outrage-grows>).

<a id="event-2025-11-12-4-4"></a>

Context: Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal jury orders Boeing to pay $28.45 million in damages to the family of Shikha Garg, a victim of the 2019 Ethiopian Airlines 737 MAX crash, marking the first civil trial verdict related to the two fatal MAX accidents.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bhpioneer.com/news/national_world_news/us-jury-boeing-owes-28-mn-to-family-of-ethiopian-airlines-crash-victim/article_7ea741ee-7cfe-501f-b2a5-d7ca3eab4f59.html>).

<a id="event-2025-11-12-4-6"></a>

Context: Crime in Germany.

**Archived source account.** An 18-year-old is sentenced to eight years and nine months in prison for a shooting at a bar in Göppingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, that killed one person and injured two others in 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Presse-Agentur](<https://nordot.app/1361324445139845498>).

<a id="event-2025-11-12-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are injured and 29 people are arrested when a riot breaks out at a immigration detention site in Sintiki, Serres, Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/migration-greece-riot-crete-eu-fb9fdcea1b5cfc9fc6fdf0c7eef21d27>).

<a id="event-2025-11-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Iraqi parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Preliminary results show prime minister Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani's Reconstruction and Development Coalition leading the polls.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/coalition-led-by-iraqi-pm-sudani-comes-first-iraqs-parliamentary-election-two-2025-11-12/>).

Context: 2025 United States federal government shutdown.

**Archived source account.** A bill passes through Congress and is signed by president Donald Trump, ending the longest government shutdown in American history at 43 days.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c9862nj0pvgt>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-11-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention reports about 300,000 confirmed and suspected cholera cases in the continent, mostly in Angola and Burundi, and more than 7,000 deaths in 2025, marking Africa's largest outbreak in 25 years and a more than 30% increase from the previous year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/africa-experiencing-worst-outbreak-cholera-25-years-africa-cdc-says-2025-11-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-13-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Islamabad suicide bombing, 2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani interior minister Mohsin Naqvi says that Afghan nationals carried out Tuesday's suicide bombing in Islamabad, which killed 12 people and injured many others, adding that the attack was planned and directed from Afghanistan, increasing tensions between the countries.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-afghans-nationals-behind-suicide-attacks-5ffe092756632759c13dcfc34897c656>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/amp/economy/bananas-and-beef-white-house-announces-latin-america-trade-deals.phtml>).

Context: Syria–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Spanish police dismantle an alleged international network accused of trafficking minors from the Canary Islands to France, arresting eleven suspects in operations in Lanzarote, Las Palmas, and Madrid.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/spanish-police-break-up-ring-accused-trafficking-minors-france-2025-11-13/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the July Revolution.

**Archived source account.** Bangladeshi chief adviser Muhammad Yunus announces a national referendum on the July Charter, which recognizes the 2024 uprising that ousted former prime minister Sheikh Hasina.

**Archived source account.** The state of Victoria enacts Australia's first treaty with Indigenous peoples, establishing a permanent First Peoples' Assembly and a truth-telling commission as part of a formal state–Indigenous governance framework.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australian-state-signs-countrys-first-treaty-with-indigenous-people-into-law-2025-11-13/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tanzanias-president-appoints-mwigulu-nchemba-prime-minister-parliament-speaker-2025-11-13/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-11-13-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, Blue Origin launches NASA's ESCAPADE spacecraft mission to study Mars' magnetosphere. It is the second launch of Blue Origin's New Glenn launch vehicle, and the first successful landing of the vehicle's reusable first stage.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/13/science/blue-origin-launch-rocket.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-11-13-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The governing board of Major League Soccer (MLS), the top men's association football league in Canada and the U.S., votes to change its season from its current calendar-year schedule to a summer-to-spring schedule spanning two calendar years, aligning MLS with most international leagues. The first season under the new calendar will be 2027–28, with an abbreviated transitional season from February to May 2027.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/46943880/mls-switching-schedule-align-world-soccer>).

**Archived source account.** Due to no candidates receiving 50% of the vote in the presidential election, a runoff occurs between left-wing candidate Jeannette Jara of the Unity for Chile coalition and right-wing candidate José Antonio Kast of the Change for Chile coalition, with the vote set for December 14.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/philippines-2-marcos-cabinet-members-resign-over-ghost-flood-control-projects-1.500349110>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-adds-ex-pm-kasyanov-economist-guriev-extremists-terrorists-list-2025-11-17/>).

The ECCHR alleges that the joint task force illegally imprisoned, beat, tortured, and killed over 220 civilians.

<a id="event-2025-11-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Gaza Strip under Hamas, Blockade of the Gaza Strip.

The court rules that the group helped plan the broader coup attempt linked to former president Jair Bolsonaro, who was previously convicted in the same case.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/brazil-court-hands-officers-up-to-24-years-for-plot-to-kill-lula-4d5b71c3>).

<a id="event-2025-11-20-4-2"></a>

Context: 2025 United Nations Climate Change Conference, Brazil–Germany relations.

**Archived source account.** The conference is temporarily suspended after a fire breaks out at the venue.

<a id="event-2025-11-20-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 170 mountain climbers are evacuated when Mount Semeru on Java, Indonesia, suddenly erupts.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-mount-semeru-volcano-eruption-climbers-569bcb33f108fce7075b483b5fda53ef>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-11-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Belarus–Lithuania relations, Belarus–European Union border crisis.

**Archived source account.** Lithuania reopens its Medininkai and Šalčininkai border checkpoints with Belarus after closing them over security concerns involving weather balloons used for smuggling.

Source citations (as archived): [TVP World](<https://tvpworld.com/90121121/lithuania-restores-travel-at-two-major-belarus-border-checkpoints>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-20-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests.

**Archived source account.** Clashes erupt across Nepal between supporters of ousted prime minister K. P. Sharma Oli and supporters of interim prime minister Sushila Karki. A curfew is imposed in various districts.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/gatherings-banned-in-nepal-as-fresh-gen-z-protests-erupt-9669255>).

<a id="event-2025-11-20-6-3"></a>

Context: Human trafficking in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** A Philippine regional trial court sentences former de facto Bamban mayor Alice Guo to life imprisonment after finding her guilty of human trafficking for a scam center in her town.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-20/philippine-court-convicts-ex-mayor-for-human-trafficking-on-role-in-scam-center>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2l20jzp30o>).

<a id="event-2025-11-20-6-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** A Nigerian court sentences Biafran separatist Nnamdi Kanu to life imprisonment on seven terrorism charges over his leadership of the Indigenous People of Biafra militant group.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-nnamdi-kanu-9708d396efd89ac07b90b77d02fd96ff>).

<a id="event-2025-11-20-6-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bulgarian law enforcement arrests 35 people linked to a transnational network accused of trafficking cultural goods, with authorities reporting large seizures of artifacts, antique firearms, vehicles, and safes during coordinated raids with Europol and Eurojust.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/bulgaria-arrests-35-large-scale-trafficking-cultural-goods-2025-11-20/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-20-6-7"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [RTVE](<https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20251120/supremo-condena-fiscal-general-revelacion-datos-inhabilitacion-dos-anos-multa/16824031.shtml>).

<a id="event-2025-11-20-7-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Tongan general election.

**Archived source account.** Tongans vote to elect 26 of the 30 members of the Legislative Assembly. Members of the country's nobility elect nine representatives, while the rest of the voting population elect 17 MPs.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/579439/tonga-election-polls-open-for-voters-to-elect-new-legislative-assembly>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/lula-taps-brazils-solicitor-general-supreme-court-seat-2025-11-20/>).

### 2025-11-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1324091778](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20November%2021&oldid=1324091778>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-11-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Kupiansk offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian Chief of the General Staff Valery Gerasimov announces that Russian forces have captured the city of Kupiansk, the administrative centre of Kupiansk Raion, Kharkiv Oblast. The Ukrainian military denies the statement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-met-with-russian-top-military-brass-kremlin-says-2025-11-20/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The United States outlines a new 28-point peace proposal to end the war in Ukraine, including a casus foederis guarantee for Ukraine and the cession of Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine to Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/2025/11/20/trump-ukraine-peace-plan-28-points-russia>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump gives Ukraine a deadline of November 27 to accept the peace proposal, or the U.S. will end all weapons shipments and military intelligence support. Russian president Vladimir Putin confirms he has formally received the proposal from the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c6257wrx301t>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Zaporizhzhia strikes.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and three others are injured in a Russian glide bomb strike on a high-rise apartment block in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2025/11/21/at-least-five-killed-in-russian-glide-bomb-strike-on-southern-ukraine>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-0-10"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian teenagers, aged 16 and 18, are killed by Israeli soldiers during a raid in East Jerusalem, in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/11/21/live-israel-keeps-bombing-gaza-kills-two-in-occupied-east-jerusalem>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-0-13"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria, Religious violence in Nigeria / 2025 Niger State school kidnapping.

**Archived source account.** One person is shot, and 315 people, including 12 teachers and 303 schoolchildren, are abducted in an attack on a Catholic school in Agwara, Niger State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3w7621xypyo>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-11-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Miss Universe 2025.

**Archived source account.** Fátima Bosch of Mexico is crowned Miss Universe in Nonthaburi, Thailand, becoming the fourth Mexican woman to win the title.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://www.abs-cbn.com/lifestyle/pageants-beauty-queens/2025/11/21/mexico-wins-miss-universe-2025-crown-ph-s-ahtisa-manalo-is-3rd-runner-up-1208>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-11-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Bangladesh earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 5.5 Mw earthquake strikes central Bangladesh, killing ten people and wounding over 350 more.

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/-57-magnitude-earthquake-kills-10-in-bangladesh/3749773>); [Jamuna Television](<https://jamuna.tv/national/646497>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indian Air Force HAL Tejas crashes at the Dubai Airshow in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, killing the pilot.

<a id="event-2025-11-21-2-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-chemical-factory-boiler-explosion-punjab-afd487d71c4e5f5c70631d6adf25f300>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/21/explosion-at-glue-factory-in-eastern-pakistan-kills-at-least-16>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-11-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jamaica declares a leptospirosis outbreak after Hurricane Melissa, with health minister Christopher Tufton reporting nine confirmed cases, 28 suspected cases, and six suspected deaths linked to flood-related exposure to contaminated water.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/jamaica-reports-deadly-leptospirosis-outbreak-after-hurricane-melissa-2025-11-21/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Flood control projects scandal in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Sandiganbayan issues arrest warrants for former representative Zaldy Co and 17 others, including government engineers and construction executives, over alleged irregularities in a ₱289000000 flood control project in Oriental Mindoro.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/philippines-flood-control-corruption-zaldy-co-8eb573f422425a862d69ff84fce0e18b>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-4-4"></a>

Context: Peruvian political crisis / 2022 Peruvian self-coup attempt.

**Archived source account.** A Peruvian Supreme Court judge orders the arrest and five-month preventive detention of former prime minister Betssy Chávez, who is under asylum at the Mexican embassy and is being prosecuted for alleged seditious conspiracy in connection with former president Pedro Castillo's attempt to dissolve Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-orders-arrest-ex-prime-minister-under-mexico-asylum-lima-2025-11-21/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-21-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** High Court judge Bobbie Cheema-Grubb sentences former Welsh MEP Nathan Gill to 10 and a half years in prison after he pleaded guilty to accepting bribes from ex-Ukrainian lawmaker Oleh Voloshyn to promote pro-Russian positions in the European Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/britain-politician-reform-bribery-sentence-372e14bfb629aa413814154d6321736f>).
