Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.kuow.org/stories/u-s-set-to-label-maduro-tied-cartel-de-los-soles-as-a-terror-organization>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Arrest of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** A panel of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court upholds an order to keep former president Jair Bolsonaro in police custody after he allegedly tampered with his ankle monitor while appealing a 27-year prison sentence for plotting a coup.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-top-court-panel-votes-keep-bolsonaro-under-police-custody-2025-11-24/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** A court in Embilipitiya, Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka, sentences ten people, including three women, to death for the murder of a man in October 2011. Sri Lanka has an unofficial moratorium in place, with the last execution taking place in 1976.

Source citations (as archived): [OnLanka](<https://www.onlanka.com/news/ten-people-sentenced-to-death-over-2011-embilipitiya-murder.html>); [Mirror Sri Lanka](<https://www.dailymirror.lk/breaking-news/Ten-sentenced-to-death-over-murder-in-Embilipitiya/108-325886>).

<a id="event-2025-11-24-3-5"></a>

Context: Prosecution of James Comey, Prosecution of Letitia James.

**Archived source account.** Judge Cameron McGowan Currie rules that the appointment of Lindsey Halligan as U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Virginia was illegal, dismissing the indictments against James Comey and Letitia James without prejudice.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/judge-dismisses-cases-james-comey-letitia-james-finding-prosecutor-was-rcna244775>).

<a id="event-2025-11-24-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and ten others are injured when a man rammed a stolen car into pedestrians in Tokyo, Japan. The perpetrator is arrested by police at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/japan/tokyo-car-crash-hit-and-run-b2871128.html>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/accident-injury-police-japan-holiday-530ee11a714cdacc8c1e43a339c406c6>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-11-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Egyptian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Egyptians vote in the second round to elect parliament members after the National Elections Authority annulled votes in 19 of the 70 constituencies due to various violations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/egypt-election-parliament-rerun-6c6e86670ff2df30596238c097659c95>).

<a id="event-2025-11-24-4-3"></a>

Context: India–Israel relations.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli government approves a plan jointly-coordinated with the Indian government to admit 5,800 members of the India-based Bnei Menashe ethnic group to Israel under Aliyah laws and will settle them to the Galilee region.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/israel-to-admit-thousands-from-indias-jewish-lost-tribe/a-74855366>).

<a id="event-2025-11-24-4-5"></a>

Context: Pauline Hanson's burqa incidents.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Senate censures and suspends Queensland senator Pauline Hanson for a week after she wore a burqa in the chamber to push for a burqa ban in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/australia-pauline-hanson-burqa-far-right-senator-called-racist-over-protest/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-24-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Unions in Belgium begin a three-day general strike across the country to protest Prime Minister Bart de Wever's government of "social dismantling" through budget cuts in their savings program.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/belgium-faces-nationwide-disruption-as-unions-strike/a-74870459>).

### 2025-11-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360236012](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20November%2025&oldid=1360236012>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-11-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo–Ukrainian war / Kyiv strikes, Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Seven people in Kyiv, Ukraine, and three more in Rostov-on-Don, Russia, are killed as both countries launch airstrikes at each other. Several more people are wounded in both countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/11/25/live-5-killed-in-kyiv-rostov-as-russia-ukraine-carry-out-attacks>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/25/russia-strikes-kyiv-ukraine-us-brokered-peace-talks-abu-dhabi>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes.

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan says nine children and a woman were killed when a civilian home was hit by a Pakistani airstrike in Khost, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/25/taliban-says-pakistan-bombed-afghanistan-killing-nine-children-and-a-woman>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-0-7"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières withdraws its staff from a hospital in central Darfur, Sudan, after a stretcher bearer is shot dead and several others are injured, stating that it will not resume operations unless the Rapid Support Forces guarantee the safety of its personnel and patients.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/msf-pulls-out-darfur-hospital-after-fatal-shooting-2025-11-25/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-0-9"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven people in a village located in Cotabato, Philippines are fatally shot during a firefight between the Moro Islamic Liberation Front and the Moro National Liberation Front that left 48 families temporarily displaced.

Source citations (as archived): [Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2146294/7-dead-as-moro-groups-clash-in-cotabato>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-11-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Polygamy in Christianity.

**Archived source account.** Pope Leo XIV approves a decree affirming the Catholic Church's rejection of polygamous and polyamorous marriages.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/one-spouse-is-enough-vatican-tells-worlds-catholics-2025-11-25/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-11-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Insurance in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Federal Court fines United Super, the Cbus pension fund's trustee, A$23.5 million (US$15.2 million) for systemic failures that caused extensive delays in processing death and disability insurance claims affecting over 7,000 members.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australian-pension-fund-cbus-fined-over-15-million-death-disability-claim-delays-2025-11-25/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-11-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Let L-410UVP operating as Nari Air Flight 114 and chartered by Samaritan's Purse crashes in Unity State, South Sudan, killing all three crew members while en route from Juba with two tonnes of food aid for flood-displaced communities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/plane-carrying-food-aid-crashes-south-sudan-three-dead-2025-11-25/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hayli Gubbi volcano in the Afar Region of Ethiopia erupts, sending ash plumes across Oman and Yemen, and prompts flight cancellations in northern India.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/ethiopia-volcano-eruption-india-air-travel/a-74882548>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-volcano-afar-hayli-gubbi-15232fa7dc1920f44a89e92699b845b1>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-11-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Food security in Nigeria, Islamic extremism in Northern Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** The World Food Programme reports that escalating instability in northern Nigeria is increasing acute food insecurity to record levels, with nearly 35 million people projected to face hunger in 2026 as the agency exhausts its funding by December.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-faces-record-hunger-amid-insurgent-attacks-aid-cuts-2025-11-25/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-11-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Moldova–Russia relations, Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Moldova reports that six Russian drones entered its airspace, including one that came down on a residential roof near Florești and another that crossed into Moldova before continuing toward Romania.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/moldova-complains-unacceptable-intrusion-russian-drone-2025-11-26/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-25-6-1"></a>

Context: Arrest of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** Former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro starts his 27-year sentence for leading a coup plot.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-bolsonaro-prison-sentence-4ffc790826dd9dcd008dc666b6b9dda7>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-6-3"></a>

Context: Counter-terrorism in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore orders Meta and TikTok to block local access to the social media accounts of an Australian man whose posts advocate replacing Singapore's secular system with an Islamic state and seek to cause communal tensions and influence elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/singapore-blocks-tiktok-meta-accounts-australian-linked-radicalisation-2025-11-26/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-6-5"></a>

Context: Killing of Lisa from Abcoude.

**Archived source account.** A court in Amsterdam, Netherlands, begins the trial of an illegal migrant from Nigeria who murdered a 17-year-old girl in Duivendrecht.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS in Dutch](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2591921-rechtszaak-over-moord-op-17-jarige-lisa-uit-abcoude-van-start>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-6-7"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the European Union, Same-sex union legislation.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice rules for all European Union member states to recognize same-sex marriage and not discriminate against same-sex couples. The ruling does not force individual countries to legalize same-sex marriages.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/eu-same-sex-marriage-lgbtq-poland/a-74876738>).

<a id="event-2025-11-25-6-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two wanted gunmen, identified as "extremist" brothers, are killed and three security forces are wounded in a shootout in Ar-Ramtha, Jordan.

Source citations (as archived): [Sada News](<https://www.sadanews.ps/en/news/252879.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-11-25-7-1"></a>

Context: 2026 Ugandan general election.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan opposition party National Unity Platform says security forces have detained more than 300 supporters and officials since presidential candidate Bobi Wine began campaigning, while police report several arrests linked to clashes at Wine's rallies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ugandan-opposition-says-over-300-supporters-detained-presidential-campaign-2025-11-25/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-11-25-8-1"></a>

Context: Chinese space program.

**Archived source account.** The Shenzhou 22 spacecraft enters orbit after China conducts its first emergency space launch to restore a safe return option for the three astronauts aboard the Tiangong space station following damage to the Shenzhou 20 return capsule earlier in November. The uncrewed spacecraft, launched on a Long March 2F rocket, carries replacement parts and supplies and aims to return the current crew to Earth in 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/china-launch-shenzhou-22-spaceship-0411-gmt-state-media-reports-2025-11-25/>).

### 2025-11-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1325602861](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20November%2026&oldid=1325602861>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-11-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Israeli occupation of the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military announces the start of a military operation in the northern Samaria area in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/israel-begins-west-bank-operation-amid-settlement-expansion/a-74901208>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A drone strike is carried out at the Khor Mor gas field in Sulaymaniyah, Iraq, causing major power cuts across the northern Kurdistan Region.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/drone-attack-targets-major-iraq-gas-field-kurdistan-security-sources-say-2025-11-26/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-11-26-1-2"></a>

Context: Holy See–Lebanon relations, Holy See–Turkey relations / Visit by Pope Leo XIV to Turkey and Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Pope Leo XIV begins his first papal trip, first to İznik and Nicaea in Turkey, then to Bkerké, the Monastery of Saint Maron, and the Port of Beirut in Lebanon. The trip will include an ecumenical commemoration of the 1,700th anniversary of the First Council of Nicaea and a mass in honor of the victims of the 2020 Beirut explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/vatican-pope-trip-turkey-lebanon-0b7733129e6f761d9a644aac4fb12e40>); [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-11/pope-leo-xiv-apostolic-visit-turkiye-lebanon-press-briefing.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-11-26-2-2"></a>

Context: Economy of Ukraine, Russo-Ukrainian war / Economic impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The International Monetary Fund announces a staff-level agreement with Ukraine on a proposed Extended Fund Facility worth more than US$8 billion, outlining fiscal and monetary policies intended to support macroeconomic stability, debt sustainability, and external financing amid the ongoing war with Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/russia-ukraine-war/article/imf-ukraine-reach-staff-level-deal-on-arrangement-worth-over-us8-billion/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-11-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Wang Fuk Court fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire at a housing estate in Tai Po, Hong Kong, leaves at least 94 people dead, dozens injured, and 279 more missing. Police arrest three men for suspected manslaughter in the fire.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/international/hong-kong-arrests-three-alleged-manslaughter-deadly-fire>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-tower-fire-toll-rises-44-police-arrest-three-2025-11-26/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/hong-kong-tai-po-wang-fuk-court-fire-d3da6740dd2c90f08d28dcd889db0c30>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Cyclone Senyar, 2025 Thailand–Malaysia floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the floods in southern Thailand increases to 33 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/thai-floods-death-toll-33-official-says-2025-11-26/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed when a UV Express van collides with a truck in Camalig, Albay, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Manila Bulletin](<https://mb.com.ph/2025/11/26/11-dead-in-uv-express-truck-collision-in-albay>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed in an explosion at a weapons depot in Idlib Governorate, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2624044/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Swiss tourist is killed and another person is critically injured in a bull shark attack off the coast of Crowdy Bay National Park, New South Wales, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz68lglg5vlo>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-11-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Cyprus–Lebanon relations.

**Archived source account.** Cyprus and Lebanon sign a long-delayed maritime boundary agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lebanon-cyprus-finalize-sea-border-agreement-after-20-127889896>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Dominican Republic–United States relations, War on drugs, 2025 United States naval deployment in the Caribbean.

**Archived source account.** The Dominican Republic permits the United States to use the Las Américas International Airport in Punta Caucedo, Santo Domingo, and the San Isidro Air Base to support Operation Southern Spear targeting alleged drug traffickers linked by the U.S. to Venezuelan authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251126-dominican-republic-to-allow-us-to-use-facilities-for-anti-drug-ops>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-4-5"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Foreign relations of Hungary.

**Archived source account.** Bosnian defence minister Zukan Helez denies approval for Hungarian foreign minister Péter Szijjártó to land his military aircraft in Banja Luka, Republika Srpska, citing Hungary's support for former Srpska president Milorad Dodik, whom Helez accuses of undermining Bosnia and Herzegovina's sovereignty.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/bosnia-refuses-let-military-plane-carrying-hungarian-foreign-minister-land-2025-11-26/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-4-7"></a>

Context: South Africa–United States relations, 2026 G20 Doral summit, South African farm attacks.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Donald Trump announces that South Africa will not be invited to the 2026 G20 summit in Doral, Florida, and that U.S. payments and subsidies to the country will cease, citing South Africa's refusal to transfer G20 hosting responsibilities to a U.S. embassy representative at the 2025 Johannesburg summit and criticizing its treatment of Afrikaners, among other reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2624085/world>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-11-26-5-2"></a>

Context: 2025 deployment of federal forces in the United States / 2025 Washington, D.C. National Guard shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two members of the U.S. National Guard are shot and critically wounded in Washington, D.C.. The perpetrator, who is also wounded, is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20251126-two-national-guard-members-killed-in-shooting-near-white-house>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-5-5"></a>

Context: Women in Italy / Women's rights in Italy.

**Archived source account.** The Italian parliament approves a bill to punish femicide with life imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/italy-femicide-law-crime-gender-violence-women-99e4be4aaba9f6b940d834ed6c7cb4d0>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-5-7"></a>

Context: Corruption in Peru.

**Archived source account.** A Peruvian court sentences former president Martín Vizcarra to 14 years in prison for accepting bribes from construction companies while serving as governor of Moquegua between 2011 and 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.trtafrika.com/english/article/38522ad72294>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-5-9"></a>

Context: Murders of Yuna and Minu Jo.

**Archived source account.** Justice Geoffrey Venning of New Zealand's High Court sentences 45-year-old mother Hakyung Lee to life imprisonment with a minimum non-parole period of 17 years after convicting Lee of murdering her two children in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/new-zealand-suitcase-murders-mother-sentenced-to-prison-for-life/a-74899111>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-5-11"></a>

Context: Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** The Tatmadaw grants amnesty to over 3,000 political prisoners, drops charges of over 5,500 others, and grants conditional release to 724 prisoners ahead of the general election in December.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-military-amnesty-political-prisoners-76f591d2cfa82398bf6e38c64f22ba72>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-5-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** Georgia's Tbilisi Appeal Court sentences opposition leader Nika Melia to an additional 18 months in prison for contempt of court after he threw water at a judge during a hearing, adding to the eight-month term he has been serving since May for refusing to appear at a parliamentary inquiry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/jailed-georgian-opposition-politician-gets-extra-sentence-splashing-water-judge-2025-11-26/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-11-26-6-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état, 2025 Guinea-Bissau general election.

**Archived source account.** Bissau-Guinean president Umaro Sissoco Embaló is detained following a coup d'état one day before provisional election results were expected to be released.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0edww3qgq2o>); [Jeune Afrique in French](<https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1743734/politique/guinee-bissau-umaro-sissoco-embalo-se-dit-victime-dun-coup-detat/>).

<a id="event-2025-11-26-6-3"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria, Religious violence in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Nigerian president Bola Tinubu declares a nationwide security emergency and orders the recruitment of 20,000 additional police officers and the deployment of specialised units in response to recent killings and kidnappings.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.trtworld.com/article/5862b6ee58c5>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2025-11-26-7-1"></a>

Context: Chess World Cup 2025.

**Archived source account.** Uzbek chess grandmaster Javokhir Sindarov wins the 2025 World Cup in Goa, India, at the age of 19, becoming the youngest player to win the event.

Source citations (as archived): [FIDE](<https://www.fide.com/javokhir-sindarov-crowned-2025-fide-world-cup-champion/>).

### 2025-11-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1368453127](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20November%2027&oldid=1368453127>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-11-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Crimea attacks / 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion.

**Archived source account.** A Russian court sentences eight people to life imprisonment for terrorism after a truck bomb attack on the Crimean Bridge in Crimea killed five people in October 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/russia-convicts-and-hands-life-sentences-to-8-people-over-attack-on-a-key-bridge-to-crimea/ar-AA1RfMjs>).

<a id="event-2025-11-27-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Israeli occupation of the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military and police say they are reviewing a raid in Jenin, West Bank, in which forces fatally shot two Palestinians who had exited a surrounded building after a prolonged surrender procedure.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/11/27/israeli-army-is-reviewing-the-filmed-shootings-of-two-palestinians-who-had-surrended_6747911_4.html>).

<a id="event-2025-11-27-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Three policemen are killed in a shooting attack by unknown militants with assault rifles on a roadside checkpoint in Hangu District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/militants-kill-3-police-officers-attack-checkpoint-northwest-127922767>).

<a id="event-2025-11-27-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Chinese citizens are killed in a drone–shooting attack at a gold mine in Shamsiddin Shohin District, Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-afghanistan-border-attack-chinese-nationals-death-gold-mining-taliban/33607228.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-11-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Green economy policies in Canada, Anti-environmentalism.

**Archived source account.** Canadian prime minister Mark Carney and Alberta premier Danielle Smith sign an agreement removing planned federal emissions caps and eases clean-energy rules in exchange for strengthened provincial carbon pricing and support for carbon-capture projects, while also committing to enable a privately financed oil pipeline to British Columbia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/canada-drops-emissions-cap-oil-gas-sector-agreement-with-alberta-2025-11-27/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-11-27-2-2"></a>

Context: 2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season / Cyclone Ditwah.

**Archived source account.** More than 40 people are killed, and 21 others are missing after landslides caused by heavy rains hit Sri Lanka, mainly between Badulla and Nuwara Eliya.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/sri-lanka-weather-landslides-floods-ef3a2354448a7ec58cfe4ac5d8f750d1>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-12-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ragebait is named word of the year by the Oxford University Press.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/oxford-word-rage-bait-biohack-aura-farming-205cad01227a75198aaebdea02f6409b>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-12-01-2-2"></a>

Context: 2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season / Cyclone Senyar.

**Archived source account.** The toll from the floods in Indonesia increases to 604 people killed and 464 more missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/1/floods-in-indonesia-sri-lanka-thailand-leave-close-to-1000-dead>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-2-4"></a>

Context: 2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season / Cyclone Ditwah.

**Archived source account.** The toll from the floods and landslides caused by heavy rains in Sri Lanka increases to 366 people killed and about 400 more missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/1/floods-in-indonesia-sri-lanka-thailand-leave-close-to-1000-dead>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A landslide strikes two boats docked at a river port in Ucayali, Peru, killing at least twelve people and leaving around 50 others missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz0n1rm95yxo>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-12-01-3-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Kasaï Province Ebola outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Republic of the Congo declares that the Ebola outbreak in the country since August, which resulted in 53 confirmed cases, 43 deaths, and 11 probable cases, has ended.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/congo-ebola-outbreak-update-minister-2fdefab2c0f004955e7f8e30029fa471>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cuba reports 33 deaths from dengue and chikungunya amid a widespread mosquito-borne disease outbreak, with health officials reporting thousands of new cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/cuba-says-33-have-died-mosquito-borne-illnesses-epidemic-rages-2025-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spain deploys 400 Mossos d'Esquadra and 117 Military Emergencies Unit members to contain the spread of the African swine fever virus in Catalonia after two dead wild boars tested positive for the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/spain-mobilises-military-against-swine-fever-says-contaminated-sandwich-could-be-2025-12-01/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-12-01-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état, Foreign relations of Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Nigeria grants asylum to Guinea-Bissau opposition leader and presidential candidate Fernando Dias da Costa at its embassy in Bissau to protect Dias from detention by the military junta.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/nigeria-grants-asylum-to-guinea-bissau-opposition-leader-8d3437ea>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Canada–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** Canada agrees to join the European Union's Security Action for Europe initiative, which will allow Canadian defense firms greater access to EU markets and encourage European defense investment in Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canada-agrees-join-eu-initiative-surge-defense-spending-2025-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-4-5"></a>

Context: China–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** China permits Spain to resume pork exports from regions unaffected by African swine fever following a trade prohibition imposed on November 28.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/spain-mobilises-military-against-swine-fever-says-contaminated-sandwich-could-be-2025-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-4-7"></a>

Context: Dominican Republic–United States relations, 2025 United States naval deployment in the Caribbean.

**Archived source account.** The Dominican Republic announces that its temporary agreement permitting United States military personnel to use restricted areas at Las Américas International Airport and the San Isidro Air Base for logistical counter-narcotics operations remains in effect until April 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/dominican-republic-permits-us-airport-access-anti-drug-operations-until-april-2025-12-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-4-9"></a>

Context: Honduras–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Former Honduran president Juan Orlando Hernández is released from a prison in Preston County, West Virginia, after U.S. president Donald Trump pardoned Hernández from his conviction of aiding large-scale cocaine trafficking.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251203-honduran-ex-president-leaves-us-prison-after-trump-pardons-drug-crimes>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-4-11"></a>

Context: Thailand–Vietnam relations.

**Archived source account.** Thailand extradites Vietnamese citizen Y Quynh Bđăp, who founded a human rights organization for ethnic minorities, amid concerns from human rights groups.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-vietnam-activist-extradition-bdap-aea1ce468be04d84e676633dfbef8329>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Cameroonian presidential election, 2025 Cameroonian protests.

**Archived source account.** Anicet Ekane, a 74-year-old opposition politician and leader of the MANIDEM party, dies in custody after being arrested a month ago during a crackdown in Cameroon.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/cameroon-ekane-death-detention-opposition-biya-02e756ecf21a2e06835f123029ad5404>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-5-3"></a>

Context: International Criminal Court investigation in Libya.

**Archived source account.** A senior official of the RADA Special Deterrence Forces is transferred from Germany to The Hague, Netherlands, and placed in International Criminal Court custody for alleged war crimes while serving a senior role at a Libyan prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/libyan-war-crimes-suspect-transferred-germany-hague-icc-says-2025-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Trial of Sheikh Hasina.

**Archived source account.** A Bangladeshi court sentences former prime minister Sheikh Hasina and British MP Tulip Siddiq to five years and two years in prison, respectively, for corruption involving a government land project.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-hasina-tulip-siddiq-1929bc5f3ef62959067a6da1f105605e>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-5-7"></a>

Context: Wang Fuk Court fire.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong police arrest thirteen people on suspicion of manslaughter in connection with the fire, while officials report that some scaffolding netting at the site failed to meet required fire-resistance standards.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2025/12/1327837/hong-kong-police-arrested-13-manslaughter-over-fire>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-12-01-6-2"></a>

Context: 2024–2025 Georgian protests, 2024–2025 Georgian political crisis / Use of camite during the 2024–2025 Georgian protests.

**Archived source account.** BBC World Service says that the Georgian police used water cannons laced with the chemical agent camite against protesters in Tbilisi in 2024. The ruling Georgian Dream party denies the accusation, threatening to sue the BBC in an international court.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/mediacentre/2025/bbc-eye-when-water-burns>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-6-4"></a>

Context: 2025 Honduran general election.

**Archived source account.** The Honduran National Electoral Council reports that presidential candidates Nasry Asfura and Salvador Nasralla remain separated by about 500 votes in the preliminary count, which it describes as a technical tie, and announces that a manual count will begin.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3334823/right-wing-rivals-honduras-presidency-technical-tie>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-6-6"></a>

Context: 2025 Saint Lucian general election.

**Archived source account.** The incumbent Saint Lucia Labour Party government, led by Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre, is projected to maintain a supermajority in the House of Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Associates Times](<https://associatestimes.com/news/slp-wins-2025-general-elections-in-saint-lucia>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-6-8"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria, Religious violence in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Nigerian defence minister Mohammed Badaru Abubakar resigns amid President Bola Tinubu's declaration of a nationwide security emergency.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20251201-nigeria-s-defence-minister-resigns-amid-security-crisis-presidency>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-6-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people gather across Bulgaria to protest against government corruption and the proposed 2026 budget and calls for members of prime minister Rosen Zhelyazkov's cabinet to resign.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/bulgaria-sees-biggest-protest-in-years/a-74975871>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2025-12-01-7-1"></a>

Context: Mass surveillance in India.

**Archived source account.** India's Ministry of Communications orders smartphone manufacturers to pre-install Sanchar Saathi, a government-run cybersecurity app on all new devices within 90 days and to push the app onto older models through a software update. The ministry says the app is essential in "curbing misuse of telecom resources for cyber frauds and ensuring telecom cyber security".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/india-sanchar-app-privacy-cyber-b2564204c6eda0c620e9c293d94f9839>).

<a id="event-2025-12-01-7-3"></a>

Context: Nuclear power in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia enacts amendments to its nuclear law that require permits for all atomic-energy activities, including the import, export, transshipment, and transit of radioactive and nuclear materials. The updated framework introduces stricter oversight and penalties, including the possibility of the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-tightens-nuclear-controls-under-amended-law-2025-12-02/>).

### 2025-12-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1353693101](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20December%202&oldid=1353693101>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hamas returns the remains of an unidentified person, possibly a hostage, to Israeli authorities to be examined by forensics experts.

Source citations (as archived): [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/israel-receives-remains-of-possible-hostage-and-plans-to-reopen-gaza-crossing-into-egypt>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / 2025 Bannu ambush.

**Archived source account.** A government administrator, two of his guards and a passerby are killed in an ambush against a vehicle in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-gunmen-killed-government-administrator-northwest-afghanistan-d59593ed50a51102bd98b4e59f7b3c44>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-12-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Winter Egg, one of the few Fabergé eggs remaining in private hands, sells at Christie's in London, England, United Kingdom, for £22.9 million (US$30.2 million), setting a new auction record for a work by the House of Fabergé.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/12/02/style/faberge-winter-egg-auction-sold>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-12-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed in a road accident in Almaty region, Kazakhstan.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20251202/745d427910cb462282c0270786b960f2/c.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-12-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Indonesia–Netherlands relations.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia and the Netherlands agree to repatriate two elderly Dutch nationals convicted of drug trafficking, including one on death row, on humanitarian grounds, following a request from Dutch king Willem-Alexander.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-dutch-sign-deal-repatriate-two-convicts-one-death-row-2025-12-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-3-3"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations, Deportation in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela approves the United States's request to resume deportation flights, reversing a brief suspension imposed following U.S. president Donald Trump's declaration that Venezuelan airspace was "closed".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/world/2025/12/02/venezuela-reauthorizes-deportation-flights-from-us-ministry->).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Samaritan's Purse Cessna 208 hijacking.

**Archived source account.** A Cessna 208 Caravan operated by Samaritan's Purse to distribute humanitarian aid to Maiwut County is hijacked in Juba by a gunman who tried to divert the plane to Chad, but is apprehended after landing to refuel in Wau, South Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-sudan-aid-plane-hijacked-gunman-d436a7cb44f3cfb03b2b85710c6f9ea6>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian authorities detain 17 children and nine adults belonging to the fundamentalist Jewish cult Lev Tahor, citing concerns about the safety of the children in the group. Five of the children had American and Guatemalan passports, and all 26 members were flown to New York to await investigations into their welfare.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/colombia-ultra-orthodox-jewish-sect-lev-tahor-45392d6b12f2b8223152f2cb231a7a72>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former European Union foreign and security policy chief Federica Mogherini and two others are arrested in Belgium amid a fraud investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/02/former-eu-top-diplomat-federica-mogherini-arrest-fraud-investigation>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tunisian police arrest former human rights minister Ayachi Hammami to enforce a five-year prison sentence for a state-security conspiracy conviction issued amid recent appellate court rulings that imposed long jail terms on opposition figures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisia-arrests-prominent-opposition-figure-hammami-enforce-5-year-jail-term-2025-12-02/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-12-02-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état, 2025 Guinea-Bissau general election.

**Archived source account.** The Bissau-Guinean electoral commission announces that it is unable to release election results after armed men destroyed nearly all election tally sheets during the coup.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20251202-guinea-bissau-electoral-commission-says-armed-men-destroyed-election-ballots>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-5-3"></a>

Context: 2025 Saint Lucian general election.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Saint Lucian prime minister Philip J. Pierre wins a second term in office while his party, the Saint Lucia Labour Party, wins 14 of the 15 seats in Parliament against the opposition United Workers Party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/st-lucia-election-philip-pierre-56d56031ade620596291ad9d1992ed4e>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-5-5"></a>

Context: 2026 Haitian general election.

**Archived source account.** The Transitional Presidential Council of Haiti announces that presidential and legislative elections will be held in August 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20251202-haiti-sets-august-2026-elections>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bulgarian parliament withdraws its draft 2026 budget, originally prepared for the adoption of the euro, following nationwide protests against proposed tax increases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/bulgarias-government-withdraws-2026-draft-budget-after-protests-2025-12-02/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-02-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nigerian president Bola Tinubu appoints retired army general Christopher Gwabin Musa as defence minister, following Mohammed Badaru Abubakar's resignation amid a nationwide security emergency.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theafricareport.com/400924/nigeria-names-former-top-general-christopher-musa-as-defence-minister/>).

### 2025-12-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1325936844](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20December%203&oldid=1325936844>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni crisis / Red Sea crisis / Attacks on the Eternity C.

**Archived source account.** The Houthis release eleven seamen from the Eternity C carrier.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/houthis-release-crew-greek-operated-cargo-ship-struck-red-sea-2025-12-03/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/3/yemens-houthis-release-9-mariners-held-since-july-ship-attack>).

<a id="event-2025-12-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni crisis / Yemeni civil war / 2025 Hadhramaut offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Southern Transitional Council seizes swathes of territory from the government of Yemen in Hadhramaut Governorate, including Seiyun.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/03/world/middleeast/yemen-militias-attack-oil-uae.html>).

<a id="event-2025-12-03-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Israel says it will reopen the Rafah border crossing with Egypt, allowing Palestinians to leave the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpwk7xen544o>); [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/israel-receives-remains-of-possible-hostage-and-plans-to-reopen-gaza-crossing-into-egypt>).

<a id="event-2025-12-03-0-11"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Five Palestinians, including two children, are killed by Israeli drone strikes near Khan Younis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/3/live-israeli-forces-kill-357-palestinians-in-50-days-of-ceasefire-in-gaza>).

<a id="event-2025-12-03-0-12"></a>

Context: Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli army says four of its soldiers were wounded in a Hamas attack in Rafah.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-khan-younis-airstrike-targeting-hamas-operative-after-attack-on-troops/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-12-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia announces that the search for the wreckage of Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 will resume on December 30, with Ocean Infinity conducting a 55-day underwater search in a targeted area of the southern Indian Ocean under its existing "no-find, no-fee" agreement with the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/search-missing-flight-mh370-resume-december-30-malaysia-says-2025-12-03/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-03-2-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Gaza peace plan.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Knesset votes 39–0 to endorse the 20-point Gaza peace plan, in a vote boycotted by the member parties of the Netanyahu government.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2025/12/03/middleeast/knesset-vote-trumps-gaza-plan-intl>).

### 2025-12-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363257042](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20December%204&oldid=1363257042>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / 2025 Rafah ambush.

**Archived source account.** Yasser Abu Shabab, leader of the Israeli-backed and anti-Hamas Popular Forces, is fatally shot in Rafah, Gaza, by unidentified gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israeli-collaborator-yasser-abu-shabab-reportedly-killed-gaza>).

<a id="event-2025-12-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war / 2025 Hadhramaut offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Southern Transitional Council announces the capture of the al-Mahrah Governorate from the Yemeni government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Araby Al-Jadeed](<https://www.alaraby.co.uk/politics/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%B8%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%B9%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86>).

<a id="event-2025-12-04-0-8"></a>

Context: War on drugs / 2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers.

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy strikes a boat in the Pacific Ocean alleged to have been carrying illegal narcotics, killing four people onboard the vessel, according to the United States Southern Command.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/dec/04/pentagon-boat-strike-pacific>).

<a id="event-2025-12-04-0-10"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict.

**Archived source account.** Presidents Félix Tshisekedi of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Paul Kagame of Rwanda formally sign a peace agreement in Washington, D.C., hosted by U.S. president Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/rwanda-congo-conflict-donald-trimp-peace-pact-11158408>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2025-12-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Eurovision Song Contest 2026.

**Archived source account.** Ireland, Slovenia, Spain, and the Netherlands announce they will boycott next year's Eurovision Song Contest after the European Broadcasting Union confirmed Israel's participation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/ce3xrywzpn6t>).

<a id="event-2025-12-04-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pantone names "Cloud Dancer", a shade of white, as its Color of the Year.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/12/04/style/pantone-color-of-the-year-2026-intl-scli>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-12-04-2-2"></a>

Context: Russia–United Kingdom relations / Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom imposes sanctions against Russia's GRU and several military intelligence officers after a public inquiry concludes that Russian operatives carried out the 2018 Novichok attack in Salisbury, Wiltshire, England, under orders from President Vladimir Putin. The UK also summons Russian ambassador Andrey Kelin.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-sets-out-new-sanctions-against-russia-after-novichok-report-2025-12-04/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-04-2-4"></a>

Context: Kenya–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States signs a five-year agreement to provide over $1.6 billion to Kenya's health system under its new global health strategy, with Kenya committing to increase domestic health spending by US$850 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/us-signs-pact-with-kenya-under-america-first-global-health-plan-2025-12-04/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Human trafficking in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spanish police arrest eleven people linked to a criminal network that smuggled over 300 workers into the country on tourist visas, mostly from Nepal, and placed them on farms.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/spain-workers-smuggling-nepal-21ddb9c84927a146515691242f010250>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/21/more-kidnapped-schoolchildren-freed-in-nigeria>).

<a id="event-2025-12-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen abduct 28 people after intercepting a vehicle traveling to a Maulud gathering in Bashar, Plateau State.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20251223-gunmen-kidnap-muslim-religious-event-central-nigeria>).

<a id="event-2025-12-21-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed and ten others are injured in a mass shooting when 12 gunmen open fire near a tavern in Bekkersdal, Gauteng, South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/deadly-shooting-south-africa-bekkersdal-near-johannesburg/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-12-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Extremaduran regional election.

**Archived source account.** In Extremadura, Spain, the ruling People's Party of Extremadura of regional president María Guardiola wins the elections for its first time since 2011, while PSOE Extremadura reports its worst result ever and the far-right Vox party more than doubles its share of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [RTVE](<https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20251221/elecciones-extremadura-2025-resultados-cronica/16868985.shtml>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Syrian conflict / SDF–Syrian transitional government clashes (2025–present) / December 2025 Aleppo clashes.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and eight others are injured during clashes between Syrian security forces and Syrian Democratic Forces fighters in Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.wfmz.com/news/clashes-flare-as-top-turkish-officials-visit-syria-ahead-of-deadline-for-kurdish-integration/article_e58ae448-83cc-5063-b2fe-42f9416d9cc8.html>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-0-6"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed in an Israeli airstrike against a vehicle near Sidon, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/22/live-israel-escalates-strikes-on-lebanon-displaces-dozens-in-jerusalem>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-0-9"></a>

Context: 2025 United States naval deployment in the Caribbean, United States–Venezuela relations / Operation Southern Spear.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump says that the United States will keep the oil from the oil tankers it seized off the coast of Venezuela, along with the ships themselves.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c87lnn09yj8o>); [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/defense/5660486-trump-seizes-venezuelan-oil-tankers/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-0-12"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian military forces launch airstrikes on several targets across Russia, hitting an oil terminal, an ammunition depot, and a drone launch site in Krasnodar.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-drone-attacks-d92b40dab1055df4e3512f77c27eb5c9>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-0-13"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Lieutenant general Fanil Sarvarov is killed by a car bomb in Moscow, Russia. The Security Service of Ukraine is being investigated for its role in the attack, which they have not taken responsibility for, with connections also drawn to the assassination of Igor Kirillov last year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/22/russian-general-fanil-sarvarov-killed-car-bomb-moscow-investigators-say>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-0-15"></a>

Context: Turkey–Islamic State conflict, Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Turkish intelligence agents capture a senior member of the Islamic State – Khorasan Province along the Afghanistan–Pakistan border.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://halifax.citynews.ca/2025/12/22/turkish-agents-capture-an-is-member-on-the-afghan-pakistan-border/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-12-22-1-1"></a>

Context: China–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese commerce ministry imposes a provisional set of 42.7% tariffs on dairy products imported from the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/china-eu-dairy-tariff-ev-b53e2f0afc777b3415eff3823f6a67d0>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The price of gold reaches an all-time high of US$4,383.76 per ounce, surpassing its previous peak of $4,381.52.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/gold-price-hits-record-high-of-4-383-76-on-us-rate-cut-bets-c46bc8a0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-12-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 16 people are killed and 18 others are injured, including five critically, when a passenger bus loses control on a toll road, strikes a concrete barrier, and overturns in Semarang, Central Java, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-bus-crash-java-56815beaa357343ad652127c8bb155ad>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Mexican Navy Beechcraft Super King Air plane carrying eight people, including a pediatric patient, crashes into a bay while on approach to Scholes International Airport in Galveston, Texas, United States. At least five people are killed, including a two-year-old child, while two others are rescued and another is reported missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Chron](<https://www.chron.com/gulf-coast/article/plane-crash-galveston-texas-bay-21257753.php>); [BNO News](<https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/mexican-navy-plane-carrying-pediatric-patient-crashes-near-galveston-texas-6-on-board/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/galveston-texas-plane-crash-07fbc8ca6632354bb0148df460606c86>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are injured, including three seriously and the driver, when an individual drove into a crowd waiting to watch a parade in Nunspeet, Gelderland, Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [Nunspeet Huis aan Huis in Dutch](<https://www.nunspeethuisaanhuis.nl/112/112/50474/auto-rijdt-menigte-in-in-nunspeet-meerdere-gewonden>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/netherlands-nunspeet-car-crash-parade-injuries-4e3aaa4ee95a2910afa9bcf1dce2a07a>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2025-12-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Nuclear power in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Niigata prefectural assembly approves the restart of the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Nuclear Power Plant, the world's largest nuclear facility, nearly 15 years after Japan shut down its reactors following the 2011 Fukushima disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/japan-prepares-restart-worlds-biggest-nuclear-plant-15-years-after-fukushima-2025-12-21/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-12-22-4-1"></a>

Context: India–New Zealand relations.

**Archived source account.** India and New Zealand finalize a free-trade agreement aiming to reduce most tariffs on bilateral trades, while New Zealand also pledges to invest US$20 billion in India's economy over the next 15 years.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-new-zealand-sign-free-trade-deal-with-wellington-pledging-20-billion-investment/a-75265364>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

**Archived source account.** The high court of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, rules that former prime minister Najib Razak must remain in prison, holding that a purported royal addendum allowing house arrest lacks legal force because it was not approved by the pardons board, as required under the constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysias-ex-pm-najib-face-two-key-court-rulings-1mdb-saga-2025-12-22/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-12-22-6-1"></a>

Context: Mass media in Israel.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli cabinet approves defense minister Israel Katz's proposal to close the Israeli Army Radio, one of the country's two state broadcasters, by March 1, 2026, citing dissatisfaction from soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/netanyahu-government-moves-shut-down-israels-army-radio-station-2025-12-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-22-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States president Donald Trump reveals the development of the Trump Class USS Defiant, the first American battleship built since World War II.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2084nq2npjo>); [USNI](<https://news.usni.org/2025/12/22/trump-unveils-new-battleship-class-proposed-uss-defiant-will-be-largest-u-s-surface-combatant-since-wwii>).

### 2025-12-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1368479763](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20December%2023&oldid=1368479763>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Israeli settler violence.

**Archived source account.** Five masked Israeli settlers break into a Palestinian house in the southern West Bank, killing three sheep, injuring four others, and fire tear gas into the living quarters. Three children under the age of four are taken to hospital after the tear gas attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2025-12-23/israeli-settlers-forcibly-enter-palestinian-home-kill-sheep-in-latest-west-bank-attack>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian Armed Forces confirm their withdrawal from Siversk, Donetsk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-troops-withdraw-eastern-town-siversk-2025-12-23/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-0-7"></a>

Context: War on drugs, Operation Southern Spear / 2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers.

**Archived source account.** The United States Southern Command announces U.S. forces have struck an alleged drug trafficking vessel in the eastern Pacific Ocean, killing one person.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/new-eastern-pacific-strike-alleged-drug-boat-kills/story?id=128642786>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-0-9"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistani Taliban detonates a bomb and shoots at a police van in Karak, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, killing five officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/five-pakistani-police-personnel-killed-gun-bomb-attack-2025-12-23/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war.

**Archived source account.** In an agreement mediated by the United Nations special envoy office and the International Committee of the Red Cross, the Yemeni Presidential Leadership Council and the Houthis release a joint 2,900 detainees held throughout the civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/yemen-prisoners-release-war-houthis-7523c53ce1aff283866d10e9f38e5246>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-12-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Italian Competition Authority fines Irish low-cost carrier Ryanair €255 million (US$300 million) for allegedly abusing its dominant market position from April 2023 to April 2025 by restricting how travel agencies sell its flights.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/italy-regulator-fines-ryanair-255-million-euros-alleged-abuse-dominant-position-2025-12-23/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-12-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Harmony Jets Flight 185.

**Archived source account.** A Dassault Falcon 50 jet carrying Mohammed Ali Ahmed al-Haddad, the Libyan Army chief, four other passengers and three crew crashes approximately two kilometers south of Kesikkavak, Haymana, Ankara, Turkey. No survivors are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/23/signal-lost-with-jet-carrying-libyan-army-chief-over-ankara-turkiye-says>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-libya-private-jet-contact-lost-0ff39d90fea5798a276efd3122ff8d78>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and 20 others are injured in an explosion and fire at a nursing home in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [WPVI-TV](<https://6abc.com/post/explosion-reported-nursing-home-bucks-county-reports-people-trapped/18309877/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/explosion-rips-through-pennsylvania-nursing-home-2025-12-23/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2025-12-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Montenegro–Turkey relations, Visa policy of Montenegro.

**Archived source account.** Montenegro reinstates visa-free entry for Turkish citizens but shortens the permitted stay from 90 days to 30 days after resuming cooperation with Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/citing-better-cooperation-montenegro-lifts-visas-turkish-citizens-2025-12-23/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-3-3"></a>

Context: United States–European Union relations, Visa and deportation controversies in the second Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** The United States imposes visa bans on Center for Countering Digital Hate CEO Imran Ahmed, former European Commissioner for Internal Market Thierry Breton, Global Disinformation Index co-founder Clare Melford, and HateAid CEOs Anna-Lena von Hodenberg and Josephine Ballon for allegedly pressuring U.S. social media platforms to restrict speech.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/us-targets-former-eu-commissioner-activists-with-visa-bans-over-alleged-2025-12-23/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romanian president Nicușor Dan announces an investigation into alleged systemic abuses within the judiciary after judges and prosecutors report intimidation and undue influence by the High Court of Cassation and Justice.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/romanian-president-says-judiciary-will-be-investigated-address-claims-abuses-2025-12-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Epstein Files Transparency Act.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Justice releases 30,000 more pages of files related to Jeffrey Epstein, including allegations of his ties to U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/justice-department-releases-3rd-batch-jeffrey-epstein-files-mention-tr-rcna250533>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-4-5"></a>

Context: Piracy in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan National Assembly approves a law that creates prison terms of up to 20 years for promoting or financing activities defined as piracy, blockades, or related international crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-passes-law-against-piracy-blockades-amid-us-oil-ship-seizures-2025-12-23/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-23-4-7"></a>

Context: Zagreb school stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A Croatian man is sentenced to 50 years in prison for fatally stabbing a 7-year-old student at a school in Zagreb in December 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/croatia-school-knife-attack-sentencing-1aea594e0ead5f360d716326f8b1e275>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2025-12-23-5-1"></a>

Context: 2026 Portuguese presidential election.

**Archived source account.** A court in Lisbon, Portugal, orders Chega presidential candidate André Ventura to remove campaign posters targeting the Romani people within 24 hours, ruling that the materials are discriminatory and may incite hatred, or face daily fines of €2,500 (US$2,940) per poster.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/portugals-far-right-leader-ordered-remove-posters-targeting-roma-community-2025-12-22/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Takaichi Cabinet of Japan approves a ¥122.3 trillion (US$785 billion) budget for the next fiscal year, the largest national budget in Japan's history, while reducing the debt-dependence ratio to 24.2 percent, supported by projected tax revenues of a record ¥83.7 trillion ($535 billion).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japans-cabinet-approves-record-785-billion-budget-vows-keep-debt-check-2025-12-26/>).

Context: Israel–Somaliland relations, International recognition of Somaliland.

Context: 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/malaysia-najib-razak-corruption-trial-c10c6edf4af838327052206628a57da1>).

<a id="event-2025-12-26-4-3"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court orders the preventive detention of former federal highway police chief Silvinei Vasques after he was captured in Paraguay while attempting to flee Brazil despite electronic tagging, following his conviction for involvement in the attempted coup.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-top-court-orders-detention-ex-head-highway-police-after-escape-attempt-2025-12-26/>).

### 2025-12-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1330723837](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2025%20December%2027&oldid=1330723837>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war / Kyiv strikes, Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 32 are injured during a Russian missile and drone strike on Kyiv, Ukraine. Damage to critical infrastructure leaves 40% of Kyiv's residential areas and surrounding districts without heating.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1dzvpg1341o>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Denis Kapustin, leader of the Ukraine-aligned neo-Nazi Russian Volunteer Corps, is reported to have been killed in a Russian drone strike in Zaporizhzhia Oblast. It is later revealed that Kapustin had faked his death in order to thwart an assassination attempt.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/ukraines-hur-faked-death-of-top-anti-putin-russian-commander-claimed-kremlin-bounty-money/>); [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/12/27/leader-of-russian-volunteer-corps-killed-fighting-for-kyiv-a91564>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-0-6"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur genocide.

**Archived source account.** The Rapid Support Forces kill over 200 civilians in ethnically motivated attacks targeting non-Arabs in West Darfur and during advances in North Darfur, according to the Sudan Doctors Union.

Source citations (as archived): [The Express Tribune](<https://tribune.com.pk/story/2584217/over-200-killed-in-ethnic-attacks-by-sudans-rsf-in-darfur-doctors-group-says>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-0-8"></a>

Context: 2023 Nigerien coup d'état, Islamist insurgency in Niger.

**Archived source account.** The Nigerien government declares a nationwide mobilization that authorizes the conscription of citizens and the requisition of property and services to support operations against jihadist insurgent groups.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20251227-niger-junta-orders-general-mobilisation-in-fight-against-jihadists>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-0-10"></a>

Context: 2025 Cambodia–Thailand conflict.

**Archived source account.** Cambodia and Thailand sign a new ceasefire agreement, calling for a pause in military movements and airspace encroachment for military purposes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-border-fighting-ceasefire-0019310e1c062cd211f9f5398b3bc463>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2025-12-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Cross-strait relations, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** China sanctions 20 United States defense-related companies and ten executives for providing weapons to Taiwan last week.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/china-sanctions-us-companies-arm-sale-taiwan-31e1bdef85a4cae9a765b189497ca3bf>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Lithium mining in Chile.

**Archived source account.** Chilean state-owned mining company Codelco and private miner SQM create a joint venture to develop lithium in the Atacama salt flat until 2060, with the Chilean state set to receive the majority of operating margins.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/chilean-firms-announce-creation-of-giant-company-to-exploit-lithium-4f031d54>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-1-5"></a>

Context: Trade policy of China.

**Archived source account.** The National People's Congress of China passes a revised trade law that will expand the government's authority to counter trade restrictions, regulate exports of strategic goods, and update provisions on digital, green, and intellectual-property trade from March 1, 2026.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-passes-revised-foreign-trade-law-bolster-trade-war-capabilities-2025-12-27/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2025-12-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 19 more injured as a bus plunges in to a ravine while driving on the Inter-American Highway in Sololá Department, Guatemala.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/27/at-least-15-dead-19-injured-in-guatemala-as-bus-plunges-into-ravine>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An accident involving two cars after an improper overtaking kills eleven people on the BR-101 highway near Mucuri, Bahia, Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [UOL](<https://noticias.uol.com.br/cotidiano/ultimas-noticias/2025/12/27/acidente-na-br-101-mata-11-pessoas-na-bahia-incluindo-gestante-e-criancas.htm>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are killed and eight others are injured when a bus carrying 19 charity workers overturns on a mountain in Phình Hồ, Lào Cai province, Vietnam.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-7-killed-vietnam-after-bus-overturns-2025-12-27/>); [Tuổi Trẻ](<https://news.tuoitre.vn/9-killed-8-injured-after-bus-carrying-charity-group-overturns-in-northern-vietnam-103251227142029558.htm>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 7.0 Mw earthquake, rated intensity four on the Central Weather Administration seismic intensity scale, strikes 32 km off the coast of Yilan, Taiwan, causing a temporary power outage for over 3,000 households.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/70-magnitude-earthquake-rattles-taiwan/a-75317087>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2025/12/27/asia/taiwan-earthquake-tremors-intl-latam>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2025-12-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Oil smuggling in Iran.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian justice ministry seizes a foreign-flagged oil tanker carrying 25,000 barrels traveling through the Strait of Hormuz and detains its sixteen crew members on allegations of carrying illegal items.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-seizure-oil-tanker-hormuz-strait-16f0c69a2314c17dcc08149b10861fa3>).

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2025/12/27/italy-hamas-fundraisers/8881766869202/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2025 Ivorian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of the Ivory Coast vote for the 255 members of the National Assembly despite the opposition Democratic Party boycotting due to alleged election fraud by the ruling RHDP party.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/cote-divoire-election-held-amid-opposition-boycott/a-75314914>).

<a id="event-2025-12-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Italian Parliament approves a reform that reduces the powers of the Court of Audit over public spending, caps financial penalties for negligent administrators at 30% of losses or two years of salary, and introduces automatic approval if the court does not respond within 30 days.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/italy-loosens-court-control-over-public-tenders-amid-protests-2025-12-27/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Turkey–Islamic State conflict.

<a id="event-2025-12-29-2-2"></a>

Context: Cross-strait relations / Justice Mission 2025.

**Archived source account.** China conducts the largest live fire exercises to date around Taiwan, designating multiple sea and air zones for drills by naval and air units to rehearse a blockade and to signal opposition to recent United States arms sales to Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-launches-live-firing-drills-around-taiwan-its-biggest-war-games-date-2025-12-30/>).

<a id="event-2025-12-29-3-1"></a>

### 2025-12-30

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2025-12-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza war / Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip, Gaza Strip famine, Gaza genocide.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces the suspension of many international humanitarian organizations, including Doctors Without Borders, the International Rescue Committee, and divisions of Oxfam and Caritas, from operating in Gaza starting January 1 for allegedly failing to pass new rules to vet the organizations and cooperating with Hamas and other militant groups.
